name: Mu Megabase
description:
Mu, also known as Mu Megabase, was a large group base founded in late 2017 by the Followers of Melon, Nether Highway Group and Southern Canal Corp.

After the griefing of Summermelon in May 2017, the Melon Group was left homeless. Around this time, the Nether Highway Group was nearing the end of their dig to the +,+ world border. Since Offtopia and Willyroof knew many members of both the Nether Highway Group and Melon Group, they, along with Joelik, started drawing up plans for a base with members from both groups. After the NHG reached the border, the members joined the Melon Group, as well as some members of the Southern Canal Corp, to come up with ideas for this new base. During this time, Auion, a member of the NHG, discovered the chunk dupe. Since only a few trustworthy members of the group knew how to perform the dupe, it was kept secret for roughly a year before the rest of the server had it. After the dupe was discovered, the plans for the base expanded greatly in scope. Offtopia came up with the name Mu, after the mythical lost continent of the same name, and provided the base banner. A location was decided on, but after coords were accidentally leaked, it was left as a decoy and a new location was chosen. A final plan for the base was agreed on, consisting of a large circular basin with terraformed terrain surrounding a huge mountain, with canals and themed “districts” around the edge.

After most of the members arrived at the building site, work started on the central hole. To speed up the process, the base members utilized two layers of flying TNT dupers in order to clear the jungle terrain and carve out the basin. The original plan called for the basin to be 1600 blocks in diameter, but it was scaled down to just 1000 blocks in diameter due to the sheer scale of the bomber project. After the hole was finally carved out, it was filled with a layer of grass, which required multiple dubs of shulkers of grass blocks. After that, the central feature of the base began construction; Mu Mountain, which was designed by Toshie and built mostly by Scribblefoxx, along with help from Totaldarkness, Offtopia and Oldschoolgamerx, was built between February 25 and April 7th 2018. In October 2018, after the chunk dupe finally went public, Thebesandsound created large stashes that could hold massive amounts of resources. One of these stashes was eventually world edited out by Hausemaster after it created a large amount of lag. The base was relatively inactive for most of 2019, with many members getting burnt out by the sheer scale of the project. However, in early 2020, Scribblefoxx invited a few new members to the base, including some former members of Valerian. This breathed new life into the base, and new plans started to be drawn up for the future of Mu. However, after the account exploit of late February 2020, during which many well known members had their accounts logged into, the base was compromised. After transferring most of the resources from the stashes, the base members filled the central basin of Mu with water to make griefing more difficult, submerging the base just as the fictional lost continent of Mu supposedly sunk beneath the waves. Many aspects of the original plan, including the canals and themed districts, were never fully realized. After the base was compromised, Byrnsy revealed the base to the general community on the subreddit.

name: Sundial
description: BarrenDome's working sundial is a 153-block-wide desert build made from roughly 21,000 blocks of locally collected stone, andesite, and diorite. Its recessed markings cover Minecraft's daylight hours in half-hour steps. Reading it requires a shader that renders the pointer's shadow; BarrenDome demonstrated it with Sildur's Vibrant Shaders and also showed the moon casting a midnight shadow.

name: Point Nemo
description:
Point Nemo is a destroyed base located on the 2b2t X+ World Border, constructed by the +X Digging Group. The base was griefed a single week after construction began, and completely wiped out in the following months.

The landscape of the area was generated in 1.6. The first known people who reached the area were Pyrobyte and iTristan on December 7th, 2013 (most likely with a backdoor). They left a bedrock platform on the other side of the border, with two signs, reading:

"It's the end of the world -Pyrobyte December 7 2013"

"iTristan was here. If you see this, shit went down"

iTristan also left the 121 book from the Mein Kampf collection, created by Victormeriqui, and a super weapon on the other side of the border.

On December 9th 2016, Byrnsy started a journey towards the very same place, thus formed the +X Digging Group. It was established that once they reach the World Border, they were going to build a base there, just like they did at other notable points. They named it Point Nemo, after the oceanic pole of inaccessibility - the furthest point on Earth from land, located in the Southern Pacific Ocean.

On March 26th, 2017, the first group of diggers - househousehouse1, xxq, irql, rasqi, miningminecraft, and several others - reached the World Border, and discovered Pyro's and iTristan's signs. They also manged to retrieve the Mein Kampf book.

As other group members also arrived, the building of the base started. On March 28th, when Byrnsy finished his journey, the place had already started to take shape. However, a day later, it was griefed.

On April 24th, Fit finished his own journey to the world border, and several of the former diggers, including Byrnsy, gathered at the partially repaired base as a formal welcome party.

On April 30th, the base was griefed again.

During May, the base was fully destroyed, and lavacasted beyond repair.

Negative_Entropy and other builders expanded the original lodge into a large spawn base, including Todarac’s Smibby Land to the north. It was destroyed on June 5, 2021. The current Archive warps for the historical base are labeled June 4, 2021. A separate single-player concept retains a May 22, 2021 label and includes additions made after the grief; that concept is not an untouched live-server snapshot.

The group soon left to finish the remaining six million Overworld-equivalent blocks of its border journey. MiningMinecraft’s contemporary tour shows the base while it was still being built.

name: NFE
description:
Negative Fourhundred Eighthundred (NFE) was a spawnbase and sanctuary, thought to be originally built by a Facepunch user and the early home to xcc2 and alex02028. Today, the majority of the spawnbase is encased in a giant lavacast, but there are some features that can be made out and are still standing today.

Due to it being only about 900 blocks away from spawn it was easily griefed, but it took 2 years for the base to finally go down due to the defense of xcc2 and his basemates.

NFE was started in early 2011 by Pimpmastaflex and possibly other anonymous Facepunch players. It started as a castle and was presumed to be abandoned by xcc when he arrived at it. xcc2 repaired the castle along with another player named alex02028. Months later, many players had heard of the base around the server and was a popular attraction. xcc and alex02028 offered food and gear to new players who came to NFE. Due to the base's popularity and proximity to spawn, NFE was repeatedly griefed and repaired. In one case the base was covered in a lavacast, the creator of which fell to their death after the cast was removed. x0XP and Cold_Storage77 eventually aided alex and xcc in defense with x0XP later naming the base. Finnish griefers named Pyylaandia repeatedly griefed NFE, repeatedly detroying the base to such an extent as to cause alex02028 to permanently leave the server and xcc2 to move to other bases such as Plugin Town The base was completely destroyed after the introduction of withers.

name: Pit Fight 9
description:
Pit Fight 9 was Obscension’s January 22, 2022 event. Teams defended beacons on themed floating islands around a lighthouse while attacking the other islands. The Archive dates the venue’s establishment to January 15 and preserves a January 22 download.

The 2b2t Wiki records Arkloe as the winner of the $100 prize. The organizer shared an event recap on January 23, thanking players for the turnout.

name: SBA 1
description: SBA 1 was the Spawn Builders Association’s first spawn base, founded in May 2021. Its central double helix became a recurring group symbol. The Archive preserves a download labeled May 2021. This Overworld site is separate from SBA’s later Nether spawn build.

name: The Drain
description:
The Drain was the base of Offtopia and willyroof which was constructed during the waning days of the Rusher War. Offtopia based with high ranking members of Team Aurora who helped with the construction. The base was toured by FitMC on October 22nd, 2016, without Offtopia's permission.

Fit was able to find it by using the bedrock exploit of late 2016, which had been used to find the location of his Fitlantis base beforehand. After Fit's video, Offtopia declared that the base was compromised and it was the end. Fit then made a video explaining that he would not reveal the coordinates. However, Offtopia knew Fit had used the bedrock exploit and suspected someone would use Fit's video to locate the base. Eventually, the 4th Reich found the base, due to Fit "accidentally" publishing the coords in his "Fitlantis" World Download, and they griefed it. The base can be downloaded here (It says fitlantis download, but you spawn at the drain)

Deliberate lavacasts concealed the farm, and later griefs and repairs left successive rooms, farms and ruins. The wiki identifies maxtorcd55 with a 2017 renovation. description: deaddreamer built Homebase Theta, a creeper-themed base near spawn, which the Archive dates to 2012. In his September 2018 retrospective, xcc2 describes finding it partly damaged, restoring it and living there for a time. He reports finding it in ruins again shortly before writing that account. The Archive preserves a November 8, 2017 download of the site.

name: Asgard I
description: Asgard I was an unfinished Valkyria base planned by Sato86 in 2013 around a mountain site. Its builders included Offtopia, xcc2 and passie05. The group abandoned the project after popbob discovered its location through the thunderhack exploit. Originally called Asgard, it became known as Asgard I after the later Asgard II project. The Archive preserves a January 20, 2014 download.

name: Plugin Town
description:
Plugin Town was a base that was made in the very early days of 2b2t and was known for how it was built. The base was built by popbob, xcc2, and several others using TooManyItems, which popbob granted to them with his backdoor.

After Passietown was griefed by luke2thebun in December 2011, many of the members, including xcc2, passie05, popbob and policemike55, left and founded a new base.

Using a plugin that he created for Hausemaster, popbob gave himself access to the TooManyItems mod, which meant that the base members had virtually unlimited resources at their disposal. Since the base was made during the Beta version of Minecraft, the builders were restricted to using the comparatively few blocks available at the time, so they did their best to make the base look nice. This backdoor access would eventually give the base the name Plugin Town.

name: Armorland
description: In August 2017 there was an exploit that allowed players to travel long distances in a short period of time using elytras. This exploit was mainly used to lag the server by loading a lot of chunks at the same time. However, this exploit was used by a few players to reach the world border very fast. Armorsmith would use this exploit to be the first player on 2b2t to reach the end world border corner, and he built a base at -30000000 -30000000 called Armorland, although a few players would reach it a few days after him.

name: Fort Aqua
description: Joey_Coconut, Crawket and LordGalvatronMC founded Fort Aqua on July 25, 2020. JIDF members cleared an ocean monument and developed the base before its coordinates appeared on a livestream. Residents destroyed it on August 1, the date of the preserved Archive download. The site also appears in the histories of the New Facepunch Republic and the revived Shortbus Caliphate.

name: The Hudson Inn
description: Fit built the Hudson Inn in 2013, according to the Archive. Sage_Mathias later restored it. The preserved download is dated February 3, 2017.

name: The Cesspool
description:
Happysnackers started the cesspool on the 25th of August 2018. During the first month or so of the base's existence it was nothing more than a starter base, consisting of happy's tower and a some small farms which were later relocated.

Towards the beginning of October, Happy brought KissinHomiesGN, ProphetofJohn and REDMONSTER_GAME to the base and then the base really began to take shape. Walls were quickly constructed, farms were moved, expanded and improved, a storage room was built, everyone built their own houses, and an arena was constructed.

Sometime in between mid-october and the beginning of November, ProphetofJohn met a player by the name of KatPatch on the highway and recruited the player as a slave. That player would quickly advance past being a slave and became extremely respected within the base due to being very efficient at gathering materials as well as an amazing builder. Katpatch helped with just about everything around the base and built big parts of the base such as the slave district and the small valley of wheat.

Sometime in November the bookdupe went public and Happysnackers began duping items for the base. This was huge as many members of the base didn't have a huge amount of gear yet.

Midway through November another player would get recruited on the highway by Happysnackers. PeeptheMeep contributed to the base by being the driving force behind what was supposed to be a huge underground castle build. PeeptheMeep also duped a lot for the base using the book dupe as well.

In January a player by the name of TheReverend was recruited through Reddit by KissinHomiesGN. TheReverend came out to the base, looked around, considered griefing the place but ultimately decided to join the group instead, bringing with him some of the members of his group "The Excursion", Such As Daemon__.

Throughout all this REDMONSTER_GAME was working on the library, which was completed sometime in January, ProphetofJohn completed the town hall, and Reverenend also began a dome build which unfortunately never really got off the ground.

The base met it's end on 7/27/19.

name: Pleiades 5: Fort of GoA
description: Pleiades 5, also called Fort of GoA, belonged to the Guardians of Andromeda’s Pleiades base series. The Archive dates its establishment to March 14, 2021 and preserves an April 9 download.

name: Poppy Town
description: Poppy Town began as a small 2019 base built by SC0EY, Jinkers, Swiss_Bank and TheRealMozzie. I_tri rediscovered it in January 2021 and invited friends, including members of Shortbus Caliphate, to expand the town and farms. Astral Brotherhood revived the site in January 2022, adding a castle, church and numerous organic builds. The base was attacked and then largely self-griefed on February 5, 2022. The Archive preserves a download dated that day.

D_loaded founded the base; iAmZeiss, Steampunkjax, Jackpadge and other members helped expand it. The Archive lists establishment on September 12 and preserves a December 8 download, while the published history dates its founding to September 15. The base was destroyed in December 2021.

name: Final Stronghold
description: _Smokescreen_ built the Final Stronghold in 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 4, 2021.

name: Space Valkyria
description:
Space Valkyria was an End base that was built by Jacktherippa. It is perhaps the most notable End base in 2b2t history along with its successors Space Valkyria 2 and Space Valkyria 3.

Construction was mainly made possible because Jacktherippa had several infinites; rare glitched blocks which were able to be placed more than once. As the base steadily progressed and expanded, Jacktherippa started to invite more players to his base. Pyrobyte gave Jack various player heads, which he displayed on armor stands at the base. The only known person who had found Space Valkyria other than people invited before the grief was Fit on accident in 2015. After he took a look around, he continued his journey into the End for his own project, the DFC.

In mid 2015, while Pyrobyte was afk at the base, the /msg coordinate exploit was used on him, and jared2013, popbob and taylo112 arrived at Space Valkyria and griefed it. Once the server updated to 1.9, c1yd3i and jared2013 re-griefed and withered the base on their way to grief Space Valkyria 2. The two griefers, using iTristan's backdoor access, teleported to Space Valkyria almost instantly. Almost all of Space Valkyria was destroyed beyond repair, and it was destroyed even more over the next few years, with the base almost unrecognizable today. The 4th Reich also paid a visit to Space Valkyria and griefed its remains as much as they could. Jack, however, gave out an un-griefed world download for the general public in Fit's short cinematic video on Space Valkyria.

The Archive also offers a completed concept version. Its catalog explicitly says that version was not present on 2b2t in that form; it is separate from the historical May 29, 2015 capture.

name: Wawa
description: Wawa was an Astral Brotherhood main base built from late 2024 into early 2025. It included Centauri's Victorian neighborhood Sorrento, the large VLC traffic-cone tribute, and grounds used for the group's Christmas events. The group's published tours identify individual builders and structures.

name: Summermelon
description:
Summermelon was a base on 2b2t founded by Toshie, Vaxent, Aaron_Alvin, and theloneloner after Wintermelon was griefed. Later additions included Offtopia, Willyroof, CytotoxicTcell, Drud14, Krobar01, and Todarac.

Summermelon was one of the largest bases on 2b2t. It was under construction for only 4 months before it was destroyed.

Sometime in May, Bigdon50 was invited to Summermelon and after a couple weeks, leaked the coords to Fit. On July 28th, 2017, Fit made a video on griefing Summermelon for "revenge", with the help of Alphacomputer and three others. 

At the time, Fit and Alphacomputer were members of the Spawn Masons. However, contrary to popular belief, the grief was not executed (or even approved by) the Spawn Masons. It was Fit and Alphacomputer acting on their own. After the grief, Alphacomputer was voted out and Fit left (due partially to the fact that Krobar01 was in the Spawn Masons at the time).

After the town, most of the builders moved onto Offtopia's flagship base, Mu.

The Archive also offers a separately labeled finished concept version. That completed design is not a record of everything built on the live server.

name: Angkor
description: Angkor was an Emperium base preserved in a November 23, 2019 Archive download.

name: FSC: Notre Dame
description: Franknificant built the first church in the Four Spawn Churches Project with help from monkeboy121 in September 2020. This Overworld recreation of Notre-Dame de Paris was used for Fight Club and is preserved in a January 4, 2021 Archive download. It is separate from his later Nether recreation.

name: Melon Town / Pumpkinville
description: Melon Town and Pumpkinville were neighboring themed villages built by BarrenDome. Melon Town reworked a village's houses, paths, farms, and chapel in melon blocks, while Pumpkinville used pumpkins, perimeter fencing, and cactus defenses. BarrenDome's tours turn their contrasting designs into a fictional rivalry between the two villages and their mayors.

name: Mushroom Island Base

name: New Zion
description: New Zion was an unfinished group build documented by BarrenDome during his early 2b2t travels. His tour shows a partially built tower, a mansion with a damaged interior, and a large atrium. The footage records the site after some griefing, with much of the exterior architecture still recognizable.

name: Hitlerwood
description: Coldwave and Zach3397 founded Hitlerwood for their revival of the Facepunch community in early 2013, with Hinderjd and other members contributing. The base was abandoned when its residents joined the Black Flag Group to form Valkyria in April 2013. This New Facepunch Republic was separate from the later revival founded in 2019.

name: Androxius' Island Base
description: The Archive dates Androxius’ island base’s establishment to March 17, 2014 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: Castle Hatehart
description:
Castle Hatehart, also known as Castle Hateheart, originally named Bitchette and named the West Road Inn in its early construction was an abandoned castle used as an inn for travelers created in conjunction with the Old Spawn Road by LegitYarik in Late 2013/Mid 2014. The castle would later be used by Team Veteran and griefed by the vets due to incoming traffic from the road. Multiple restoration projects have been made by traveling individuals. Due to its proximity to spawn, however, the castle would always get griefed again and again.

LegitYarik, the creator of the Old Spawn Road, decided to build a large castle for travelers in conjunction with the old spawn road around about 2013/2014. Since it was built during the construction of the road, it was specially built to accommodate for the path. This castle would serve as an early start to travelers, having mines, food, and all the basic necessities and early player would need at the time. In 2016, throughout the 4th Incursion, the castle would serve as a good meeting point for veterans.

The Archive dates the cathedral’s establishment to May 2022 and preserves a May 18 download; the wedding itself took place later. This venue is separate from Franknificant’s earlier cathedral designs.

name: Invictus I
description: Upon reaching Invictus I, Vertrix and Russian began recruitment, the first players recruited left quickly and were forgotten. Some of the first players to stay were named Fogel_2 and Screams. Russian disappeared from the server, so Fogel_2 took over his role as co-leader. The base began to take shape. Screams and Vertrix would run into Slappnbadkids independently of eachother, and would invite and vouch for him, respectively. Slappnbadkids would then invite Juicybear, b3astplay3r, TechReadyGamer, TaurusBabe, chairman_112, PhantomSB, and GetDroppedKids rounded out the group. GetDroppedKids invited Donster to the base without telling any of the other members. Donster began sending messages to Vertrix, using the account JaredIsKing, describing things about the base that only someone who'd seen it would know. The members were all paranoid people, so they destroyed the base, kicked GetDroppedKids, and moved to a new location. In all, the base lasted under a month.

Its medieval city expanded across three areas joined by bridges, with walls, houses and churches inspired by Antwerp’s cathedral tower and Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia. The latter church remained unfinished. Backstreet Boys destroyed the base in April 2022. The Archive preserves a download labeled April 3.

Beneath a tundra biome, builders excavated a roughly 255-block-wide pit to bedrock and constructed a vast dome above a landscaped interior. Durkaaqt and Beardler drove much of the excavation; Beardler built most of the dome, while xrayessay, YoMoBoYo and cpybara designed the terrain. The project was still unfinished when it was griefed on June 25, the date of the Archive’s preserved download.

name: Ravendel

name: Block Game Mecca
description:
Block Game Mecca (BGM) was founded on January 1, 2017, and griefed on June 1, 2018. It is considered one of the largest bases on 2b2t, although, after its grief, many of the builds were determined to be schematics.

Block Game Mecca was founded on January 1, 2017, by GanjMeisterBlock and AutismBot. Its creation followed in the wake of a short-lived project with C4RTM4N. Most of the original base members were selected from C4RTM4N's Creative Mode Project, with a few additions of friends. The base started slowly, due to its distance and the lack of a travel exploit at the time, many members took months to arrive. A goldfarm was constructed early, but most of the initial efforts went into creating the guardian farm area. Once that was complete, the sorting system and the UFO (circular spike building near goldfarm) were built. Not long after those were constructed, the donkey dupes became public. The members of BGM immediately began work on a large number of massive builds, several of which were never completed. The cathedral is probably the most impressive of them. Nearly everyone at the base put some work into it, and it was completed less than a week before the base was griefed.


A render of the Hitler Statue, a symbol of the base
Block Game Mecca had a "trickle" invitation system. The members found that long periods of peacetime exhausted players, and accordingly had several-month long gaps between inviting players. Invitations were generally handed out every 3-6 months, with only one or two people being recruited at a time.


A render of the entire base.
The downfall of BGM came with the last series of recruits. The base was beginning to stagnate, and out of a large list, doctrzombie, Todarac, and Beardler were invited, as all had fantastic reputations. Unbeknownst to the members of Block Game Mecca, Beardler had conspired with a player named Odorous to steal all the items in Drathader's museum. A short time after his arrival, on June first, 2018, the museum was stolen and withered, and the center of the base was slightly damaged. Base members along with jared2013 concluded to blow up the rest of the base rather than allow others the satisfaction of doing so. These events led to the "BoeMeccan Witch Trials," during which it was proven that Beardler held guilt in the destruction of Boedecken as well as Block Game Mecca.

description: Franknificant and Gravixious built this Speyer Cathedral replica at the second HermeticLock SMP site in late 2021. It contained a banner museum and used an obsidian core beneath its exterior. The Archive dates its establishment to October 23 and preserves a November 7 download; the published build catalog places its construction in November.

Districts combined a downtown with fantasy builds, while a storage system sorted shulker boxes. The Archive dates its founding to June 28, 2019 and preserves an October 6 download, the day the city was destroyed following a coordinate leak.

The Archive preserves this section separately under March 6, 2022.

name: Fort Unpopulated
description: Fort Unpopulated is an early stone-and-cobblestone fort near spawn, marked by its name laid out on the ground. In niko's tour, Project Nostalgia volunteers explain how they repaired the damaged site, continuing work begun by another restorer. Their tour connects it with the early Facepunch settlement network; the surviving build should be understood as a mixture of old remains and later restoration.

name: Farm
description: 24 built this farm, tentatively dated by the Archive to 2015. The preserved download is dated November 12, 2016.

name: Kool Kid's Klub
description:
The Kool Kids Klub was a base founded by c1yd3i and Rustle_League . It was started as the two got bored from travelling as far as they could away from spawn. The base was famous for housing the largest gold farm in 2b2t history, outsizing even the one at Aureus.

C1yd3i and Rustle_League, when they first joined, wanted to get as far away from spawn as they could. Eventually, they reached the millions by travelling on the Nether highway. At some point though, they got tired and have founded the base sometime in 2014. The two began working on the base and eventually began to slowly invite other players such as James_Rustles, who arrived November 25th, 2014, SilverKrownKing, DocSmurf, and Dr_Cash. James_Rustles eventually invited Fit to join the base. According to Fit, when he arrived, the base was really ugly. The group had large ambitions for the base and they eventually agreed to build the largest gold farm in 2b2t history.

name: Gape 2.0
description:
The Gape Group was a group that saw its first roots during February of 2014, when Victor96 made a giant hole near 1k -1k. Some people came to the area to build a few castles and fortresses, but nothing much came of it. It was later griefed, with lavacasts filling in the hole. Eventually 9 players would revisit the area after the disbandment of Valkyria, but it was griefed once again even harder.

A few members of Gape 1.0 then decided to go out farther from spawn to start the new Gape, Gape 2.0, also called Caleesii's Cape (As she was one of the builders). The members of the base where coconut4, Caleesii, James_Rustles, and Victor96. But there where a few people who visited the area.

Some members of this group, including Victor96 and Caleesii, later based at The Monastery and renamed it "Gape Haven" sometime around mid 2016.

description: In 2015, iTristan used unauthorized server access to copy Imperator’s original base to a second site near X 3,237,684, Z -1,788,243. The copy included a large void hole, later covered by a bedrock floor. jared2013 rediscovered the site in May 2021 and attacked it with HermeticLock and orsond on May 29. The Archive preserves a May 30 download of this second site.

Following an accidental coordinate leak, Enchoseon and Joey_Coconut relocated the signboard and invited more members. A building competition and the Beard Hole project helped the base grow. It was later compromised through the Log4j exploit. The Archive dates its establishment to October 27, 2021 and preserves a December 9 download.

name: Passie Town / Squidbase
description:
Squidbase, also known as Squid town, Squidpolice town, or Passietown, was a 2011 base inhabited by several famous players and a squid statue. It was griefed by luke2thebun in late December of 2011. 

There have been two bases named Squidbase, the first one was just a few thousand blocks off of Spawn. Its members where Passie05, policemike55, and Squidgeymon. This is where the "Squid" part of the base name came from. It was griefed in early 2011, possibly by popbob.

The well known Squid Base was founded by passie05 and policemike55 during August of 2011. The base went on to boast many castles and the iconic Blooper. The base also had a spot where Facepunch Republic members had meetings. It is unknown when, but popbob went on to join the base and built a large dome, in which he would build several others and would later become iconic. He joined unwantedly, but popbob used his backdoor abilities to get materials for the base, so the members did not mind.

The base was later griefed by Luke2thebun and tytoowns281, both 4channers, who attacked the Facepunch base. Funnily enough, all of the grief was caught on the footage.

5 years later the base was later leaked to the public by PandaSauceYT during the events of the Rusher War. The base has seen more destruction.

name: DonFuer 20
description: DonFuer 20 was a DonFuer base featuring a netherrack castle, a quartz pyramid and a large D_loaded statue. SpawnMasons visiting after a coordinate leak added their own builds under the name Covid-2149. The Archive preserves both versions under March 10, 2021, shortly before the base was destroyed on March 13. Sources disagree on its founding date: the Archive lists June 20, 2020, while the base’s wiki history gives October 27.

name: James Rustle's House of Fun
description: House of Fun was James_Rustles’ first base. The Archive records its abandonment on December 9, 2013 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: Zeta Base
description: Zeta Base was an Emperium base in the End. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2, 2020 and preserves a February 24, 2021 download.

name: Space Valkyria II
description:
Space Valkyria 2 was a base created by Jacktherippa after the destruction of the original Space Valkyria.

After the original Space Valkyria was griefed by taylo112, popbob and jared2013, Jack traveled about 2000 blocks away and started building another base. This may not seem like very far, but the End was nothing but an empty void at this time so after Jack destroyed his bridge that he used to travel to this new site, there was no real way of knowing where he was. To make sure no one could find this base, Jack griefed every known End portal on the server a month after starting work on Space Valkyria 2, cutting off access to the End for the rest of 2015. jared2013 and the rest of Nerds Inc knew that Jack was still in the End, but they couldn’t get to him.

Space Valkyria 2 consisted of two builds; the main build and Space Valkyria Island. Space Valkyria Island, also known as The Island of the End, was a large floating island covered in grass. Topping it off was a building containing storage, farms, passive mobs, and even villagers. An enderman farm was also built nearby. The main build was a massive structure made almost entirely out of quartz and obsidian, instead of quartz and stone brick. This gave Space Valkyria 2 an even more futuristic aesthetic than the original.

name: Invictus II
description: The leadership in the group shifted following the move, at the helm was now the trinity of Vertrix, Slappnbadkids, and b3stplay3r. The group began to work on Invictus II (sometimes called Autismbot's 1Mil Base), and the base was progressing steadily. Drathader, Sophrosyne, and Joey_Coconut were invited around this time. Slappnbadkids was experimenting with the BedTP exploit, when he accidentally discovered La Rosa, a large base started in the beginning of 2016. The group moved to raid the base, carrying off a load of riches. Joey_Coconut passed by the raid group while they were bringing the riches back to the base, hiding from them, not realizing they were his basemates since he only knew Slappnbadkids. A book was found claiming the base was abandoned so they decided only to rob the base and not grief it. As it turned out, C4RTM4N still lived there and was unhappy about all his possessions being stolen. He made this known, alerting the Invictus group to the fact that La Rosa was very much not uninhabited. As a result, Slappnbadkids decided to grief the base for the name recognition and notoriety. Chairman_112 achieved a fame of sorts by insiding NedaT's faction, Team Aurora. In light of this, NedaT was invited to Invictus II to do a base tour and to 1 v 1 chairman_112, following the leak of the base by a new member, PhantomOf2b2t. Mines also did a tour. The base lasted until late September 2016. As the base was only leaked and not raided, the group moved to save the items. The issue was no one knew who leaked the base immediately, so about half of the group consisting of Slappnbadkids, Vertrix, b3astslay3r, Drathader, Sophrosyne, and Joey_Coconut took all the items and stashed them several thousand blocks away for safekeeping. Once it was determined that PhantomOf2b2t was the leaker, what was left of the group reassembled, and determined it was time to move. Many members of the group departed from the server.

The base was another victim of this drama along with Block Game Mecca.

After the group became inactive, Galvatron revived it as a personal base with contributions including Jelooboi’s library and Joey_Coconut’s towers. The Archive preserves his November 16, 2022 download, taken during plans to redesign the main area. Fifth Column destroyed the base in February 2023.

Krobar01 and Joey_Coconut extended their neighboring builds into a staged battle between airships and alien spacecraft.

After terraforming a mountain and surrounding terrain, they merged the base group into Astral Brotherhood in November and renamed the site. Universin’s castle and library, Osmobyte’s portal and Zodiac temple, an observatory, and later suburbs and a canal pump expanded the base. Fifth Column griefed it in January 2023. The Archive labels its preserved download January 27; the published history dates the grief to January 26.

The Archive preserves a January 2, 2023 download and a separate concept version with a finished dragon. The concept version is not a record of the dragon’s completion on the live server.

Construction began on November 1, 2022 with help from volunteer Spawn Builders Association members. Unusual materials included creeper heads, TNT, cauldrons and enchanting tables, each presenting different building problems. FitMC’s documentary credits bobbers22, SBA and the Jesus Valley Project as sources. The Archive preserves a January 28, 2023 download.

name: Crusaders Krack
description: Crusaders Krack was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to January 6, 2023 and preserves a March 4 download.

name: Crystalline
description: Dr_Cash built Crystalline in 2013, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated July 3, 2019.

name: Dawn's Crown
description: IKhanBuildThat2 built Dawn’s Crown as a Vortex Coalition base. The Archive dates its establishment to 2019 and preserves a June 23 download.

name: DayTown
description: The Archive dates DayTown’s establishment to June 26, 2014 and preserves an October 22, 2017 download.

name: Deadwood
description: Deadwood was a Vapepens Elite Alliance base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 19, 2024 and preserves a September 4 download. Max1mumChr1s’ builder history lists contributions there.

name: Dingusbongusfair
description: Dingusbongusfair was a DonFuer base established on September 7, 2023, according to the Archive. Its catalog includes a November 21 download at the coordinates of this location.

name: Don Chykukanukakisaki
description: Don Chykukanukakisaki, usually shortened to Don Chyku, was a DonFuer base founded by Phosph0lipid on February 3, 2024. Its walled layout and districts drew on East Asian architecture. Builders included Phosph0lipid, Vethre, rainbowren11, N8TT and Warske. The Archive preserves a July 9 download.

name: Don Maximus
description: Max1mumChr1s and Traveeseemo founded Don Maximus on March 31, 2023. Its varied biomes supported medieval, western, sandstone and modern districts. Builds included Max1mumChr1s and knullsidor’s castle, Senko_Foxx’s pyramid and farm, and a full-scale Southern Canal replica for WaterWay Union’s six-month anniversary. Visiting WaterWay Union members also built at the base. Teutonic Order destroyed it on July 7. The Archive preserves a July 5 download.

name: DonFuer 28
description: DonFuer 28 was a remote End base begun on June 22, 2023, after the group lost an earlier base during the Randar exploit. Builders traveled millions of blocks into the End and cleared islands around a castle that served as their initial headquarters. The project expanded over roughly a year, with transporting supplies and avoiding losses to the void forming a major part of its construction story.

name: DopeFuer
description: ko8efanboy built DopeFuer as a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 9, 2023 and preserves a July 20 download.

name: Dr. Cash's House of Fun
description: Dr_Cash built his House of Fun in 2013, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 28, 2019.

name: Dubrovnik
description: Dubrovnik was Astral Brotherhood’s main base from August 2022 to April 2023, founded by Joey_Coconut, LordGalvatronMC and smcz19. More than 55 players contributed to a city inspired by the Croatian port, alongside districts with other styles. Landmarks included xrayessay’s Westminster Abbey and RICELAND1’s giant serpent, Son of Veles. Members self-griefed the base in April 2023. The Archive preserves an April 9 download and a separate concept version with the serpent completed; that concept should not be mistaken for the original server state.

name: Duxie
description: Duxizon built Duxie. The Archive dates its establishment to March 15, 2022 and preserves a January 31, 2023 download.

name: Dystopia
description: The Archive dates Dystopia’s establishment to August 27, 2023 and preserves an October 20 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Eastmarch
description: GanjMeisterBlock, Master_Builder and X_Azrael_X began Eastmarch in late 2016, far beyond the highways of the time. A BedTP chain helped players reach the site, which developed an early autofarm perimeter. Joey_Coconut later became its caretaker and continued visiting and repairing it until its July 2024 grief. His published history dates its founding to October 10, while the Archive lists November 10. The preserved download is dated February 3, 2023.

name: Eldemür
description: Eldemür was a Last Templar base established in late 2022. Its builders’ August 2023 showcase describes an unfinished project that they self-griefed after security compromises. Their account dates its founding to October 27; the Archive lists November and preserves an August 12, 2023 download. The showcase credits a large building team and explains that the statues adapted existing 3D models.

name: Elsweyr
description: OblivionWalker built Elsweyr as an Astral Brotherhood base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 7, 2023 and preserves an April 10 download.

name: Entropic Extinction
description: YoMoBoYo and RICELAND1 built Entropic Extinction, a SpawnMasons lodge preserved by the Archive under September 23, 2023.

name: Equinox
description: LifeGrips built Equinox as a Samsara base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2024 and preserves a May 23 download.

name: Esztergom Synagogue
description: A group of Astral Brotherhood members and friends built a rendition of the Esztergom Synagogue near the 1533 road at spawn. Their published showcase describes the project and records that it was self-griefed after a gathering with the SpawnMasons.

name: Etazhi
description: Blizzen built Etazhi. The Archive dates its establishment to December 2022 and preserves a March 19, 2023 download.

name: Eternity's End
description: Breithan and BoomerangVillage built Eternity’s End in the Overworld. The Archive dates its establishment to June 2, 2018 and preserves an October 30 download.

name: Everhill
description: Everhill was established on September 24, 2020, according to the Archive. Astral Brotherhood’s 2023 retrospective credits Thranoz, Legend_Bake, IronException, Joey_Coconut and others, while explicitly describing it as not strictly an Astral base. Its preserved download is dated August 10, 2023.

name: Everyone Base
description: Joey_Coconut founded EveryoneBase on October 13, 2023 as a shared building project for players from different 2b2t groups. More than eighty players participated, including members of SpawnMasons, DonFuer, Astral Brotherhood, VEA, SBA, GreyBeard Geezers and other groups. Landmarks included Nasder’s tower, an arena, and MuskWizard and Clink_Clank’s GeezerCheese monument. The base lasted three days before Fifth Column destroyed it. The Archive preserves an October 15 download.

name: Ex Animo
description: Ex Animo was an Imperial Empire base established in December 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated December 27. Warske’s builder history also lists the base among his projects.

name: Family Feud
description: The Wedding Planners organized this Family Feud event on June 30, 2024. Thirty-six players competed over three hours, answering questions based on a survey of more than 100 community members. Astral Brotherhood won, followed by SpawnMasons and CGI. The organizers credited Capybara, Ciroc, YoMo, MagicEx, 1drw and P529 with designing and placing the build. Hundreds of maparts displayed the questions and answers. The Archive preserves a download from the event date.

name: Far Neg
description: The Archive dates Far Neg’s establishment to February 25, 2024 and preserves an August 11 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Fatlantis
description: Fatlantis was an Astral Brotherhood base for trusted recruits, established on April 13, 2023 according to the Archive. Several dozen players built there over eleven months. The group self-griefed the base after a basehunter found it, then published a showcase in March 2024. The preserved download is dated March 16.

name: Fort Alcazar
description: Th3_L1nk built Fort Alcazar. The Archive dates its establishment to May 2022 and preserves an April 22, 2024 download.

name: Fort Concord
description: Fort Concord began as a 2017 spawnbase; the Archive preserves a July 28, 2017 download. In 2023, Joey_Coconut, smcz19, YoMoBoYo and Todarac restored the old base using a world download and expanded it into an Astral Brotherhood community project. The group reported 123 contributors over two months. The linked Astral showcase and history-video chapter cover that later rebuild, not the 2017 capture.

name: Fort Winchester
description: Inzland built Fort Winchester. The Archive dates its establishment to July 16, 2024 and preserves a September 22 download.

name: Fox Fall
description: xrayessay and Harrisssonn founded Fox Fall after meeting on the ++ diagonal highway. Its landmarks included a giant stone fox, a Vesuvius-inspired volcano, a spruce village, a mansion inspired by Howl’s Moving Castle, and a large pyramid. YoMoBoYo developed a contrasting dark-oak area and, with Legend_Bake, collected mobs for an ark and the mansion. SpawnMasons grants helped fund the pyramid. The Archive dates the base’s establishment to August 25, 2021 and preserves a March 13, 2024 download; the founders published its history and renders two days later.

name: FutureFuer
description: Phosph0lipid founded FutureFuer, a DonFuer base. Max1mumChr1s contributed smaller builds including the Future-Village and Large Drain. The Archive dates the base’s establishment to April 25, 2023 and preserves a July 14 download.

name: Gatekeep
description: Beardler established Gatekeep in August 2024. Its builds included his bridge and church, with contributions from Spctre, Lazarus, Svenn Svenn, CARLWEEZER and Chikow. It was griefed on September 16, after which Beardler established Bethany. The Archive preserves a September 9 download. Sources give different establishment days, August 13 and August 15.

name: Geezer Town 10
description: FIRECATinBLACK built Geezer Town 10, also recorded as Geezer Town X. The Archive dates its establishment to April 15, 2024 and preserves a May 24 download.

name: Geezer Town 11
description: Geezer Town 11 is the eleventh numbered GrayBeard Geezers base, recorded as 'Geezer Town XI' in The Archive. The Archive snapshot and Mrc00ks' video overview were both published on July 12, 2024.

name: Geezer Town 12
description: STG__ built Geezer Town 12, the twelfth numbered base in the Graybeard Geezers series. The Archive dates its establishment to July 22, 2024 and preserves an August 9 download.

name: Geezer Town 1
description: CecilTheTurtle built Geezer Town 1, the first numbered base in the Graybeard Geezers series. The Archive dates its establishment to April 2023 and preserves an April 17 download.

name: Geezer Town 2
description: Geezer Town 2 is the second numbered base in the GrayBeard Geezers' recurring 2b2t series. The group is primarily a community for players over 30, with MuskWizard serving as a public point of contact. The Archive preserves a world-download snapshot dated May 30, 2023.

name: Geezer Town 5
description: Geezer Town 5 was a 2023 GrayBeard Geezers base. Max1mumChr1s joined the group through MuskWizard, began a floating-island house here, and signed the GT5 group map art before Outlast griefed the base. The Archive preserves a September 18, 2023 snapshot, and Dad Twoknee streamed a surviving tour the following day.

name: Geezer Town 6
description: Geezer Town 6 was the GrayBeard Geezers' first megabase and drew more than 80 contributors. Its builds included a large central canal and sky islands by Max1mumChr1s, who also helped recover surviving materials during the grief. Dad Twoknee streamed the base while Pidgeon30 preserved building and grief footage; The Archive's snapshot is dated November 12, 2023.

name: Geezer Town 7
description: The Archive labels this Graybeard Geezers site Geezer Town Seven and preserves a February 2, 2024 download near X -246,905, Z 143,309. Its listed establishment date is November 16, 2023. A separately preserved January capture is at different coordinates.

name: Geezer Town 8
description: Geezer Town 8 is the eighth numbered GrayBeard Geezers base, recorded as 'Geezer Town VIII' in The Archive. The preserved world-download snapshot is dated April 1, 2024.

name: Geezermanjaro
description: Geezermanjaro was a GrayBeard Geezers project associated with the group's wider run of 2023-2025 builds. Max1mumChr1s is documented as one of its builders, and The Archive preserves a world-download snapshot dated April 22, 2024.

name: Greengrad Industrial Outpost
description: Greengrad Industrial Outpost was a Communist Party of 2b2t base. The Archive dates its establishment to September 29, 2023 and preserves a November 26 download.

name: Haku Town
description: The Archive dates Haku Town’s establishment to September 27, 2023 and preserves a June 11, 2024 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Halloween Party Base 2023
description: This was the Backup Base on the 2b2t Party Committee and Spawn Builders Association’s 2023 trick-or-treat route. The Archive dates its establishment to October 18 and preserves an October 28 download. The organizers’ recap places the venue near X 35,160, Z -25,940.

name: Hallstatt
description: Hallstatt, also called Camp Fuzzy, was an Astral Brotherhood recruit base founded and run by FuzzyBiskits. The Archive dates its establishment to February 24, 2023 and preserves a July 1 download. The group published footage of its self-grief the following day.

name: Hexverse
description: Hexverse was an Astral Brotherhood mid-rank base featured in the group’s 2023 retrospective. The Archive dates its establishment to April 14, 2023 and preserves an August 26 download.

name: Hobbiton
description: Hobbiton was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to April 28, 2024 and preserves a June 23 download. It is listed among Outlast’s griefs in the group’s history.

name: Inception
description: Inception was a base of The Collective. The Archive dates its establishment to March 1, 2023 and preserves a March 14 download.

name: Italica
description: Italica was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to May 30, 2023 and preserves a July 26 download.

name: Jellyfish Space Station 1
description: Jellyfish Space Station 1 was a Cool Dudes base in the End. The Archive dates its establishment to January 3, 2024 and preserves a January 15 download.

name: Lorq Fortress
description: IKhanBuildThat2 built Lorq Fortress as a Vortex Coalition base. The Archive dates its establishment to June 3, 2019 and preserves a July 27 download.

name: Lumire
description: Lumire was an Astral Brotherhood base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 19, 2024 and preserves a May 4 download.

name: Lumos Isles
description: Lumos Isles was an Afterdawn base. The Archive dates its establishment to February 2023 and preserves a September 11 download.

name: Majora's End Oasis
description: Majora’s End Oasis was a Spawn Builders Association base near the End’s negative-X world border. The Archive dates its establishment to April 2024 and preserves a May 26 download.

name: Mars Base Alpha
description: Mars Base Alpha was near X -4.98 million, Z 4.83 million. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2023 and preserves an April 21, 2024 download; its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: MelonDew Valley
description: a1fastyellowgto built MelonDew Valley near spawn. The Archive dates its establishment to July 3, 2020 and preserves a July 24, 2023 download.

name: Meowcatraz
description: Meowcatraz was a Cult of Mer base. The Archive dates its establishment to September 23, 2023 and preserves a November 5 download.

name: MooMoo Cowtown
description: MooMoo Cowtown was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to December 19, 2023 and preserves a May 19, 2024 download.

name: MrFox178's Base
description: MrFox178 built this base, established in December 2023 according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 16, 2024.

name: Mushroom Base (Blizzen)
description: Blizzen built this Mushroom Base, established in May 2021 according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated August 10, 2021. It is separate from mrking039’s earlier Mushroom Base.

name: NasFuer 3
description: NasFuer 3 was an Imperial Empire base, according to the Archive. The catalog dates its establishment to March 2023 and preserves a September 6 download.

name: New Menegroth
description: New Menegroth was the Astral Brotherhood’s main base after Dubrovnik, founded on April 29, 2023 by Joey_Coconut, LordGalvatronMC and smcz19. Its connected builds filled a windswept savanna with bridges, aqueducts, waterwheels and a dam. Rivendell-inspired architecture combined steampunk details with prismarine foundations, pale walls and purpur roofs. After the base was discovered and its images circulated, members finished remaining work and self-griefed on June 18, the date of the Archive’s preserved download.

name: New NFE
description: This is the 2025 rebuild of New NFE, whose original establishment is listed as 2014 in the Archive. The preserved download is dated March 11, 2025.

name: New Sodom
description: MagnumRat built New Sodom. The Archive dates its establishment to June 11, 2020 and preserves a July 30, 2022 download. Blizzen’s linked flyover documents a later visit on August 20, 2024.

name: NewLoo
description: NewLoo, also called the Valley of Toilets, was a SpawnMasons base built by Breithan. The Archive dates its establishment to January 18, 2023 and preserves a February 27, 2024 download.

name: Noringtontownship 3
description: Noringtontownship 3 was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 29, 2023 and preserves a November 24 download.

name: NSO 7
description: SurgicalDonut built NSO 7. The Archive dates its establishment to December 2023 and preserves an April 26, 2024 download.

name: Nuketown Hide N Seek
description: BryceDey and Yamez built a recreation of Call of Duty’s Nuketown for a hide-and-seek event involving Spawn Builders Association and Vapepens Elite Alliance players. The Archive preserves a September 18, 2024 download. Sources differ on the build’s start: the Archive lists July 27, while BryceDey’s history describes it in June.

name: Obsidian Taj Mahal
description: The Obsidian Taj Mahal was near Overworld Z 8,500. The Archive dates its establishment to August 2023 and preserves an August 9 download; it does not name the builders.

name: Oceanix City
description: FIRECATinBLACK built Oceanix City as a Graybeard Geezers base. The Archive dates its establishment to January 26, 2024 and preserves an April 3 download.

name: Oceans 21
description: Blizzen built Oceans 21. The Archive dates its establishment to April 8, 2022 and preserves a May 16, 2023 download. The linked exploration video was published in 2025 and should not be treated as footage from the download date.

name: Odyssea
description: Odyssea was an Astral Brotherhood mid-rank base featured in the group’s 2023 retrospective. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2, 2023 and preserves an April 2 download.

name: Olmeccan Paradise
description: Blizzen built Olmeccan Paradise. The Archive dates its establishment to August 23, 2021 and preserves an April 7, 2022 download.

name: Orange Town
description: LILPEPPU built Orange Town. The Archive dates its establishment to April 5, 2023 and preserves a July 1 download.

name: Oremonger's Savannah Base
description: OreMonger’s Savannah Base was also known as his fourth base. The Archive dates its establishment to February 15, 2015 and preserves a June 1 download. It is distinct from his earlier Mesa Base with KingSplash.

name: Outlast 1 Year Event
description: This Outlast first-anniversary event was held in the End. The Archive dates its establishment to March 23, 2024 and preserves a March 24 download.

name: Outlast Christmas Event 2023
description: Outlast held this Christmas event in the End in December 2023. The Archive preserves a December 20 download.

name: Outlast Spawnbase 2
description: Outlast’s second spawnbase used a black-and-white palette, including obsidian roofs, stone-brick walls and quartz details. It was destroyed by CuppyK shortly after construction began. The Archive dates its establishment to June 19, 2023 and preserves a June 25 download.

name: Outlast Spawnbase 3
description: Outlast’s third spawnbase used a green theme, with gardens and green roofs. It lasted about five months before its members self-griefed it. The Archive dates its establishment to July 20, 2023 and preserves a December 28 download.

name: Outlast Spawnbase
description: Outlast’s first spawnbase centered on a large obsidian basilica designed by Nigerianprince and built with KILLAQUEEN123. Nasder and Nigerianprince also built an enormous obsidian OUTLAST sign overhead. The Archive dates the base’s establishment to March 21, 2023 and preserves a May 6 download.

name: Pandora
description: The Archive dates Pandora’s establishment to August 27, 2022 and preserves a December 31, 2023 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Point Meme
description: Point Meme was near the positive-X world border, at approximately X 29.99 million, Z 413,000. The Archive dates its establishment to November 20, 2021 and preserves a June 30, 2022 download.

name: Poptopia
description: _ItsPapa_ built Poptopia. The Archive dates its establishment to June 19, 2023 and preserves a July 16 download.

name: Portillo's
description: EMRusto built Portillo’s as a Watchmen base. The Archive preserves a May 12, 2021 download; its establishment field contains an invalid day (March 42), so the exact founding date is unconfirmed.

name: Posston
description: Posston was a Vapepens Elite Alliance base established on July 19, 2024, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated September 22.

name: Random's Secret Hideout
description: The Archive dates Random’s Secret Hideout’s establishment to February 25, 2019 and preserves a March 27, 2020 download.

name: Redcastle
description: Redcastle was a DonFuer spawn base with contributions from Vapepens Elite Alliance builders, including Max1mumChr1s. The Archive dates its establishment to March 15, 2024 and preserves a May 4 download. Builder showcases published that May document the base; it is distinct from an earlier Imperial build also called Red Castle.

name: Respawn Base
description: The Archive dates Respawn Base’s establishment to January 2024 and preserves a February 15 download.

name: Skyrim: Riften
description: This is the Riften site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. It is separate from the Imperial Empire recruit base named Riften.

name: Riga
description: Centauri started Riga as an Astral Brotherhood recruit base with an east-meets-west European theme. Western-style cathedrals and rowhouses stood alongside eastern-style block houses and monuments. The group also drained an ocean monument and built an autofarm platform during the base’s 12 days before it was griefed. The Archive dates its establishment to August 13, 2024 and preserves an August 25 download.

name: Romenna
description: Clink_clank built Romenna. The Archive dates its establishment to July 3, 2020 and preserves a June 23, 2024 download.

name: Schizo Clits
description: This base was on test.2b2t.org during the September 2019 test period, rather than the permanent 2b2t world. The Archive preserves a September 7 download.

name: Shroomtown II
description: The Archive dates Shroomtown II’s establishment to June 23, 2023 and preserves a January 5, 2024 download. It also offers a separately labeled concept-build exhibit at the same coordinates; that design version should not be confused with the live-server capture.

name: Skyrim: Dark Brotherhood
description: This is the Dark Brotherhood site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: Dawnstar
description: This is the Dawnstar site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: Falkreth
description: This is the Falkreth site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: Farmhouse Stash
description: This is the Farmhouse stash site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: Goldenglow Estate
description: This is the Goldenglow Estate site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: High Hrothgar
description: This is the High Hrothgar site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: Riverwood
description: This is the Riverwood site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Skyrim: Windhelm
description: This is the Windhelm ruins site in the Archive’s Skyrim complex, near X -1,206,000, Z 15,000. The preserved download is dated March 28, 2023. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Slootland
description: Slootland was a Vapepens Elite Alliance recruit base established on June 15, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 19.

name: Solera
description: Solera was an Astral Brotherhood base. The Archive lists its establishment as June 21, 2024; its current warp is labeled July 8, 2024.

name: Space Avalonia
description: Space Avalonia was an End base established on May 25, 2021, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 28, 2024.

name: Space Crusaders
description: Space Crusaders was a Last Templar base established on March 4, 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 2, 2024.

name: Spectrum Builder's Base
description: This Spectrum Builders base was established in January 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated September 6, 2024.

name: Stalpo Street
description: Stalpo Street was a Vapepens Elite Alliance base established on February 11, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated May 19.

name: SteamFuer
description: SteamFuer was a DonFuer base established on May 2, 2023, according to the Archive. Max1mumChr1s built a large Unga Bunga statue there. The preserved download is dated June 17.

name: Stinky's Skybase
description: The Archive records this site as stankerz’s skybase, also called Unnamed base. It was established in May 2018, and the preserved download is dated August 23, 2019.

name: Summerland
description: The Archive dates Summerland’s establishment to May 20, 2019 and preserves a June 10, 2023 download.

name: Sunshroom
description: Sunshroom was a Sun Knights base established on May 22, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 15.

name: Sunzy Castle
description: Sunzy Castle was a Sun Knights base for highly trusted members, established in November 2022. It was later leaked and griefed. The Archive preserves a May 1, 2023 download.

name: Super Base
description: The Archive dates Super Base’s establishment to May 1, 2023 and preserves a July 19, 2024 download.

name: Thalassa
description: Thalassa was a SpawnMasons base established in August 2023, according to the Archive. Nasder’s portfolio identifies his Octopus Gardens, inspired by the Beatles, as a build there. The preserved download is dated July 6, 2024.

name: The 2b2t Museum
description: Franknificant led The 2b2t Museum, a project using books, banners and mapart to document the server’s history. After two earlier sites were compromised, the final museum was established on January 5, 2023 and completed on September 9. Its building recreated St. Peter’s Basilica with an obsidian core and included statues of 64 players. The Archive preserves an October 1 download from before the October 4 destruction. This was an in-world 2b2t build, separate from the museum archive server.

name: The Dark Mirror
description: DonFuer built The Dark Mirror inside Kallie’s Gape, the enormous hole world-edited by iTristan in 2015. D_loaded designed its inverted domes, and Darkomier performed much of the construction with other DonFuer builders. The project was completed on April 30, 2023 and named in Darkomier’s honor. The Archive preserves a download from that date, before its reported destruction in July.

name: The Drained Bermuda
description: The Drained Bermuda was an Espionage base established on April 26, 2021, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 9, 2023.

name: The Halo
description: The Halo marks the Southern Canal’s 550,000-block milestone. Max1mumChr1s and Phosph0lipid built it while working with the WaterWay Union. The Archive dates its establishment to July 13, 2023 and preserves a July 23 download.

name: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon
description: Jeses built The Hanging Gardens of Babylon as a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to February 28, 2024 and preserves a September 23 download.

name: The Hidden Vale
description: Max1mumChr1s and boojr founded The Hidden Vale on December 15, 2023. Inspired by Boedecken and their Constantiam base The Vale, they developed an underground settlement with a forge and dragon head, meadow, hanging islands and iron chains. Jalapeno built a town above it, while TorturedCosine added farms. The Archive preserves a September 5, 2024 download.

name: The Invisible Castle
description: The Invisible Castle began as an unknown player’s base around June 2011 and was rediscovered by Courier6 in 2020. The Invisible Knights, later renamed Vapepens Elite Alliance, added new builds in 2022, including a Jesus statue and Eiffel Tower. The Archive’s September 5, 2022 establishment date refers to this later continuation above the old base; its preserved download is dated November 18. The original castle was reported destroyed in March 2023.

name: The Isle
description: SpawnMason base in the End. The Atlas also lists individual lodges here: Opera Lodge, Hatch Lodge, Phoenix Fortress, Escaping from Sky to our New Home, and Time is Running Out. Their Archive warps lead to different points around the base; the currently available lodge WDLs and renders include this shared surrounding area.

name: The Last Templar
description: The Last Templar was an exclusive building group founded by King_Aurelius, GenderPretender, and ForRussia. The group was well-known for their bases Argonath and New Argonath. They were also known for their 10k highway monuments. The group tended to avoid griefing.

name: The Library of Wan Shi Tong
description: The Library of Wan Shi Tong was built by Negative_Entropy, Jumbo_Warrior, Tanaxis and Todarac, according to the Archive. Inspired by Avatar: The Last Airbender, Negative_Entropy designed the library as a large storage facility and published its design on Planet Minecraft. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2018 and preserves a December 1, 2020 download.

renders.name: The Library of Wan Shi Tong

name: The Lowlands
description: The Lowlands was a Communist Party of 2b2t base established on December 23, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated March 6, 2024.

name: The Oracle
description: Nebikanezer built The Oracle. The Archive dates its establishment to December 2019 and preserves a December 18, 2022 download.

name: Ullr
description: Ullr was an Imperial Empire recruit base founded by Borrelli, with a medieval theme and extensive building by LordLao. Nuktameron built a house and early farms. The Archive dates its establishment to October 27, 2023 and preserves a November 13 download; the group’s own history instead lists November 13 as its starting date.

name: UnNamed Base
description: KingDedeDONG and LaziestToast built this unnamed base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 15, 2022 and preserves a December 16, 2023 download.

name: Uriel Town
description: The Archive records this site as Uriel Town 2.0, established on December 4, 2023. Its preserved download is dated January 28, 2024.

name: USA
description: USA was a Vapepens Elite Alliance main base established on October 6, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 7, 2024.

name: Vape Birthday
description: This Vapepens Elite Alliance birthday venue is recorded as Vape birthday v2. The Archive dates it to October 2024 and preserves an October 7 download.

name: Ven's Village
description: Ven’s Village was a Vapepens Elite Alliance base established on July 1, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated July 26.

name: Vesta
description: Vesta was an Astral Brotherhood main base with contributions from more than 40 builders. Its builds included the Lidenbrock Dome, Green Town, Enchoseon’s underground Blue Town, Warske’s Abbey, a vineyard, KommunistKuba and Nasder’s cathedral, and RyeGamess’s Dun Brese. The group’s showcase documents work from August 2023 to July 2024. The Archive dates the base’s establishment to July 27, 2023 and preserves a July 18, 2024 download.

name: Vivifica Township
description: Paragon and NickoMode built Vivifica Township, according to the Archive. It was established in July 2020, and the preserved download is dated July 11, 2024.

name: VLC Media Player Connect 4 Arena
description: The Astral Brotherhood used this End arena for a Connect 4 event. The Archive dates the venue to April 2024 and preserves an April 7 download.

name: Vocitare
description: Vocitare, also known as Vouchbase 2, was an Astral Brotherhood base established on January 2, 2024, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 12. It is separate from the original Vouchbase.

name: Vouchbase
description: Vouchbase was an Astral Brotherhood base established on October 27, 2023, according to the Archive. It included EddyNoChong’s Asahi Beerland, featured in the group’s Gang Alcohol showcase. The January 12, 2024 download predates the group’s published self-grief video. Vocitare, also called Vouchbase 2, was a separate successor base.

name: WaterLoo
description: Waterloo is also known as Bored Base. The Archive’s two differently named warps lead to the same coordinates and both refer to the July 2, 2018 download.

name: Waternoose
description: Waternoose was an Infinity Incursion base built by jumboman32 and BachiBachBach, according to the Archive. It was established on November 16, 2020, and the preserved download is dated February 19, 2024.

name: Wild Faerie Valley
description: Kahszzear built Wild Faerie Valley, established on November 1, 2017 according to the Archive. Its download is labeled July 25, 2022, but the catalog explicitly notes a signboard from June 22, 2024; the preserved exhibit therefore includes material from more than one date.

name: Willow Place
description: The Archive dates Willow Place’s establishment to August 2024 and preserves a September 16 download.

name: Wingston V

Linked islands housed builds including Warske’s Ostankino Tower and an industrial area developed with Nasder, Blaksaber, Yomilo and other builders. The Archive dates its establishment to May 21, 2023 and preserves a July 19 download. It is distinct from Wingston VI.

name: Yellow Castle

name: Kingdom Project

name: Barren Dome's HISP
description: BarrenDome’s Hovering Inverted Sand Pyramid, or H.I.S.P., is a suspended inverted pyramid made of sand. The Archive records construction from March 13 to March 22, 2017 and preserves a February 25, 2020 download. BarrenDome documented the project in his H.I.S.P. video.

name: X-Topia

name: South Canal Terminal

name: The Keeps
description: The Archive dates The Keeps’ establishment to early 2020 and preserves a May 6, 2021 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Fort Astral
description: LordGalvatronMC established Fort Astral as an Astral Order outpost and invited active members from an earlier repair project. The outpost was gradually abandoned as the group became inactive. The Archive dates its establishment to February 25, 2019 and preserves a March 6, 2021 download.

name: Purgatory
description: Purgatory was Builders Haven’s first temporary base, begun in May 2018. An underground duplication stash grew into a collection of builds, storage rooms and villager farms. It was destroyed on June 1, shortly after the Archive’s May 31 preserved version, and members moved to Purgatory II.

name: Halicarnassus
description: Halicarnassus was an independent base beyond one million blocks, occupied by builders from Crimson, Shortbus Caliphate and later Astral Brotherhood. Founded in December 2020, it served as a long-term base and shared storage site. Its builds included I_tri’s desert towers and Steampunkjax’s Parthenon temple. After its coordinates were leaked, the residents chose to destroy it on October 22, 2021. The Archive preserves a download with that date. Sources disagree on the precise December founding day.

name: Menegroth
description: Menegroth was Astral Brotherhood’s first Lunarium base, founded by Joey_Coconut and LordGalvatronMC in September 2021. A97J, smcz19, bread_loafs and the founders were among its active builders. The base was destroyed in October, prompting members to abandon other compromised sites. The Archive records establishment on September 11, a download on October 13 and abandonment on October 22. This is separate from New Menegroth, founded in 2023.

name: Crapville

name: Aqua Island

name: Mawchester

name: Maggie's Farm II

name: Indus Deep

name: The Lost Base
description: Davinch built The Lost Base. The Archive dates its establishment to November 2019 and preserves a March 19, 2021 download.

name: Underground Pyramid Sanctuary
description: The Archive dates Underground Pyramid Sanctuary’s establishment to July 7, 2018 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of that year. The entry does not identify its builders.

name: Fenrir
description:
Fenrir was a base founded by Sato86 and Pyrobyte that was notable for bringing Valkyria and the Gape Group together.

Fenrir was founded by Sato86 and Pyrobyte after the original Valkyria was griefed. Soon after this, 2b2t began having some major lag issues, and many players moved over to 3b3t for a while to escape the lag. It was on 3b3t that Sato and Pyrobyte met up with members of the Gape Group, including James_Rustles and Caleesii, and founded Nova. After most of the lag issues were resolved on 2b2t, many members of the Gape group traveled to Fenrir and began building there. The base continued to expand until March of 2015, when Sato announced that everyone still at Fenrir should move to the next major Valkyrian base, Asgard II. The base was abandoned, and was lightly griefed over the next few years by various players. In mid 2019, Miggers and LordPopcwrn heavily griefed the base, which, at that point, was still relatively intact.

Sato’s only major build at Fenrir was the large fortress by the ocean, which contained a white tree at the top. There were no real guidelines for what to build at the base, but many players ended up making extensive use of spruce wood, as it was readily available. Coconut4 built a replica of the Eiffel Tower out of brown wool, which was eventually struck by lightning and burned down. Just like the original Valkyria, this base had a replica of the Spawn Beacon from the Second Incursion. Pyrobyte built a lighthouse, Caleesii built the structure that housed the member board and an underground crop farm, and ftsqr built a large, detailed house out of spruce wood and cobblestone. Other builds included a large clock tower, a gold farm, and the Fenrir Inn.

name: Purgatory II
description: Purgatory II was a temporary Builders Haven base overseen by Jonathan222 and Beardler. Built between June 1 and June 16, 2018, it combined many builders’ styles with a town, quarry, mapart, games and a Valley of Wheat memorial. The Archive preserves a June 15 download, one day before its destruction in the aftermath of the BoeMeccan Witch Trials.

description: The Rainbow Islands were an early base built by Offtopia in late 2011. The existing historical video recounts the base’s destruction and the subsequent conflict with popbob. The current Archive command is /warp Rainbow_Islands_2011, labeled to the year 2011 without a month or day.

name: Death Star II
