description: DarkXL6 built this SpawnMasons fishing-event lodge for June 12, 2021. The Archive preserves a later download dated August 21, 2021; that label is not the original event date.

name: Uber Snow Base
description: The Archive dates Uber Snow Base to 2015 and preserves a January 24, 2018 download.

name: Omega City
description:
Omega City was built by the player called Caviyaz/Putin. It was among one of the biggest bases on 2b at the time.

Omega City was founded in early July 2016 by Caviyaz. The base used to be a small outpost for Caviyaz and his friends to stay at so they could be close to spawn. However, the base grew bigger and bigger and at some point, it became a proper base. After a few months, his friends left to build bases of there own, leaving Caviyaz with a whole base to himself. He started expanding and the idea of a group came to mind, a group that would not interfere with the general 2b2t community (nobody knows the group's name, but they are mostly referred to as "Omegans").

After a 6 month period of isolationism, Caviyaz invited the first outsider to the city. His name was mines and they met sometime before on The Lonely Island. After mines came to the city the place grew rapidly and some time later Caviyaz invited Enjoy and Niftyrobo.

Around may the city was fully terraformed and completely packed with housing and mega-builds. They ran out of land and had to start building into the ocean. Some notable buildings such as The Omega meeting hall, The Rainbow, The Statue of Liberty and the Cathedral were all built on this reclaimed land.

Elytras were enabled again in the middle of 2017, and due to the base being so close to spawn, some SpawnMasons found the base on accident (Hermeticlock, 0x22, and Babbaj). This wasn't much of an issue because there were several masons already at the base, and eventually Caviyaz would be made a mason. HermeticLock liked the place so much that he decided to stay and contribute to it.

On July 18, 2017, the city was destroyed by the players mrking039, CasualCocaine, and Pekee, who discovered the base via Elytra fly.

name: Sigma Pride
description: Sigma Pride was an Emperium base preserved in a May 29, 2019 Archive download.

name: World Traditional Farming Infrastructural Center
description: A public farm inspired by the Twin Towers in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

Krobar01 later led its development into a medieval castle base with farms and an underground area built by Yarnamite. Other residents included Joey_Coconut, terbin, Tanaxis, Banana, gigo and DocSmurf. The residents destroyed the base on June 16, 2021 after its location was exposed. This is distinct from the Kingdom of the New Order’s Whitehaven.

name: Spawnfuer 16

In 2017 its members built a separate decoy to mislead Fit, who destroyed the imitation in February 2018. This record is the real base, preserved in a May 20, 2019 Archive download before its destruction that summer. Media about the Viper Ruse depicts the decoy rather than this site throughout.

description: Endromeda was an End base built by Gsmack, SkullerG, Goujon, 4Pilot and Redbaron1991. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2020 and preserves a September 8 download.

name: Golden Hills

name: Yggdrasil
description: Yggdrasil grew around a guardian farm started by DocSmurf and Sugaha in January 2015. After the farm stopped working, Sicknessman and Daladev joined them in developing a giant tree suspended above an island, surrounded by a glass dome to protect it from lightning. The group gathered and smelted roughly 140,000 sand for the dome. Renewed activity exposed the base through the Nocom exploit in 2021, and the residents destroyed it on July 18. The Archive preserves a July 23, 2019 download of the earlier build.

name: Spook Base III
description: Spook Base III was an Infinity Incursion base. The Archive preserves an October 25, 2019 download. It is distinct from the Guardsmen’s Camp Spooky project of October 2020.

name: Lost Nomad Games II
description: The second Nomad Games used Franknificant’s Hagia Sophia as its main venue. The Lost Nomads also included Lunch_Katsu’s King of the Hill and Forceken’s snowball event. The site was griefed during the games; its later follow-up was called Nomad Games 2.5.

name: Cloudsdale
description:
Built by BottleCapBrony starting in 2016. Griefed in 2018 by jared 2013

BottlecapBrony initially gathered the white wool by breeding and shearing sheep, building a rainbow road and guest house around the towers. After the first destruction in December 2018, he rebuilt from screenshots and expanded the site with a meeting lodge, PvP arena, and an Etika memorial. The restored Cloudsdale was destroyed again in December 2019.

description: Purgatory IV, also known as Mesa Purgatory, was a Builders Haven temporary base founded in June 2018. Its builds included a quarry, Bloctagon’s futuristic tower, HawkedOnFonix’s house and an unfinished desert casino by 1Charlie3 and BigBat. After its destruction, members moved on to Exposition. Its numbering includes the short-lived Purgatory III at spawn.

name: Oblivion

name: Empire's Edge

After its coordinates were leaked on May 17, 2018, members evacuated their supplies and destroyed the base themselves.

name: The City of Alfheim
description: The City of Alfheim was a Backstreet Boys base founded on February 7, 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated September 22.

name: Zirilzuntir
description: Doctrzombie founded Zirilzuntir on September 6, 2017. The largely underground base included builds by 0xymoron, mmmmbeefy, Shaihulid, SilverXSnake, Crazyguy_123, Waaiayki, Wuzaam, Slappinbadkids, McNeo, wierdguy and MorbidRain. Following a dispute and coordinate leak, residents destroyed it on April 14, 2018. The Archive preserves an April 16 download.

name: Aureus City
description:
Aureus City was made over a year before the Rusher War, started on May 31st, 2015. The base was founded by CainesLaw and Tachrev and was the largest base of 2016. It was home to many midfags including Fit, James_Rustles, SnackyNorph, and 12 others. Aureus City was also known as the City of Gold due to the massive gold farm they had. The gold farm produced so much gold that they started decorating the city with gold.

Near Aureus was a temple which housed a barrier block.

Sometime during early 2015, Caines_Law and Tachrev's base, Exodus, was griefed. This left the two homeless until they joined the Valkyrians at Asgard II. When Asgard II was griefed, CainesLaw and Tachrev joined the rest of the Valkyrians in the Third Incursion. After the Incursion, the two needed a home and so Aureus City was founded. They eventually began to slowly invite other players to the base, many being their former Valkyrian comrades. Them and their new base members had planned for the city to be the greatest city in 2b2t history. The gold farm was built by Caines_Law, in which it produced tons of gold. This allowed for the members to create large amounts of golden apples before they were removed in the 1.9 update. Tachrev and Caines_Law allowed their residents to build their own houses which were all built to the player's desire.

The base had beautifully decorated streets that led to several parts of the city. The streets were lined with gold from the massive amounts of gold produce from the gold farm. The base also had a lot of decorative helixes around the base. On the streets of Aureus, there were several custom and unique homes built by each player. In the underground areas, the mines were decorated with large lava pillars surrounded by gold and the sea parts of base had large glass domes and entrances. The base, while not the largest redstone base, had a lot of redstone contraptions such as automated farms, sorters, and lights that would tell the players how full the chests were. The contraptions were mainly built by Yellowstonejoe and CainesLaw, who both had redstone experience. The base also had the original shelter of Tachrev and CainesLaw, which was a small cave dug out with an enchantment table, several chests, beds, crafting tables, furnaces, and an anvil. There was a Jack-O-Lantern from Halloween and an artificial island created to keep mooshrooms in by Monkey.

The Guardsmen later partially restored Aureus. DonFuer undertook a more extensive restoration in August 2022, with Darkomier and a1fastyellowgto among its principal builders. The Archive preserves both earlier versions and an August 8, 2022 rebuild; DonFuer’s credit here refers to that restoration rather than the original founding.

name: Valkyria
description:
During a temp map in April of 2013, Sato86 and the Black Flag Group (Pyrobyte, Drewbookman, and Angry_baby) met with hinderjd and his basemates from Hitlerwood (Coldwave, zach3397, and KnightVista). During the chaos that was the temp map, Sato proposed the creation of a new base by both groups. After deciding on a location, the two groups began constructing the base. Multiple names were kicked around for a while, including The Facepunch Reich and Niggertown, before Sato finally decided on a name; Valkyria, inspired by the angels of Norse mythology that transported dying warriors to the afterlife.

As time went on, more and more players joined the base and it became the largest group base on the server at the time. However, ever since an abandoned base known as “The Reich” was found only a few thousand blocks from Valkyria, many of the members were worried that the existence of Valkyria could be uncovered, and took extra precautions to cover their tracks when travelling to and from the base.

After kinorana, a new member of Valkyria, had pranked the base members by taking a world download of the base and griefing it, then showing screenshots of this world download to the base members, Sato began to have second thoughts about inviting him, although he did forgive Kino after he apologized. This all changed when Kino taught the members of Valkyria how to dupe, and the future of the base looked bright. However, a rivalry began between Kino and Drew, who grew more distant from Sato and Pyrobyte as they became better friends with Kino. Drew also began acting strange, and he set random parts of the base on fire and blamed it on lightning on three separate occasions, despite the fact that the damage was too great to be from a lightning strike, which would have quickly been put out by the rain. Drew was also accused of stealing a set of armor. Despite these incidents, Sato still trusted Drew because he was the first basemate Sato ever had on 2b2t, and they had been through a lot together.

Soon after this, the First Incursion was started by members of Valkyria, and they organized 2k2k as a sort of meetup spot. While there, they met a player named trodam, who didn’t try to attack them. Drew instantly attacked and killed him, burning his stuff on the spot. After this incident, Sato had finally had enough, and Drew left the group. The Valkyrians created a small farm at 2k2k with a beacon and logged out. Soon afterwards, a player named BAHSAHKAH killed trodam and stole the beacon. Sato logged on and, along with Pyro, chased BAHSAHKAH into the nether, but he escaped. Later, after Pyro had logged out, BAHSAHKAH returned and fought Sato, who lost the fight partially due to a bad internet connection. Despite losing, Sato still considered this to be an “enjoyable fight”. As it turned out, BAHSAHKAH was the alt of Jacktherippa, who soon became friends with Sato.

After the First Incursion ended, Sato returned to Anatolia to expand the base. While Sato was away, Drew spawned five withers at Valkyria and used TNT to grief more of the base. Coldwave and hinderjd, who were still at Valkyria, killed four of the withers and tried to figure out who was responsible. Sato instantly suspected that Drew was the culprit, and talked to him in chat. Drew told Sato that he wanted to spread paranoia among the members of Valkyria and cause them to split up, returning the balance of power on the server to “the way it was before''. Drew had made a grave mistake, however; he had given his coordinates to hinderjd before confessing. Hinder, Coldwave and Zach tracked Drew down to his dupe stash and killed him while burning down the stash. Later, Sato returned to Valkyria and, in a moment of anger, killed the final wither that Drew had spawned at the base and used its nether star to craft a beacon that he left at the ruins. Sato never thought that he would return to the site of Valkyria again after this.

name: Medina
description: Medina was the Fourth Incursion base, established by Byrnsy in 2016 according to the Archive. The preserved download is labeled 2016.

name: CampSite
description: CampSite was Highland’s underground spawn base. The Archive dates its establishment to September 19, 2017 and preserves an October 23 download.

name: Wässrige Hölle Zwei
description: Wässrige Hölle Zwei (Watery Hell Two) was a Nether base built around water, a normally unavailable resource in that dimension. Members included LordKai1, FamilyPumpkin6, DarkXL6, Courier6, Nekramite, TheAlphaEpsilon and Phi. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2020 and preserves a September 14 download. In a January 2021 memorial post, DarkXL6 reported that it had lasted about a year before being destroyed. It was distinct from the short-lived first Wässrige Hölle in 2019.

name: Beefytown
description: mmmmbeefy built Beefytown before the Astral Order existed. The Archive tentatively dates the original base to 2012 and preserves a July 31, 2016 download; other histories give later founding dates. In late 2018, LordKai1 began a restoration that became an Astral Order group project. That later restoration was griefed in December 2018.

name: 4th SpawnFuer
description: Spawnfuer 4 was a DonFuer base established on February 1, 2021, according to the Archive. The catalog records abandonment on March 12 and preserves a later September 11 download.

name: Uranos
description: The Archive dates Uranos’s establishment to May 29, 2020 and preserves a June 20, 2021 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Peaceful Islands II
description: The Archive dates Peaceful Islands II’s establishment to February 8, 2018 and preserves a May 23 download.

name: Vulcatavio
description: Vulcatavio was a SpawnMasons site preserved in a November 14, 2017 Archive download.

name: Boby's Bottom
description: Bobymicjohn's first base, preserved in a March 24, 2021 world download.

name: Lad Leuthil
description: songsayer built Lad Leuthil for The Emperium, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated August 7, 2019.

name: Asgard 2
description:
Asgard II was a base built by the remnants of Valkyria, the Legion, and others (or the "New Valkyrians" if you don't have the time) during the Second Valkyrian Period. It was the next project after Fenrir and it was a base that had a population of 30 players.

The leak of Asgard II's coords has been a convoluted and debated story. Many stories have been made speculating the destruction of Asgard II. Some people claim that OreMonger was responsible for the leaking due to an anonymous person with an alternate account handing him the the coords, who was suspected to be a spy at the base, others believe that it was leaked by Sato86 due to internal struggles between James_Rustles, xarviar, and many others at Asgard II, some believe there was an exploit used to find it, and many other stories of the like have been told. Controversial as the leak is, the news of the public leak caused the residents to panic, some fleeing, others blowing up parts of the base so that no one could claim to have destroyed the base.

On August 25 of 2019, Fit claimed that the base coords where accidentally leaked by Pyrobyte (one of the builders), and that he hid it so well that almost no one found out.

The members were angered after the destruction of the base and initiated the Third Incursion, which began on April 29, 2015. This was two years after the founding of Valkyria, and it lasted through the whole month of May, in revenge for the destroyed base. After the Incursion, Valkyria eventually began to dissolve and eventually disbanded. Some members of Asgard II went on to found other bases, the most notable of which being Aureus City.

name: Hitchhiker's Deep Thought
description: Scriblefoxx and Negative_Entropy built Hitchhiker’s Deep Thought for a SpawnMasons lodge recorded by the Archive under October 19, 2019.

name: Profectus
description: Geometrik established Profectus in 2017, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated July 1.

name: Eldorado
description: Eldorado was a massive build project created be Leuphou, where he covered an entire continent in various ore blocks, the majority being gold blocks. It was started on July 29th, 2019, and was griefed sometime in mid-January 2020.

name: Emperium Spawnbase
description: Emperium Spawnbase was an Emperium base preserved in a December 11, 2019 Archive download.

name: Argonath
description: Argonath was a Last Templar base established in 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated November 10.

name: SBA 23: Nether Edition
description: SBA 23: Nether Edition was a Spawn Builders Association base in the Nether, near X -3,844, Z -1,624. The Archive dates its establishment to February 2022 and preserves a February 18 download.

name: SBA 24
description: SBA 24 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to February 2022 and preserves a February 28 download.

name: Floating Multibiome
description: A floating plattform featuring a few different biomes

name: Jewtopia
description: The 4th Reich Gold Farm Base - Location of 4th Reich map

name: Cape Concord
description: ForgottenHarmony established Cape Concord on June 3, 2016 and abandoned it on September 9, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 10, 2018.

name: Lateott Fate Base
description: Lateott was a near-spawn base built by Fate for newer members in late 2020. After its coordinates leaked, residents destroyed the base themselves and moved on to Hyperfate. The Archive preserves a November 28, 2020 download.

name: Rhapsody Sky
description: ECKoonz built Rhapsody Sky. The Archive dates its establishment to September 14, 2019 and preserves a January 1, 2022 download.

name: Squid Game 2
description: Squid Game 2 was part of bobbers22’s series of Minecraft competitions inspired by the television show. The organizers expanded the event after its first edition, bringing in more participants and prizes; the Spawn Guardians community became the Squid Games community. The Archive credits the site to Spawn Guardians, dates its establishment to December 11, 2021 and preserves a January 4, 2022 download.

name: Oasis
description: Geometrik established Oasis in 2016, according to the Archive. Its dated download is labeled May 2017. It is distinct from the 2020 SpawnMasons lodge and the Nether Highway Group’s Oasis Outpost.

name: Western Air Temple
description: Negative_Entropy built the Western Air Temple for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under November 18, 2017. A later history of Boedecken recounts how showing this temple to CainesLaw led to Negative_Entropy being invited to that separate base.

name: Permafrost
description: Permafrost was an Infinity Incursion base. The Archive preserves a July 31, 2020 download.

name: Webzone 2
description: Webzone 2 was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2022 and preserves a January 24 download.

name: +X Nether World Border: The Terminus of Hell
description: _Smokescreen_ built the Terminus of Hell at the eastern Nether world border in early January 2022, according to the Archive. Also catalogued as Nether +X 30M Milestone, the site has Archive warps for February 15, 2022 and March 9, 2023 at this site. The site is near Nether X 30 million; the catalog’s X 240 million comparison is only a theoretical Overworld equivalent, beyond the normal Overworld border.

description: by x0XP

name: Beirut
description: Beirut was a Shortbus Caliphate base established in September 2020 after the short-lived Benghazi base. A map of the surrounding terrain exposed its location, after which it was destroyed. The Archive preserves an October 16, 2020 download.

name: Cum Zone 2
description: Cum Zone II was a Crimson Star base built in early October 2020 with Shortbus Caliphate participants and invited players from other groups. iAmZeiss built its gate and underground library; other features included a Nether portal, y_a_t_a’s church, an acacia district and a floating planet. It also supplied equipment for the Tenth Incursion. The Archive preserves an October 13 download, before the base’s destruction on October 15.

name: The Temple of The Void
description: Stone_Hammers built the Temple of the Void as the second base of The Order. The Archive records its completion on May 28, 2017 and preserves a January 20, 2018 download.

name: Beta Outpost
description: fixlumer established Beta Outpost on December 9, 2019, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated December 27.

name: Gape 1.0
description: Victor96 and other players began the original Gape excavation near spawn in early 2014. The project grew into a large pit with a castle-like fort, was attacked and later revived by a player using the name 2b2t. James_Rustles recounts taking part in the revival before another lavacast led the group to move on to Gape 2.0. The Archive preserves Gape 1.0 under September 10, 2014.

name: Point Pat
description: Point Pat was a Headpats4All base near spawn. It included three maparts and an underground museum of banners, maps and collected artifacts. Thirty-seven contributors helped create its signature map. The group’s history dates its founding to March 22, 2020; the Archive gives April 2 and preserves a May 29 download. The base was found and damaged during a livestream on June 27.

name: Ramark Base
description: A base featuring a Nether Void-Hole

name: 1 Million Town
description: 2012 base, griefed by Armorsmith

name: DonFuer 21
description: DonFuer 21 was a base built by DonFuer from February 10th, 2021, until its destruction on June 1st, 2021. It featured a variety of modern-themed builds and was primarily located on a mushroom island.

name: Farpoint 4
description: Farpoint 4 was built by pYrO1v1aniac, swimforce, Difinative and GeoGaming, according to the Archive. It was established in 2015, and the preserved download is dated January 18, 2017. pYrO1v1aniac’s published travel log provides contemporary context for the Farpoint bases.

name: The Homeland
description: The Homeland was the Guardsmen’s deliberately accessible base near spawn. After damage, members moved into adjacent biomes and continued building, gradually expanding the broader site. This record preserves the May 23, 2020 Archive download, from the early Mesa Homeland period.

name: End Portal
description: The 2b2t Wiki lists an End portal at these coordinates. This is a historical location reference; the portal’s current condition has not been verified.

name: Carilo City
description: Carilo City was one of the Republic’s large 2021 building projects. The Archive dates its establishment to August 3, 2021 and preserves a November 9 download.

name: Imperatoria 23
description: HenkieMC1 built Imperatoria 23 as an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2022 and preserves a February 15 download.

name: Shenandoah
description: jesse_number6 and EX0DlSS established Shenandoah in July 2013, according to the Archive. The underground base grew from shared rooms and supplies into a larger settlement with a castle, and became associated with the Legion of Shenandoah. The Archive also preserves a June 24, 2017 SpawnMasons lodge built at its ruins by _Henry_ and http_logan.

name: Imperial Recruit Base (2021)
description: This Imperial Empire recruit base was established in early 2021. The Archive preserves a March 31 download. It is separate from the group’s October 2022 recruit base.

name: Imperial City Project
description: Tursikas established Imperial City Project on January 24, 2017, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is labeled the fourth quarter of 2018; the Archive specifically notes that ruins on the eastern edge were not captured in that download.

name: Whitewatch II
description: Whitewatch II was an Emperium base preserved in a July 2, 2019 Archive download.

name: Paradise Island
description: The Archive tentatively dates Paradise Island to 2014 and preserves a January 3, 2016 download.

name: Epsilon
description: K3kistan established Epsilon in October 2016, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated August 31, 2017.

name: Sigma Camp
description: Sigma Camp was an Emperium base preserved in a September 23, 2019 Archive download.

name: Nova Satus
description: Nova Satus was an Emperium base preserved in a September 6, 2019 Archive download.

name: Maggie's Farm V
description: Mike_Embed built Maggie’s Farm V, tentatively dated by the Archive to 2017. Its preserved download is dated January 11, 2018.

name: New Argonath
description: New Argonath was the successor to Argonath, begun after the original base was found and destroyed in 2019. Aurelius and the other residents built around an elaborate cathedral, a group headquarters, and a memorial to the first base. SalC1's small house was the first structure; the great entrance arch was among the last. His account connects the base's eventual discovery to Nocom data and preserves views of the unfinished Founders Temple.

name: Nihongun Natsumatsuri
description: Natsumatsuri was a Nihongun base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 1, 2021 and preserves an August 12 download.

name: 6th Incursion Stronghold
description: This Sixth Incursion stronghold was on the temporary map used during the AntVenom period in April 2018. The Archive preserves an April 20 download. It is not the separately preserved main-map Incursion base.

name: +X, +Z Corner
description:
The south-east corner of the overworld.

The Motorway Extension Gurus' second elytra-friendly diagonal highway from SPAWN to WB (+X, +Z) was completed on the 4th of September, 2020. Similar to the -X, -Z highway, it took us 3,000 hours to dig. This marks a total of 6,000 hours of digging clocked in by the Motorway Extension Gurus. It should be noted that this number does not factor in the many many more hours spent organizing the logistics of this project by all involved.

It is with this dedication that a select handful of individuals on 2B2T are undertaking public infrastructure projects that are unlikely to have ever been initiated - and if begun, ever completed. For this reason, the individuals who have contributed to this project need be recognized.

This digging project was initiated on the 28th of May, 2020 by @harritaco, @KevinKC2014, and @Mr. Potato. This was no small feat; over three months, these individuals extended the 3 * 3 tunnel by approximately 37.5K nether (300K overworld equivalent), per day, for 100 consecutive days. Sizeable contributions were also made by @Max/5K5K, Paragon, and @Squirlboy006 during the mid-late stages of the dig, for which the team is grateful.

Milestones
+10M, +10M reached on 9th of July, 2020.
+20M, +20M reached on 13th of August, 2020.
+30M, +30M reached on 4th of September, 2020.

This location includes Overworld and Nether captures of the same highway stop. The Nether view is also known as +3.75m, +3.75m Nether Milestone, near X 3,749,965, Z 3,750,000. The Nether capture dated 2017-10-30 predates the 2020 MEG project described above; it is not evidence of that later construction.

name: Rapture I
description: Judge’s Group founded Rapture I on March 22, 2012 after losing 1 Million Base and several temporary settlements. Residents included THEJudgeHolden, willyroof, jdw99666, elocdrof, Rickenman, chrisleighton and Pylon55. A coordinate leak ended the base on April 21. The Archive preserves a January 7, 2017 download.

name: Rapture II
description: Rapture II was Judge’s Group’s underwater successor to Rapture I, built a few thousand blocks from the first base. The group’s history dates its founding to April 21, 2012 and destruction to May 7. The Archive instead lists March 22 as its establishment date and preserves a January 11, 2017 download.

name: Jerusalem
description: Mirek855 established Jerusalem on March 1, 2020, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 24. This site is separate from Block Game Jerusalem.

name: Empire's Larry
description: Empire’s Larry was an Emperium base preserved in a November 3, 2018 Archive download.

name: End Portal
description: Possible End Portal location

name: The Sea Spire
description: The Sea Spire was established in 2012, according to the Archive. Jacktherippa found it on November 22, 2015, then inhabited and expanded it. His museum of art occupies an area below the spire. The current Archive warp for the Sea Spire is labeled September 22, 2019.

name: Zenith Castle
description: Hausevult and Steve3 designed Zenith Castle, which Point Zenith members built in April 2019. The group used the pig godmode exploit while defending the castle against attacks.

name: R'Lyeh
description: ThePencilwriter built R’Lyeh for the Vortex Coalition in 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated September 20.

name: Lodge of Lodges
description: The Archive credits the Masons collectively with Lodge of Lodges and records it under October 16, 2021.

name: Canal Refuge Cast
description: Negative_Entropy, Raaanch and Nekramite built Canal Refuge Cast for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under October 23, 2021.

name: Little SMIB
description: Scriblefoxx built Little SMIB at Smibville for a SpawnMasons lodge recorded by the Archive under January 4, 2020.

name: Squid Games 3: Game 3
description: This was the third game of the third Squid Game event on 2b2t. bobbers22 organized the series; its third edition brought together builders including Hovecs, minecraft_simon, YoMoBoYo, Harrissssonn and xrayessay. The Archive preserves this section separately under March 6, 2022.

name: Toilet Spawnbase
description: Toilet Spawnbase was an Imperial Empire base. Its Archive entry has conflicting dates: establishment is listed as October 29, 2021, while the download is labeled August 30, 2021. The chronology remains unresolved.

name: Ireton
description: The Archive dates Ireton’s establishment to July 2016 and preserves a June 2, 2018 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Castle Greyskull
description: darthgremlin1701 built Castle Greyskull. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2017 and preserves a September 15, 2021 download.

name: 10th Don Fuer
description: DonFuer 10 was founded on December 11, 2016, with D_loaded, HermeticLock and Surviverkiller among its principal builders. It was destroyed after a coordinate leak in January 2017. Later rebuilding efforts culminated in a completed reconstruction in early 2021, largely by saznag and SkyIsWeird. The Archive preserves both the original January 10, 2017 download and the January 17, 2021 rebuild.

name: Popbob's Mesa base
description: Popbob built this mesa area at the Imperator’s Base. The Archive preserves a November 20, 2015 download.

name: Northern Air Temple
description: Negative_Entropy built the Northern Air Temple for the SpawnMasons. The Archive dates the original lodge to August 3, 2019, which is also the date in its current warp label.

name: Project Unity SGA Base
description: Project Unity restored a former main base of c1yd3i, where SilverKrownKing and Fit had also lived. The Archive dates the original site to January 2014 and preserves a November 4, 2017 download of the restoration.

name: Passies Castles
description: Passie built this collection of castles in 2014, according to the Archive. Its two preserved versions show the site on July 22 without the yellow castle and on October 4 with it.

name: Hand Farts' Safe Space
description: The Archive dates Hand Farts’ Safe Space to January 18, 2017 and preserves a June 13, 2018 download.

name: Base Nostalgia
description: The Archive’s November 28, 2020 Base Nostalgia download credits yata, kingoros, I_tri, Villagerfilms, soopa46, xcc2, overfloyd, frennn, HideXL, Joey_Coconut, oofcloof, Lunch_Katsu, PKstorm and bread_loafs. This is the 2020 base; it should not be confused with footage of the earlier 2015 Base Nostalgia.

name: H4A End Base
description: Headpats4All established this End base on July 7, 2020. Known as Swaglicously Pog End Base in the group’s history, it included the Dream No More mapart by Nr1Princess and NotConsentualsex. Activity declined after an elytra restriction in August. The Archive preserves an August 19 download.

name: -X, +Z Corner
description: This is the southwest Overworld world-border corner, near X -30,000,000 and Z 30,000,000. The Archive preserves a March 2, 2021 download of the developed corner.

name: Ymir
description: BenberinoLP built Ymir in late 2019, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated March 6, 2020.

name: The Dumps
description: mrking039, dae1250, FaithDaChav, SirGrassy, InfernoPickaxe and tommanis1 built The Dumps in November 2016, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated January 6, 2017; the base was abandoned the following month.

name: Lost Nomad Games III
description: The Lost Nomads built the third Nomad Games site about 50,000 blocks from spawn over a month. Contributors included Franknificant, Dawnfall_, Greenabi10, Smokescreen, Poyraz_Kaptain, walmart_security and WhiteRhino69. Builds included a miniature Space Valkyria III, TNT Run and the Nomad Center. The March 20, 2021 event ended early after its coordinates were leaked during a stream and griefers arrived. A later redux took place on a separate private server; further numbered Nomad Games followed.

name: Nihongun Spawnbase
description: This was Nihongun’s first spawn base, also cataloged as the Japanese Army First Base. The Archive dates its establishment to January 2021 and preserves a January 18 download. Nihongun was the building group founded by cityboss1 and UsadaJunichi.

name: Acheron
description: Acheron was Goodwill Trading’s base, founded in late 2016. It combined a medieval hub and harbor with personal rooms, farms, a villager trading hall and an ice-highway tunnel network. Automated duplication infrastructure supplied its large storage area. The base was destroyed on June 7, 2021, the date of the Archive’s preserved download.

name: Eagle's Rock III
description: Eagle’s Rock III was a Backstreet Boys base established on June 21, 2021, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated October 29. This third iteration is distinct from the earlier Astral Order and Backstreet Boys bases using the Eagle’s Rock name.

name: Astralia
description: Astralia began as a resource-gathering site for Menegroth builders and became an Astral Brotherhood group base intended to host a Halloween event. Enchoseon, crzychris, A97J, SCR3BALL7030 and Joey_Coconut were among its builders. Members self-griefed it after Menegroth was destroyed. The Archive dates its establishment to October 3, 2021 and preserves an October 22 download.

name: Wolf Den
description: Parthicus built Wolf Den in 2012, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 19, 2018.

name: Creeper Tower
description: DeadDreamer built Creeper Tower near spawn. The Archive preserves a January 27, 2013 download.

name: Camp Facepunch
description: Camp Facepunch was an early Facepunch Republic base near X 500, Z 42. Built in April 2011 for newly arrived Facepunch players, it consisted of cobblestone towers connected by walls. Its April 28 destruction during Greyskull’s Stand became an early episode of the Facepunch conflict. DeadDreamer restored it in 2012. The Archive preserves a February 23, 2013 download of the later site.

name: BoneSpire
description: BoneSpire was BarrenDome's remote island base, founded on March 11, 2017. It grew around nearby villages, an ocean monument, and mob spawners, with a Columbia statue, necromancer's castle, lighthouse, and ocean kraken among its builds. After HammerBeam fell, some of its residents moved supplies here. The site later served as a storage and travel hub. BarrenDome says he destroyed much of it himself after visitors discovered the base and emptied its stashes in May 2020.

name: BroBase
description: James_Rustles and ftsqr built BroBase, described by the Archive as a ROP base. It was established on May 10, 2015, and the preserved download is dated February 4, 2016.

name: Celebration of the King
description: VinegarPlaysMC and Twinklet0n built Celebration of the King. The Archive gives December 11, 2019 as a probable establishment date and preserves a July 31, 2021 download.

name: diGGing4gold's Base
description: The Archive preserves diGGing4gold’s base under 2018. Its catalog entry does not give a more precise capture or founding date.

name: La Capital
description: The first base built by The Republic - "The Capital" or "La Capital". It existed from 2017 until early 2018.

name: End Portal
description: The 2b2t Wiki lists an End portal at these coordinates. This is a historical location reference; the portal’s current condition has not been verified.

name: Big Cave
description: Big Cave hosted a SpawnMasons lodge recorded by the Archive under January 23, 2021.

name: Angler Catfish Flushed
description: Breithan built Angler Catfish Flushed for a SpawnMasons lodge. The Archive records it under February 6, 2021.

name: Acacia City
description: Acacia City’s recorded builders include BiigJuice, Coopseal, Entelegence, RocksbeCookin, T0_CR4ZY, TensiveWolf8599 and WutsMyName. The Archive dates its establishment to October 10, 2019 and preserves a November 12 download.

name: BranBase
description: The Archive preserves BranBase under January 16, 2018. Its catalog entry does not provide a founding date or additional builder credits.

name: Crystal Islands
description:
The Crystal Islands was a base constructed by Offtopia. It is notable for how long it managed to stay intact despite its proximity to spawn, as well as its role in the Fourth Incursion.

The Crystal Islands were founded by Offtopia and two unknown Australian players in October of 2012. At the time, the base was considered to be reasonably far away from spawn. The two Australian players didn’t have any hacks, so they created a large network of strip mining tunnels underneath the base to obtain resources. Offtopia would later invite CytotoxicTcell to the Crystal Islands, where she would stay for 3 to 4 months before taking a long hiatus from 2b2t. In mid 2013, Offtopia left to join other bases, and the Crystal Islands lay abandoned for years. In January 2016, Offtopia returned to the base and started new builds. He also invited Fit, who was at that time only a small YouTuber, to tour the base.

name: German Town
description: German Town was an area of the Imperator’s Base. The Archive preserves both the town and a separate viewpoint at JohnZoo’s house under November 20, 2015.

name: Swastika Base
description: The base was made out of many swastikas and nether portals, with the centerpiece being two pyramids (one was upside-down) that touched at their tops. Many of the swastikas were made out of unusual materials, such as lava and diamond blocks.

name: Wasted Tower
description: Janarchya and Paraschizophren built Wasted Tower on January 29, 2020, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated January 31.

name: Sniper's Peaceful Island
description: Sniper's Peaceful Island was a base started on April 3rd, 2017, by Sniper231996 and zexesl2. The base existed for about 8 months before being destroyed on January 16, 2018, and was inhabited by 13 players and many Valinor members (including Myne1001, ELVeng, Drachenstein, Sage_Mathias and pYr01v1aniac). It was griefed on January 16, 2018, by fr1kin, IamTUNA, and jared2013, and was later griefed again by former base member AutismBot/Slappnbadkids. There were 2 bases called 'Sniper's Peaceful Island' ever built, a first base, the 'Single Island,' which was unknowingly griefed by AutismBot (a base member of the second base) along with others.

name: Camp Wanabee
description: mattVTD built Camp Wanabee in August 2016, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is labeled 2017.

name: HermLand
description: HermeticLock built HermLand. The Archive preserves a November 13, 2017 download but does not supply an establishment date.

name: Monad Outpost
description: Monad Outpost was a Vortex Coalition farm, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: 11th Don Fuer
description: The eleventh DonFuer was established after the loss of DonFuer 10. It remained unfinished when HermeticLock left to start the World Famous Spawn Base. The Archive preserves a June 25, 2017 download.

name: The Lands
description:
The Lands of Norphs and Niggers, also known simply as The Lands, was a base founded by Jacktherippa. It lasted for years due to its distance from spawn.

After losing his End base due to the closing of the the End by Hausemaster to combat illegal portal use, Jacktherippa decided to travel out to X: -10000000, Z: -10000000 overworld using the Nether roof, which was enabled at the time. He got bored after about a week of travelling, however, and decided to stop at X: -4400000, Z: -4400000 and create a base.  

Jack created one of the server’s first beacon arrays at his new base shortly after the server updated to 1.4. He lived alone at this base for months until December 2012, when he was contacted by SnackyNorph, who had just lost his famous library and was now homeless. Snacky asked if he could join Jack at his new base, and Jack accepted. When Snacky arrived at the base, he brought ExaltedSpartan, xarviar, stupidwalrus and AWarGuy with him. Snacky would also give the base a name; “The Lands of Norphs and Niggers”, usually shortened to just “The Lands”. Due to the sheer amount of time it took to travel to the base, new arrivals came in waves. A second wave of players in October 2013 included kinorana, Branillon, Parthicus, thePOMPANO and fubster.

Over time, many of the residents of The Lands got bored and /killed their way back to spawn. One day, Jack was using a teleportation exploit known as STP, which ended up sending him to spawn and making him unable to return to The Lands. Soon afterwards, Jack joined the third incursion and, between the incursion and staying at Valkyria, didn’t return to The Lands for a while. When he did, he used an exploit to ride horses on the Nether roof, since the roof was now supposed to be inaccessible. Even with this exploit, it still took him four days of riding to reach The Lands again.

Many players visited The Lands over time, including xcc2, SilverKrownKing, CainesLaw, and OreMonger. TheCampingRusher was even given a tour of the base by jared2013 after it was griefed, but was killed by Jack part of the way through.

The base coordinates were made public by Hausemaster after accidentally posting them in chat. Popbob on with his alt RadicalHiccup (now RIDF) traveled to The Lands and attempted to grief it, but failed and logged out. The Tyranny claims that during the Bed Exploit, popbob logged on and completed the chain to teleport to The Lands. However, it is more likely that the boat fly exploit was used, as players could use it to travel under the Nether at very high speeds. iTristan, who was a member of the base, knew that jared and taylo were coming, but didn’t tell anybody. Taylo, using a 32k sword from Tristan’s stash, killed all the members of The Lands that tried to stop him as he and jared griefed the base.

name: MaxHolloway's Base
description: The Archive preserves MaxHolloway’s base under December 26, 2021 and dates its establishment to October 2021.

name: Minutemen Outpost #3
description: The Archive dates Minutemen Outpost #3’s establishment to December 2020 and preserves a January 14, 2021 download. Its catalog entry does not list individual builders.

name: Red Base
description: Red Base was an Astral Republic base established in April 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 27. The group’s history distinguishes Red Base from its other recruit base, Blue Base.

name: Mount Ardent
description: The Archive dates Mount Ardent’s establishment to late 2017 and preserves a May 22, 2019 download.

name: iTristan's Barrier-Stash
description: This was an iTristan base and stash where barrier blocks were reported. The Archive dates the base to August 2014 and says it did not last long. Its warp filename and menu label disagree on the preserved version’s date, so neither is treated here as a confirmed capture date.

name: The Evil Outpost I
description: Nr1Princess and whitelux built The Evil Outpost I in 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated January 7, 2021.

name: Space Valkyria III (first site)
description: Space Valkyria III's first 2b2t site was built in the End by Jack_therippa and collaborators beginning in 2017, near X 68,502 and Z -111,116. Jack_therippa later documented that two survival-server copies existed and both were eventually destroyed. The Atlas keeps the historical first-site capture here alongside a separately labeled completed-concept capture. That concept is the creator's single-player creative continuation, not a live 2b2t snapshot.

renders.name: Space Valkyria III (first site) - Singleplayer Concept

name: Pit Fight 7
description:
Pit Fight 7 was a lava-surrounded colosseum in the Nether, designed and built by Svenn_Svenn for Obscension’s Pit Crew. The November 20, 2021 event was interrupted by a server crash and postponed. The Archive preserves a November 19 download of the venue.

The 2b2t Wiki records no declared winner after the interruption.

name: Pit Fight 6
description:
Pit Fight 6 used an underground church with tunnels and canals as its PvP arena. Obscension held the Halloween-themed event on October 23, 2021. The Archive preserves the venue under October 20, before the tournament.

The 2b2t Wiki names Fiddlesticks98 as the winner, with a $100 first prize.

name: Genex Base
description: yunyi established Genex Base on September 29, 2016, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: Viking Summer Residence
description: Viking Summer Residence was an Imperator’s Group build. The Archive records abandonment on April 3, 2012 and preserves a later download labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: Wasted Skybase
description: Janarchya and Paraschizophren built Wasted Skybase. The Archive dates its establishment to early 2020 and preserves a download labeled February 2020.

name: Old Spawn Road
description: The old Spawn road is one of the oldest non axis roads on 2b2t built by LegitYarik  in 2014 and was griefed by Armorsmith in 2018 after he built the Wrath of Armorsmith at the beginning of the road.

name: Markarth City
description: A decent base mainly built by LillyoftheValley

name: Wild Emerald
description: Wild Emerald was an Invincibles base. The Archive dates its establishment to April 21, 2021 and preserves a May 17 download.

name: The Last Templar 3 Year Memorial
description: The Last Templar’s third-anniversary memorial stands on the positive Z Overworld highway near Z 10,000. It is one of the group’s series of large obsidian anniversary monuments on the main highways. The Archive preserves a May 18, 2021 download. The first-, fourth- and fifth-anniversary memorials are separate structures at other coordinates.

name: Krobar's Keep
description: Krobar01 built this keep at Follytonvilleshire. His build history identifies it among his early projects at that base.

name: Aqua Arce
description: TEST_robot built Aqua Arce. The Archive dates its establishment to June 29, 2021 and preserves a December 29 download.

name: Doriath
description: Doriath was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to November 2021 and preserves a November 27 download.

name: West Virginia
description: 7th Incursion Base

name: Imperator's Base (Jesus Statue)
description:
Imperator's Base, usually shortened to Imp's Base and also known as Viking Base and the Ungriefable Base, is one of the largest bases in 2b2t, built by Imperator's group in 2012. It was home to the most well known build on 2b2t, the Jesus Statue, and was griefed by jared2013 in 2015. You can download the base here.

Construction of the base began sometime around 2012. The base was named after ImperatorTerrae. When he arrived at the location, there were several people already living there in what is sometimes referred to as "Viking Base". Those living in Viking base were invited to join Imperator. Several well-known players such as Offtopia, omaliymix, THEJudgeHolden, CytotoxicTcell, xcc2, and LegitLobster were invited. Imperator's Base was at its height in power around 2013, after it had been discovered by the infamous griefer known as popbob. Imperator reasoned with popbob, providing him with an invitation to the base, which popbob accepted. because of this, Imperator's Base was dubbed, "The Ungriefable Base". The base was also known to have had an end portal, which hausemaster later removed.

By 2014, many of the inhabitants of Imp's had quit. The base's isolation made it difficult to recruit new players like iTristan and Branillon, who received invitations and had to use accounts already at Imperator's base.

name: Library of Babel
description: Jadestrouble built the Library of Babel. The Archive dates its establishment to September 1, 2020 and preserves an October 6 download.

name: Mokuzai Island
description: Prismary founded Mokuzai Island in May 2018 as a hermit project after a fresh escape from spawn. In the original showcase, he described gathering the building materials himself and later inviting visitors. The island subsequently hosted other players and an immortal end crystal. The Archive preserves a February 2, 2019 download, between the January fire and the later reconstruction described in its published history.

name: Thekneegar's Spawn Base
description: The Archive lists this early-2018 spawn base as tenderhart’s spawn base and preserves a February 26, 2018 download.

name: Ground Zero
description: FamilyPumpkin6 built Ground Zero in April 2020, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 26.

name: Christmas Tower (2019)
description: This Christmas Tower was built in December 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated December 28.

name: Thotsburg
description: The Society established Thotsburg in May 2018, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated July 9, 2019.

name: Sreeti's Temp Base
description: Twitch streamer with coords actively shown on screen

name: Chaos Clan Base
description: The Archive tentatively dates Chaos Clan Base to 2018 and preserves an April 24 download. The catalog does not provide individual builder names.

name: Eagle's Rock 2
description: Eagle’s Rock II was a Backstreet Boys base founded during the first pandemic lockdown in April 2020. It lasted about four months. The Archive gives an April 14 founding date and preserves an August 24 download. It is distinct from the Astral Order’s original Eagle’s Rock.

name: Endless Village
description: Endless Village was part of the Imperator’s Base, preserved in a November 20, 2015 Archive download.

name: 12th Don Fuer
description: DonFuer’s twelfth city was started in mid-June 2017. The Archive preserves a September 4 download, shortly before the base was destroyed following a coordinate leak that also exposed other DonFuer sites.

description: Possible End Portal location (Added after 1.19 update)
