description: Possible End Portal location (Added after 1.19 update)

name: Ventir Zeta
description: Ventir Zeta was an Emperium base, as credited in the Archive. Its current Archive warp is labeled December 31, 2019; the entry does not provide an establishment date.

name: End Portal
description: The 2b2t Wiki lists an End portal at these coordinates. This is a historical location reference; the portal’s current condition has not been verified.

name: Obsidian Labyrinth
description: The Guardsmen built this obsidian labyrinth near the Mesa Homeland for a Fight Club event. Elder guardians imposed Mining Fatigue on players inside, and a surrounding water cube helped protect the maze. The Archive dates the build to August 2020 and preserves an August 14 download.

name: Brotherhood II
description: The Archive dates Brotherhood II’s establishment to February 14, 2021 and preserves a May 16 download. The name alone does not establish an association with Astral Brotherhood, which formed later that year.

name: 12th SpawnFuer
description: Spawnfuer 12 was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to October 1, 2021 and preserves an October 9 download.

name: Princess Jessy's Palace
description: Sage_Mathias built Princess Jessy’s Palace as a solo base in January 2017. The Archive gives January 6 as its establishment date and preserves a January 26, 2018 download.

name: Jack's Personal 2b2t Museum of Art
description: Jack’s Personal 2b2t Museum of Art lies below the Sea Spire. The Archive dates its establishment to 2015. Its current warp is labeled December 17, 2016.

name: +X 15M Milestone
description:
This was a Nether Highway Group meeting point along the +X route to the world border, near Overworld X 15,000,000. The Archive preserves a December 20, 2017 download.

This location includes Overworld and Nether captures of the same highway stop. The Nether view is also known as Nether +X 1.875M Milestone, near X 1,874,980, Z 1. The Nether capture is dated 2017-05-07. The Overworld site was previously listed as 15 Million +X.

name: City of Helios
description: Razpaq built Helios, also known as the City of Helios, near spawn in 2014. Its buildings included a cathedral with stained-glass windows and surrounding houses. The site later became known for the August 7, 2016 duel between Fit and NedaT. Fit’s tour records its ruins.

name: Yucatan
description: mattvtd built Yucatan in May 2018, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated June 6, 2019.

name: SBA 11: Spoopy Town
description: Spoopy Town was SBA 11, the Spawn Builders Association’s first Halloween base. The Archive dates its establishment to October 24, 2021 and preserves an October download. The group’s history says it was griefed before Halloween.

name: SBA 14
description: SBA 14 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to November 10, 2021 and preserves a download labeled that month.

name: Solveig
description: Solveig was a Millennium base associated with Hit_The_Juul and used extensively for the donkey ice dupe. The Archive dates its establishment to February 15, 2020, while the group history gives February 2. Its preserved download is dated April 15, shortly before the April 17 attack on the group and the base’s destruction.

name: End Portal
description: An End portal near X 2,064, Z -4,400, listed at these coordinates in the 2b2t Wiki’s historical portal catalog. The listing does not establish its current condition on the live server.

name: Bender Base
description: Bender Base is a robot-themed build featuring a towering Bender from Futurama and an unfinished Iron Giant. Its smaller details include note-block instruments, a minecart circuit, and cactus barriers. In niko's tour, restoration volunteers describe trying to identify the original builder and explain that the Iron Giant was already unfinished in the preserved world download.

name: Mound Mk. I
description: JimmyTuesday built Mound Mk. I in early 2019, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated March 2.

name: Rapture III
description: Rapture III was a Nether base founded on August 14, 2016. Many residents came from Judge’s Group, although the group’s history distinguishes it from an official group project. The Archive preserves an October 10 download; the small-base history records its destruction before October 20.

name: The Incursion V Base
description: The temporary base made by the members of the 5th Incursion.

name: Exodus City
description: Pheanom established Exodus City in August 2016 and abandoned it that December. SmackAttack86 and tenderhart later found and expanded it, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated November 11, 2017. It is separate from CainesLaw and Tachrev’s 2015 Exodus.

name: Project Shiny
description:
Gold farm project, as part of the World Famous Spawn Base.

Its Overworld design used large Nether portals to produce zombie pigmen. BarrenDome's tour credits HermeticLock and the Gold Diggers with the project and demonstrates the mobs being directed into the collection area. The farm combined practical resource production with a conspicuous public build close to spawn.

name: North Haverbrook
description: North Haverbrook was wrrrtika’s base, established in 2016 or earlier according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated February 1, 2017.

name: Cloud City
description: HermeticLock built Cloud City near spawn. The Archive preserves a December 11, 2017 download. It is separate from Judge’s Group’s Old City.

name: Ararat
description: Ararat was a Guardsmen base preserved in a July 4, 2020 Archive download.

name: Taj Mahal
description: FreedomHolland and Maker02 built this Taj Mahal replica near Overworld X 15 million, Z -15 million. The Archive dates its establishment to January 26, 2022 and preserves a February 5 download.

name: 2b2t Times HQ
description: Franknificant and Forceken built the 2b2t Times headquarters for their in-game newspaper project. The site combined its mapart newspaper with automated sugarcane, cow and wheat farms supporting production. The Archive preserves a January 26, 2022 download. The newspaper’s history describes the headquarters being exposed and destroyed after the project’s February 2022 shutdown, then rebuilt later that year.

name: fr1kin's Mesa Base
description: The Archive dates fr1kin’s Mesa Base to early 2015 and preserves a January 7, 2016 download.

name: La Rosa
description: La Rosa was established in November 2015, according to the Archive. Recorded builders include Aryvas, berkbrein, C4RTM4N, H3atherRingt0n, HairyNugget, James_Rustles, LittleSu, Mbash, mrx, Sharpie, Spartan512, Thrax_Keyholder and UBERSLUGCAKE. The preserved download is dated August 5, 2016.

name: FSC: Hagia Sophia
description: Franknificant built Hagia Sophia as the fourth church in the Four Spawn Churches Project, assisted by Turkish players including Poyraz_Kaptan, 0yiqitozturk and gokberkimben. The recreation included an obsidian core and hosted the second Nomad Games. The Archive preserves a January 30, 2021 download.

name: Broxus
description: Dimek2 built Broxus, tentatively dated by the Archive to 2017. Its preserved download is dated December 22, 2018.

name: Bunker Badass
description: Vab_ito established Bunker Badass on November 24, 2019, according to the Archive. It was one of the New Facepunch Republic’s bases. The preserved download is dated December 6.

name: Smibville
description: ufocrossing founded Smibville for the SpawnMasons on May 20, 2019. The snowy base included the Smibadome, ice dragons, a snow village and many weekly lodges. It was destroyed in January 2020. The Archive preserves both server captures and a separately labeled concept version with some builds completed and mobs restored after the destruction; that concept is not an unchanged capture of the live base.

name: Victoria
description: mattvtd founded Victoria on February 14, 2018, later joined by SurvivalGamerQC, Toysoildier and DistantFoSho. The savanna town included a throne room, floating fountain, mushroom build and wheat-field windmill. The Archive preserves a November 23, 2019 download, two days before its destruction by jared2013.

name: Little Italy (2019)
description: This Little Italy was established in July 2019, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 10, 2020. It is separate from the similarly named November 2024 base.

name: 9k Mystery Tower
description: Gecko501 built 9k Mystery Tower in December 2015, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated January 12, 2016.

name: Melon Continent
description: A giant melon farm made across an entire landmass.

name: Lost Nomad Games 2.5
description: The Lost Nomads held Nomad Games 2.5 a week after their second games, collaborating with Oliversnowyowl’s 2b2t Wave Shop. The event ran to completion without the premature destruction that disrupted several other Nomad Games.

name: End Portal
description: The 2b2t Wiki lists an End portal at these coordinates. This is a historical location reference; the portal’s current condition has not been verified. The source marks this portal as broken or unlit.

name: vesko's End Portal Pyramid
description: EnigmA_008 built this End portal pyramid, cataloged under vesko’s name. The Archive dates construction from September 25 to October 10, 2021 and preserves an October 23 download.

name: HWU 1st Anniversary Event
description: This was the Highway Workers Union’s first-anniversary event site. The Archive dates its establishment to 2021 and preserves a September 11 download.

name: Dungeon at Rumeria
description: LordNo built Dungeon at Rumeria for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under June 26, 2021.

name: Redroom 19
description: EntropyAnnDroid built Redroom 19 for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under July 10, 2021.

name: Snow Town
description: Snow Town was a Judge’s Group base established in 2012, according to the Archive. Its preserved viewpoints include THEJudgeHolden’s tower. Residents included Offtopia, jdw99666 and other members of the group; the base experienced long periods of inactivity.

name: Mesa Mountain HQ
description: Tumorous built Mesa Mountain HQ. The Archive dates its establishment to August 1, 2016 and preserves a November 22, 2020 download.

name: Two Temples
description: E0P built Two Temples on June 23, 2016, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated January 16, 2018.

name: The Halls
description: A 2014 underground base. It has been griefed by mrking039.

name: Edark's Island
description: The Archive tentatively dates Edark’s Island to 2013, while explicitly distinguishing it from Edark’s separate 2013 base. Its preserved download is labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: Terror Island
description: Small island base discovered by JALILTERROR and Incredible Gravy in 2016.

name: Schloss Andecite
description: The Archive dates Schloss Andecite’s establishment to September 14, 2021 and preserves a January 25, 2022 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Spawnfuer 17
description: Spawnfuer 17 was a DonFuer base established on December 16, 2021, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated January 26, 2022. It is separate from Spawnfuer S7-a, a later DonFuer base at different coordinates.

name: Endcursion
description: While at Summermelon, Krobar01 was invited to Space Jam by other members of the Spawn Masons. The base fell before Krobar01 could build a meaningful amount, so he decided to move to a new spot, which he titled "Endcursion." Krobar01 abandoned the base after it was compromised by 0x22 with the Authentication Exploit.

name: 2close
description: 2close was a public spawn-base project of The Society. The Archive lists its establishment as February 20, 2019; its current warp is labeled March 2, 2019.

name: Hillville
description: The Society established Hillville on October 15, 2018, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated August 4, 2019.

name: Equilibrium
description:
Equilibrium was a base founded on September 20th 2016 by c3rv3z4. It was quickly discovered by the YouTuber Mines, who made a video about it.

c3rv3z4 initially recruited mainly German 2b2t Players, the first ones being Fabustra and Prismary.

Over time more and more players were invited, until the base was griefed on the first of June by jared2013 as the last base in his 31days31griefs month of destruction.

name: Uganda
description: ornom0n built Uganda in 2012, according to the Archive. The preserved versions include a March 21, 2015 download and a December 25, 2020 rebuild.

name: Temple of the Talion
description: The Temple of the Talion was Drud14's jungle base, founded in September 2016. Its entrance arch led into a complex of domes, towers, and biome-themed courtyards, with detailed interiors, redstone machinery, and extensive underground rooms. FastVincent's history describes it as a project built without hacked clients and dates its destruction by the Fourth Reich to around May 2018.

name: Flying Castle
description: Offtopia built the Flying Castle at the Imperator’s Base. The Archive preserves a November 20, 2015 download.

name: Cloud Club
description: The Cloud Club, also known as the Clout Club, was a Spawn Mason base around 3,000 blocks from spawn that lasted for about a week in mid-August of 2019. The base had many members invited to it, mainly friends of the Spawn Masons and Emperium members.

name: Eternal Gardens
description: Toxic_Zombie25 built The Eternal Gardens, also called Preuveneers, in 2012 and abandoned it in 2013, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated September 12, 2016.

name: Jalanda City Outpost
description: The Archive dates Jalanda City Outpost’s establishment to October 2016 and preserves a July 1, 2017 download.

name: c0mmiegrad
description: c0mmiegrad is a large obsidian dome with a pyramid in the center. The base was first designed on a private server hosted by aternos.org and was then built on 2b2t. The base took around 1 hour to create, while the watercube took around 12 hours to make as the Gulag had to manually mine all of the ice they would need.

name: Christmas Party Base 2020
description: The 2b2t Party Committee built this Christmas party venue for the server’s tenth anniversary. The current Archive warp is labeled December 19, 2020. The Archive credits 7___k, BoomerangVillage, BottleCapBrony, Breithan, Chipoff, Clavicus_Vile_, DarkXL6, Fakeblockgame, IronException, Joey_Coconut, Kittengorl, LegendBake, Mr_Pint, Negative_Entropy, Raaanch, Rathause, SpeedDemon0 and Univercius.

name: Gaza
description: Gaza was a Shortbus Caliphate base founded in November 2020. Bathory343 and R1ckson were among its builders; R1ckson’s pyramid became a central feature. Following the loss of Menegroth and the exposure of Halicarnassus, members self-griefed Gaza in October 2021. The Archive preserves an October 23 download and records abandonment on October 22; the group’s history dates the self-grief to October 23.

name: Castle Galifrey
description: The Archive tentatively dates Castle Galifrey to late 2016 and preserves a November 12, 2018 download.

name: Poseidon
description: Krobar01 began Poseidon in September 2018 at a former stash. Its ocean theme included a wrecked ship, the namesake statue, a seahorse, an aquarium and custom coral and sea grass between islands. The Archive preserves a March 13, 2020 download.

name: Avalysium
description: Avalysium united builders from Avalonia and Elysium in 2020. After an initial relocation, construction at this site began in October. The base developed around a central storage hall, landscaped roads and themed districts, including Amsterdam, Greek and Italian areas, a volcano and a major railway station. Its Nether hub was designed by ____Nexo____ and built by several residents. The Backstreet Boys destroyed the base on April 16, 2021, the date of the Archive’s preserved downloads. It is distinct from Avalysium 2, established in 2024.

name: Requiem
description: TheQracken and Covfefe2020 built Requiem for the Vortex Coalition. The Archive dates its establishment to October 4, 2019 and preserves a November 23 download.

name: Jumbo 36x36x36
description: Jumbo 36x36x36 was a Vortex Coalition obsidian logo build. The Archive dates its establishment to August 2019 and preserves an August 27 download.

name: Harblax's Base
description: The Archive dates Harblax’s Base’s establishment to late 2012 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: Raffiniert
description: Niftyrobo, Crystalinqq, MortAmos, DemonCrown, Caviyaz, Chrissipo, Wi77e, 0nger, GlowskiBroski, Dustin and Jollerino built Raffiniert. The Archive dates its establishment to March 22, 2017 and preserves an August 15 download.

name: Adamantium
description: Orsond and Joey_Coconut founded Adamantium on December 31, 2020. Guardsmen and Shortbus Caliphate builders developed floating islands held by enormous decorative chains, alongside a forge, towers, statues, a pagoda and Franknificant’s Frederick’s Church. Members of DonFuer and Fight Club also joined the base. WomenAreObjects destroyed it on January 18, 2021; the Archive’s download is labeled January 20.

name: Towerz Clan Headquarters
description: The Archive dates Towerz Clan Headquarters to 2017 and preserves a June 5, 2018 download.

name: Wrath Outpost
description:
Wrath Outpost, also commonly shortened to Wrath, is a monument that was built during the Third Spawn Incursion by Valkyria, and used as the main spawn base during the incursion. It was given the name Wrath as a symbol of Valkyria's rage towards the other players for the destruction of Asgard II. The Wrath outpost was made completely out of obsidian, making it relatively ungriefable (Although people have been able to lava cast and wither it). Inside of Wrath Outpost was two pieces of bedrock placed by Pyrobyte due to his access to a backdoor, one in the staircase and the other in the center. If Wrath would ever fall, the third incursion would create another spawn base representing another one of the Seven Deadly Sins. Wrath never did fall, meaning that only Wrath would be built.

Wrath Outpost's entrance is a long wide corridor that leads into the heart of the building. The opening has a large arch over it, and large towers stand in front of it. The heart of the Outpost has a simple square perimeter, but the walls are made of giant arches that form into a large dome that goes above the clouds. In the middle of the base there where beacons.

After the Rusher War, The 4th Reich posted a video on their YouTube channel. The video showed them griefing Wrath Outpost by spawning many withers as well as removing the bedrock placed by Pyrobyte using a method involving a dragon egg.

name: Anatolia
description: Anatolia was Sato86’s early 2013 base and the home of the Black Flag Group, including Pyrobyte and drewbookman. Much of it was built in cobblestone, including lavacast structures. Its name came from a map in Age of Mythology. The group later joined the Hitlerwood builders to establish Valkyria. The Archive preserves a June 1, 2013 version of Anatolia.

name: Blazin Saiyan's Gape
description: The Archive dates BlazinSaiyan’s Gape’s establishment to January 9, 2017 and preserves a download labeled August 2017.

name: The Monastery (Gape Haven)
description:
The Monastery was a base created by a trio of players that went on to be infamous for its endurance throughout 2b2t history until February 2020. It survived without the need for reconstruction and was only found three times, which involved its griefing in 2020, the arrival of a retroactive core base member in 2016, and by an unknown player.

“The Monastery” base was the second base for a trio of players: marcus4761 (jared2016), ttfractal44, and asobl97. The first, called “The Bunker,” was established by the three of them earlier in 2012 which lasted only a few months due to its proximity to its nether portal. The sighting of an unknown player between the base and the nether portal caused marcus4761 to seek out and find a new site for a base.

The location marcus4761 found (around 15k away from “The Bunker”) was the island that became the core of “The Monastery” base. The first building erected around September of 2012 was the main building of the monastery itself, without the cloistered garden which would come later. The intention of the building was to serve as sleeping quarters, as well as the base’s center for item storage, enchantment, and brewing; a role which it served for nearly the entire existence of the base.

Shortly after the initial settlement, asolb97 quit the server, citing the annoyances of long distance walking, the server lag, and boredom with vanilla gameplay. Following this, two players, KobeBeast and Mr_KyleBeast (aka PapaSmurf) made the journey from spawn and joined The Monastery base. Another player, Superhomunculus, made the journey but lost interest soon after.

Unbeknownst to ttfractal44 and marcus4761, KobeBeast and Mr_KyleBeast built their own base directly underneath the monastery, down at bedrock level, with a hidden entrance at the bottom of a small pond in front of the monastery building. (Note: the rooms to this base are still extant underneath the floor of the large underground area beneath the monastery). Upon learning of the secret base, marcus4761 took it upon himself to excavate a massive amount of stone, matching the footprint of the monastery and the newly added cloister, down to the level of Kobe and Kyle’s base as a sort of retaliation for their secret base.

name: Spook Base 4
description: Spook Base 4 was an Infinity Incursion base. The Archive preserves an October 21, 2020 download.

name: The Last Templar 2 Year Memorial
description: The Last Templar built this second-anniversary memorial near X -10,000 on the negative X Overworld highway. The Archive dates its establishment to December 2020 and preserves a December 28 download.

name: Webzone / Dalania
description: The Archive catalogs Webzone as a DonFuer base established on May 22, 2021 and abandoned on August 17. Its preserved download carries the August 17 date. Atlas also lists the site under the name Dalania.

name: Whistler
description: Whistler was a short-lived Guardsmen and Shortbus Caliphate base in an ice spikes biome near the Homeland. Builders added numerous structures during its week-long life in March 2021. The Archive records establishment on March 17 and preserves a March 22 download; the Guardsmen history gives March 16 as its founding date.

name: Jesus Doughnut
description: Jesus Doughnut, also known as the Biome Donut or Christ’s Biome Donut, was built mainly by wakwak90 in 2019 near X -80,000, Z -2,000,000. The build combined a small town with a large torus and a Jesus statue. The creator revealed it publicly in October and later shared before-and-after images and world downloads after destroying it with MatteaMonster. The wiki dates its founding to May 11 and its destruction to October 19, 2019.

name: Arcadia
description: A group base after destruction of Callisto.

name: Hope's Retreat
description: The Archive preserves Hope’s Retreat under November 21, 2013. Its catalog entry does not give a founding date or builder list.

name: Base Near Spawn (2013)
description: The Archive credits this 2013 spawn-area base to omaliymix, xcc2, Kaameron, slow_dive and CytotoxicTcell. Its preserved download is dated December 16, 2013.

name: Obscension
description: An1meTiddie founded the base Obscension in February 2020, before the group of the same name formed. Its name combined obsidian and ascension, reflecting a towering obsidian build created with lava and water casting. The site was destroyed in June 2021 during the conflict following Chunk Haven’s destruction. The Archive preserves a June 4 download and records abandonment on June 8.

name: Ziggy Town (Bedrock Comet)
description:
Ziggy Town was a base built sometime in 2012. The base was founded after Ziggy was going to repair NFE but instead of going to the coordinates in the Overworld, he went to those coordinates in the Nether, which is eight times -400 X 800 Z. The base is best known for its giant bedrock comet. Not so far away from the base is a big part of dried up ocean, walled off from the water with bedrock, given the title of the "Bedrock Dam". Builders got the bedrock through popbob's backdoor which allowed to select players to teleport to, fly and use Not Enough Items mod to spawn stuff in. One of the members who got these perks made stashes out in the millions filled with illegal items, including bedrock. It was one of many bases that had the signature "town" in its name, as bases back then were generally called towns. The base was eventually griefed by an unknown player back in 2012, possibly Acid1212 or Harblax.

The base is comprised of standard Minecraft castles and houses. It was more colorful than Passie Town due to the fact that the base was built in a different Minecraft update, which introduced new creative blocks that players could use.

Bedrock Comet
The famous bedrock comet is one of the last bedrock builds that is still standing, as Hausemaster has removed several illegal builds and lag machines over the years. The build was actually not a comet, but it is based off of a beacon from the Dead Space franchise. A wither was spawned inside the comet presumably in 2012 and was killed later in 2016 by The 4th Reich. In 2020 the comet was submerged in water in order to protect it from griefers attempting to destroy the bedrock.

Attempts to grief
Ziggy Town was abandoned and griefed in 2012, later in 2014, xcc2 returned to Ziggy Town only finding it slightly griefed. The base was rebuilt but was found months later and griefed again. Following that incident, the base members decided to leave the base for good, leading to the bases final demise. Despite the base being destroyed and lavacasted, the bedrock comet remains there as a well known 2b2t landmark. Over the years, many different players and groups have contributed more toward the ruined state that Ziggy Town is in today.

In 2017, the top 30 layers of the bedrock comet were removed by househousehouse1 using the dragon egg bedrock removal method. Due to dragon eggs falling through bedrock and breaking multiple pieces at once, there are also a lot of holes in the bottom of the comet.

In November 2019, as part of The Book Club's "No-Server-November", 2 players built an extremely powerful lag machine inside the bedrock comet. When it was removed, the admin was careful not to remove any bedrock.

Later in November 2019, Brownman members built a ban chunk which encased the bedrock comet. There was also 3 other hollow ban chunks built to make it looks like one structure, so that when an admin uses //set air to remove it, they don't realize that the comet was also deleted. The ban chunk builders spread fake screenshots of the comet being reverted to stone around 2b2t discords and subreddits to trick players into going there and getting banned.

In early April, shortly after the lavacasts has been removed from Ziggy town, a furnace chunk ban was set up by a few members of The Brownmen. This would be known as the April 8-10 Chunk Ban, the group would later extend the project and rename themselves The Bakery. An invitation to a “party” at the bedrock comet was posted on Reddit, prompting many unsuspecting players to go to Ziggy Town. Dozens of players would be chunk banned over the next few days, and it even gained the attention of FitMC, who would later make a video about it. Hause made attempts to remove the chunk ban but it was fairly easy to set the ban chunk back up. The Bakery moved operations from the comet to 0 0 overworld after a week. You can see the original post here.

Restoration Efforts
During early April of 2020 an attempt to remove the lavacasts from Ziggy Town was made. The project was lead by players Univercius and KBgaming, with additional help from Jimbo_Limbo and the creator of the bedrock comet, passie05. The restoration effort took about half a week and when the project concluded, almost all remnants of the years-old lavacasts were gone.

Bedrock Bunker
An illegally built bedrock bunker near bedrock level is close to Ziggy Town. FitMC made a video on it.

The bunker was 4 blocks wide, 3 blocks tall, and 7 blocks across (on the inside) with no way inside. When using freecam, it was possible to place blocks inside the bunker. Xcc2 said that using freecam, they used the bunker to store items as an ungriefable chest.

The bedrock has been replaced with an expoit to be out of obsidian by someone called "Press". It is unknown when it happened.

name: +Z Border
description:
Also known as The Southern World Border, this is the southern Overworld world-border settlement, near Z 30,000,000 and the end of the Southern Canal. The +Z Digging Group reached this border on June 9, 2017 after extending the Nether route to Z 3,750,000. Preserved downloads and media show the settlement at several later dates.

This location includes Overworld and Nether saved worlds. The Nether capture is archived as Nether +Z 3.75M Milestone, at X 0, Z 3,749,973. The Archive preserves captures in both dimensions dated 2018-02-26.

name: Pit Fight 4
description:
Pit Fight 4 used an Isengard-inspired arena for Obscension's August 7, 2021 tournament, which drew more than thirty participants, including streamers. The tower recreated an earlier Obscension base. In the organizer's recap, builder FreeLees explained that the reconstruction used An1meTiddie's schematic and was made for his birthday, recalling the group's beginnings.

The organizer congratulated Eternal_Fin and youfoundsand as the joint winners, with priority queue and equipment kits as prizes. This contemporary post supplies the spelling youfoundsand; the later wiki account spells it differently. The Archive preserves an August 6 download of the venue, from before the tournament.

name: Pit Fight 8: Hijacked

The 2b2t Wiki names Sammm as the $100 winner. An1meTiddie shared a post thanking the participants on December 20, under the event's Hijacked title.

Builders developed individual districts, including Crawket’s Cyber Palace, Krobar01’s Hovel and LordGalvatronMC’s pyramid. A revival in 2020 brought further construction, while its central temple remained unfinished. The base was destroyed on June 16, 2021 after its coordinates were leaked; the Archive preserves a download with that date.

He chose the location for its terrain and restricted his materials to resources available nearby, including stone, packed ice, and wood. His final tour uses a preserved world download to show the mountain's largely unchanged exterior and the construction inside. After repeated small griefs, he stopped working there and released the download.

Its intentionally ruined architecture, corridors and altered terrain formed the setting for the Fit versus TheCampingRusher duel during the 2016 Rusher War. name: KinoGrad Base
description:
KinoGrad Base (KGB), also known simply as KinoGrad and often stylized as Kinograd Base or Kinograd, was a group base founded by kinorana and OreMonger after the fall of King’s Landing. It is perhaps most notable for its role in the drama of the third backdoor.

KinoGrad Base was founded by kinorana and OreMonger after King’s Landing was griefed by its members due to the coordinates being leaked by iTristan. Many members of King’s Landing joined KGB, including YellowstoneJoe, Drewbookman, Branillon and SilverKrownKing. One later arrival to KGB was marcus4761, who was one of the founders of The Monastery.

Major builds at KGB included VargaGirl’s VargaCastle, SilverKrownKing’s chateau, marcus4761’s KGB Palace Hotel, xarviar’s temple, Dorquemada’s house, a statue of a giant spider eating a pig, a large iron farm, and Drewbookman’s double mob grinder. OreMonger was well known for building massive (and often very laggy) redstone farms and sorters at his bases, and at KGB he built a massive sorting system, a large mob grinder, and a redstone-powered fireworks shop, as well as automatic firework launching systems and other automatic farms. High above the sorting system was a massive sun made of stained glass, and next to the sorter was a small fountain with a fireworks system built under it. Perhaps the most recognisable symbol of the base was the red and white “KinoGrad” sign built above the fountain, with Russian text on the back. A Nether hub was also built out of ice and iron blocks. Many builds at KGB were never completed, such as a large castle named the Fortress City of Tyr built by Sato86 and SilverKrownKing as a “Valkyrian Embassy”.

The base was griefed by c1yd3i and iTristan as part of the Tyranny’s Week of Destruction.

name: Nautilus

Enchoseon led much of the draining; later builds included glass mushrooms, a giant jellyfish, an octopus, towers and an interior hall. After terrain screenshots leaked, members finished several projects and self-griefed the base in late January 2022. The Archive labels its download January 30; the published history dates the grief to January 29.

Later additions included Project Shiny, a dinosaur head and the nearby Cloud Club. The site also served as an Incursion meeting point. The Archive preserves several 2017 versions and a December 2019 version, plus a March 9, 2019 SpawnMasons lodge by BoomerangVillage.

Residents built their own districts around the tower, with work on the town beginning that May and a glass-and-lava sphere added above the tower. The settlement was known as The Order of the Tower.
