description:
Pit Fight 10 was Obscension’s February 2022 PvP event, staged in an amusement-park-themed arena with rollercoasters and Ferris wheels. The Archive dates the venue’s establishment to February 7 and preserves a February 18 download, one day before the tournament described in the event history.

The 2b2t Wiki credits rwah, eternal_fin, Elesuor and Baconator326 with shared prizes after lag and a restart. Its recipient count is inconsistent. KiLABGaming later published a February 25 video about attending Pit Fight, including a section devoted to his own experience of this event.

name: SBA 15
description: SBA 15 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to November 14, 2021 and preserves a download labeled that month.

name: SBA 16
description: SBA 16 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to November 19, 2021 and preserves a download labeled that month.

name: 2019 Party Committee Halloween Base
description: The 2b2t Party Committee organized this 2019 Halloween venue. The Archive credits BoomerangVillage, BottleCapBrony, Mr_Pint, Breithan, IronException, Terbin, Hari_Hari, Negative_Entropy and HermeticLock, and preserves an October 26 download. The site was also a stop on the committee’s 2023 trick-or-treat route.

name: Borealis
description: Borealis was a Team Aurora base established in December 2016, according to the Archive. Built in an ice-spikes biome, it used an ice theme for its towers and buildings. BarrenDome toured the base in his video about meeting AntVenom.

name: Jared2013 & VADemon's Base
description: The Archive identifies this as jared2013 and VADemon’s base, established by jared in early 2015. Its preserved download is labeled 2018.

name: Legion G4MEMODE Skybase
description: This was a Legion G4MEMODE skybase. The Archive preserves it under September 8, 2020. It is distinct from the group’s 2019 spawn base.

name: Goodwill Trading Outpost #1
description: Jumbo_warrior, Rimmy93, 1_King and Frostraver built Goodwill Trading Outpost #1. The Archive dates its establishment to October 22, 2016 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: OldFag Outpost
description: Javier_110 restored OldFag Outpost, according to the Archive. Its catalog cautiously dates the original base to approximately 2012–2013 and preserves a January 18, 2018 download.

name: End Portal
description: Possible End Portal Location

name: Black Freighter
description: dr_frankfurt built Black Freighter in the End in 2018, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated February 13.

name: Camp Big Moose
description: Camp Big Moose was FamilyPumpkin6’s first base. The Archive dates its establishment to December 22, 2018 and preserves a December 26, 2019 download.

name: 1 Million Base
description: Omaliymix and jdw99666 began the journey to 1 Million Base in late 2011 after leaving Ravendel. Judge’s Group joined them, and the remote settlement developed in early 2012 with a wheat farm, a long tunnel, a hilltop tower, storage buildings and Judge’s dome-shaped house on the water. An invited resident, x0XP, destroyed the base in February 2012. Darth08 began a restoration in June 2021; it was destroyed that August. The Archive’s undated download should not be assumed to show every later restoration.

name: Rocket Town
description: Rocket City, also known as Rocket Town and Fit's Sky base was a base built in March 3rd 2017 by FitMC, Bigdon50, AlphaComputer, jddinger, and ChromeCrusher.

name: Rhadamantis
description: Rhadamantis, originally Kyriath and also called the Lost City, began as an independent base whose builders included SAINTEIRIK, Lordloffar, Bigmero, Bisquette and pheno778. Valkyria members later occupied and rebuilt it in 2013, repairing buildings and adding their eagle emblem. The Archive tentatively dates the original settlement to 2012 and preserves a version labeled 2015. It should not be treated as a base originally founded by Valkyria.

name: SheLongMusk
description: ADB___, Umum_ and Zipoffs built SheLongMusk. The Archive dates its establishment to October 22, 2021 and preserves a January 14, 2022 download.

name: Builder's Haven Nether
description: Builders’ Haven Nether was a Nether base near X 157,152, Z -23,032. The Archive preserves a download labeled September 11, 2018, while its establishment field says late 2018. Those labels do not establish a precise founding date.

name: Ocala City
description: Lifeisgood72 founded Ocala City, also called Fancytown, on June 13, 2017. The solo city drew on nineteenth-century European architecture, with named streets, a cathedral, an Arc de Triomphe and a grand inn. The Archive preserves a February 21, 2020 download, the date of the base’s destruction.

name: Dome Sisters
description: Donkeywut built Dome Sisters in 2019, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated September 4.

name: Wuhu Island
description: Wuhu Island was a Backstreet Boys base founded in December 2020. The Archive preserves a February 16, 2021 download. The group’s history places its destruction roughly two to three months after founding.

name: Karthwasten
description: Karthwasten was a spawn town, founded by MrCK10

name: Fit Victorious
description: Breithan built Fit Victorious, a statue commemorating Fit’s victory over TheCampingRusher. The Archive dates the build to May 3, 2017.

name: Hemispheria
description: LegendBake, 7___k and Tokems founded Hemispheria after Tokemshire. Its best-known completed builds were LegendBake’s white concrete cathedral and Tree of Life, alongside an arena and unfinished castle. The Archive dates its establishment to February 13, 2020, while the wiki gives March. The preserved download is dated June 26, when the base was destroyed following a coordinate leak.

name: Old Town
description:
Old Town, aka Judge Town, was an old base from 2011 founded by THEJudgeHolden and Offtopia. It was one of the very few independent bases during the times of the Facepunch conflict. It was also where Judge's group was founded.

When THEJudgeHolden began to play 2b2t, he went out to found Old Town. He eventually invited Offtopia and the two began construction. Offtopia did not build as much as Judge did but instead invited more players as the months past. Offtopia eventually invited jdw99666 and Elocdrof from spawn within the first month, who were clueless newfags at the time.

Eventually, Elocdrof began inviting real life friends, like marksman77 and willyroof. This made the group have a solid six members and continued this for a while until the group decided to invite jdw's friend, bubbakennedy and square_digger.

The group was eventually attacked by popbob in November of 2011, when he used his backdoor to destroy a large portion of the base using infinite TNT and his teleportation methods.

The base was eventually abandoned by Judge's group and the group continued to be together up until 2013, during the rise of Valk.

name: Sky Zero
description: The Archive dates Sky Zero’s establishment to November 9, 2021 and preserves a November 24 download. The catalog does not identify its builders.

name: Snash
description: Snash was Zispanos’ Christmas and New Year base. The Archive dates its establishment to November 28, 2020, preserves a January 5, 2021 download and records its abandonment on January 18.

name: -3.125m, -3.125m Nether Milestone
description: This milestone lies near Nether X -3,125,000 and Z -3,125,000, equivalent to Overworld X -25,000,000 and Z -25,000,000. The Archive preserves a March 29, 2021 download.

name: Pit Fight: Arena
description:
Pit Fight: Arena is an early Archive listing near the location now cataloged as Pit Fight 2. Its June 14, 2021 warp label matches the preserved date of that venue, and the two map pins are approximately one block apart horizontally. This makes it a likely alternate listing for the same arena, although the records have not been merged.

The associated Pit Fight 2 history describes decorative buildings around a bedrock-level fighting pit. Its tournament is dated June 20, with SyndicateNA named as winner by the 2b2t Wiki. That result belongs to the numbered event; this older listing has no separately verified tournament result.

name: Veritas
description: Hidiuos and Thegreatmochi built Veritas. The Archive dates its establishment to November 5, 2015 and preserves a January 3, 2020 download.

name: Water-Pyramid
description: A medium sized base featuring a giant pyramid made out of water.

name: Doritown
description: Cluvah was Doritown’s main builder, joined by Outdoor21, 0Mateciotti, 2N2N, Croonox, 0Popbob and 420x69. The Archive dates its establishment to August 2020 and preserves a November 7 download.

name: Sleepy's Hollow
description: Sleepy’s Hollow was a Legion of Shenandoah base. The Archive tentatively dates its establishment to 2014 and records a coordinate leak in mid-to-late 2015. It is distinct from the later Emperium base named Sleepy Hollow.

name: HardHat's Pyramid
description:
CaptainHardHat's Pyramid, also known as HardHat's Pyramid, is a massive build constructed by CaptainHardHat. The pyramid is known for its strange design and being very close to Imp Base.

While the exact date of its completion is unknown, the base was most likely built sometime in 2013. CaptainHardhat's intention of building it was simply to leave his legacy on the server and so he made the long trek to where the base currently resides. Several travelers to Imp's base have discovered it on their way there and have left the usual sign to state that they were there. Some even dedicated themselves to protect the base. CaptainHardhat would continue to come on for about a year but kept under the radar and eventually left.

The original base was leaked on October 14th, 2016 by Lifeisgood72, and destroyed gradually over time as the highways expanded. However, it was rebuilt in a different location.

name: King's Landing
description:
King's Landing, also known as the IDMM, was a large group base. It was founded by OreMonger, Drewbookman, and Branillon sometime in June of 2015

After the events of the third incursion , Oremonger and Branillon decided to head far away from spawn and build King's Landing. The name of the base was voted on by the invited members, with Branillon coming up with the winning name (The name was potentially a reference to Game of Thrones). The base constructed was enormous with several projects being done.

The peace, as with most bases on 2b2t, did not last with the members and iTristan leaked the base in the public chat during the third backdoor. Oremonger and SilverKrownKing ended up having to destroy the base as they knew it was only a matter of time before someone else destroyed it. iTristan and his buddies from the Tyranny eventually dumpstered the place more.

The base had multiple personal builds of the 20 members. Builds included futuristic houses, AwesomeGuyMonkey's treehouse, pixel art, Caleesii's giant castle, a large dragon, a hand with a levitating ball, several automated farms and Oremonger's auto 265 item sorter, the first one ever seen on 2b. This sorter operated using a glitch in Minecraft that is named "glass elevator" in which items are pushed through glass blocks and flow into hoppers and chests.

name: FoE: Prologue: Of Pip Buck and Cutie Marks
Lost Nomad Games I
description: The Lost Nomads held their first Nomad Games on January 22, 2021. SilverEyes, oofplux and Dawnfall_ led construction after an earlier site near spawn was destroyed. The replacement venue, about 50,000 blocks out, included a castle, Tri-Dimensions, Excalibur, a replica of MemeWoman’s spawn base and Forceken’s snowball arena. Helpers included miki_moo, MemeWoman, ForceRiza and izatopia. The Archive preserves the event site under January 22.

name: Ragnarok II
description: The Archive dates Ragnarok II’s establishment to January 30, 2017 and preserves a May 28, 2018 download.

name: Tugboat Base
description:
Tugboat Base began as the Fellowship of the Diamond’s underground 8000 Base. In his firsthand account, KillerCapybara dates its construction to October 2011, before the group moved through other settlements and largely stopped playing in 2012.

KillerCapybara and zhode returned with HyraxKing in 2015 to restore the site. HyraxKing built the pagoda and stone-brick castle; KillerCapybara built the tower and the tugboat in July 2015. That later boat gave the older base its familiar name. The Fellowship was separate from the similarly named Brotherhood of the Diamond.

name: Costco Base
description: Costco Base was a Last Templar base established in May 2018, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated June 1.

name: New World
description: The Archive preserves several areas of New World under December 19, 2019: Anar’s hole, Nordic’s cave and hut, P5’s base, stash ruins, Ufo’s statue and Ufo’s UFO. These are separately named sections of the same cataloged base. The entries do not provide a founding date.

name: The Smibadome
description: The Smibadome was an ice-themed arena at the SpawnMasons base Smibville. The base was founded in May 2019 and hosted several weekly lodges before its destruction in January 2020.

name: The Paragon
description: The Paragon grew from Sage_Mathias and rpb7191’s July 2017 settlement and its merger with the neighboring Cobbletown, founded in May 2016. Roads connected a sandstone-and-acacia village, library, stables and Orthanc Tower. Team Infrared members later inhabited the largely abandoned site. The Archive preserves a November 25, 2017 download; the base was destroyed in January 2018.

name: City Base
description: The Archive preserves City Base, its guardian farm and its Nether area under October 21, 2020. The Nether entry dates that portion’s establishment to September 4. These viewpoints cover associated facilities in both dimensions.

name: ChongFuer
description: ChongFuer was a DonFuer base established on September 17, 2020, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated October 9.

name: DFC
description: Detroit Flight Center, or DFC for short was a base built by Fit that was never completed and turned into a stone brick platform.

name: The Reich
description: The Reich was a base near Valkyria built by Lichtenburg and zxcwbz, with contributions from kaameron, spikain and abanaattori. In his 2015 account, Lichtenburg describes an airfield, railway, towers, farms and a stadium project. He says its builders left it unfinished before Sato86 discovered it near Valkyria.

name: Anvil Base
description: Parthicus and The_DarkEmperor founded Anvil Base in 2016, according to the Archive. Other recorded members include SilverKrownKing, stankerz, rootbeerguy and Zoist. The preserved download is dated April 21, 2020.

name: Elysium
description: Elysium I was the Elysium group’s first base, founded by Carlll_ and fellow members near Z 4.5 million. The group history dates its founding to June 22, 2019; the Archive’s March 2019 note corresponds to the group’s formation. Its preserved download is dated December 6. Members later destroyed the base after maps revealed its location. This record is separate from Elysium II.

name: Emerald Sand City
description: Edark established Emerald Sand City in 2012, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated December 26, 2016.

name: Oremonger's Clock
description: A giant redstone clock made by oremonger.

name: End Portal
description: Possible End Portal Location

name: Fat Leelo's Mushroom Kingdom
description: fat_leeloo built the Mushroom Kingdom. The Archive dates its establishment to September 2013 and preserves a May 7, 2015 download.

name: HWU 2b2t 10th Anniversary Event
description: This was the Highway Workers Union’s event site for 2b2t’s tenth anniversary. The Archive preserves a December 17, 2020 download.

name: Bombay
description: Bombay was a Mew Revolution base. The Archive dates its establishment to February 18, 2022 and preserves a February 25 download.

name: Camp Spooky 2
description: Camp Spooky 2 was a Guardsmen base close to the Homeland. The Archive dates its establishment to October 2021 and preserves an October 15 download. The numbered Archive entry distinguishes this site from earlier Camp Spooky history.

name: Pit Fight
description:
This unnumbered Pit Fight listing appears to refer to the venue cataloged separately as Pit Fight 3. Both records have the same horizontal coordinates and a July 17, 2021 Archive warp label, although their recorded landing heights differ. The match is based on catalog evidence rather than a separate event announcement.

Pit Fight 3 was Obscension's Nuketown-inspired tournament, modeled on the Call of Duty map. Its existing event history names _xMeh as winner. The organizer posted a thank-you message on July 17. The unnumbered title here should not be read as proof that this was the first Pit Fight.

name: Rusher War: 5 Year Anniversary Base
description: This site commemorated the fifth anniversary of the Rusher War. The Archive dates its establishment to May 9, 2021 and preserves a June 1 download.

name: Eagle's Rock
description: Eagle’s Rock was an Astral Order spawn base built in 2018 by Stadhouder, iMems, Witblue and digandbuilder. It followed the group’s move away from centralized main bases toward sites accessible to newer members. The Archive dates this site to June 2018 and preserves a download labeled August 2018. It is the original Astral Order base, separate from the later Backstreet Boys Eagle’s Rock II and III.

name: Farmland
description: piguPigu built Farmland on August 5, 2017, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated October 9, 2018.

name: Algul Siento
description: Algul Siento was a base founded by slow_dive in 2012. Its residents included Spikain, Branillon, kinorana and linkgonzo. Surviving images show its buildings and floating glass sphere. The Archive preserves a version labeled 2015, after the base’s reported destruction in 2013.

name: George Harbor
description: George Harbor was an Infinity Incursion base. The Archive dates its establishment to April 3, 2021 and preserves an April 15 download.

name: Asa's Underground
description: The Archive preserves Asa’s Underground under August 25, 2013. Its catalog entry does not provide an establishment date or additional builder credits.

name: Highland Island
description: The Archive dates Highland Island to 2017 and preserves a December 5 download.

name: Avalon City
description: AwesomeGuyMonkey founded Avalon City, also called the City of Peace, in 2013 as an ocean refuge for travelers. In his account, the central castle expanded into farms, houses, marinas, villager trading areas and artificial mushroom islands, linked by railways, ocean roads and undersea tunnels. Supplies came from smaller bases on distant shores. Avalon was repeatedly damaged and rebuilt over the following years. The Archive preserves a September 15, 2015 download and July 27, 2025 ruins with a newer castle.

name: Rhodes
description: Andrew_Gill founded Rhodes in early 2012 after Boatmurdered. The base went through periods of activity and abandonment, then grew again when jared2013 settled there in late 2015 and other builders joined. The current Archive warp is labeled September 10, 2017, from the base’s final year.

name: Lake Village
description: A small but very detailed village near a lake.

name: 2k2k
description:
2k2k was a Facepunch Republic settlement near X -2,000, Z -2,000. Contemporary forum records and screenshots place it there by April 2012. Its builders included Phagocytic and Mystery_Penguin, and its underground rooms, farms and fortifications became a frequently rebuilt spawn landmark.

Repeated griefing and lavacasting buried much of the base. Later restoration attempts included work by jared2013 and the New Facepunch Republic, whose 2019–2020 projects reused the site while changing parts of its layout. The Archive preserves a November 20, 2013 version; later restoration history should not be mistaken for the contents of that capture.

name: Rat House
description: Rathause founded Rat House on a terraformed mushroom island in August 2020. It expanded into a large collaborative spawn base in mid-2021, with 104 recorded members from many different groups. Builders added underground rooms, floating builds and new land around the island. Projects included rat sculptures, the relocated Spire and several SpawnMasons lodges. The base was griefed in October 2021; its surviving media and downloads document the earlier build.

name: Valhalla
description: Valhalla was part of the Valkyria group’s network of bases, as recorded in Sato86’s account of the group. The Archive dates the site to 2013 and preserves a September 1, 2017 download.

name: Valley of Wheat
description:
The Valley of Wheat was a wheat-field sanctuary on 2b2t. The wheat covered almost every block of grass around the area, spanning over one thousand blocks from end to end in places. In addition, the Valley also contained many Ancient Egyptian style structures such as large pyramids, pillars and sphinxes, built using sandstone and netherrack.

The Valley of Wheat was built by Jaang, a player who did not really like to interact with other players. Jaang was the sole builder of the entire sanctuary. He spent his entire time on 2b2t building and expanding the Valley in both of its constructional phases (2011-2012 and late 2013-2014). To gather more players to visit his Valley, Jaang built a pyramid in The Nether, which would lead players through a portal and into the Valley of Wheat. Jaang let players take food from the Valley but never allowed them to build in it.

During a trip through the Nether, Jaang was attacked by another player but was saved by Offtopia, who was one of the only players Jaang ever interacted with. Offtopia would give Jaang gifts and would protect the Valley of Wheat at all costs, killing anyone who did not replant the wheat. Offtopia also invited other known players to the Valley, such as; xcc2, passie05, zxcwbz1, and others. They all helped replant and remove any minor damage, such as lavacasts and TNT craters. Offtopia would continue to defend the Valley, with "tooth and nail" according to Fit, up until the Rusher invasion.

The base's existence was nearly universally respected, no one would destroy the base. Even popbob once killed Jaang in The Valley, but did not grief it. One of the most notorious griefs on the Valley of Wheat (before the Rusher War) was committed by an oldfag known as IMBJR. The Valley was eventually restored by xcc2, Offtopia, and others. However, the destruction following IMBJR's grief caused Jaang to leave 2b2t. Eventually, xcc2 and others left in early 2016, leaving Offtopia to defend The Valley. Despite these events, many other nonaligned players contributed to restoring the Valley.

name: Nihongun Oniya Jail Island
description: Oniya Jail Island was a Nihongun build. The Archive dates its establishment to June 1, 2021 and preserves a June 5 download. The group’s documented projects also included Natsumatsuri and the Obsidian Sky Pekora.

name: SpergClub
description: iMems, digandbuilder and LightningB0lt44 founded SpergClub as a Backstreet Boys spawn base on August 14, 2021. Players built their own sections around a mountain, producing a varied collection of houses, decorations and meme builds. More than fifty players visited or contributed. The base lasted one week before its destruction on August 21, the date of the Archive’s preserved download.

name: Monolith
description: The Archive preserves Monolith under April 7, 2021, with separate viewpoints for the main base, its mapart and its Halloween build. These are parts of the same site extending across several thousand blocks.

name: Redroom #3
description: EntropyAnnDroid built Redroom #3. The Archive dates its establishment to August 5, 2018 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of that year.

name: 2020 Halloween Party Base
description: This 2b2t Party Committee Halloween venue was preserved by the Archive under October 31, 2020. It was revisited as a stop on the committee’s 2023 trick-or-treat route.

name: SnowCliff Keep
description: SnowCliff Keep is listed among the New Facepunch Republic’s bases. Its Atlas archive-warp record is labeled October 25, 2020; that label does not establish when the base was founded.

name: Elbaf
description: The Archive dates Elbaf’s establishment to July 2019; its current warp is labeled April 27, 2021. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Vularia
description: Base created by fizbag. Griefed by babbaJ and 100010.

name: Etobase
description: E_to_the_G established Etobase in July 2013 and abandoned it in December 2014, according to the Archive.

name: South Park Base
description: DaPorkChop built South Park Base in 2017, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated August 7.

name: Iacon
description: Iacon was a base founded by SLAGATHOR09 in late 2011. In his account of the base, xcc2 recalls visiting its residents and taking an early world download. He returned in 2017 and repaired it with help from cactusman777, then abandoned the restoration after a wither attack.

name: Mushroom Kingdom
description: Mushroom Kingdom began as a mushroom-island settlement in early 2012 and was repeatedly repaired after griefs. BarrenDome's tour, informed by the original builder's account, describes its later design around four classical elements: the central mushroom island for earth, a factory island for fire, an aqueduct-like museum for water, and an unfinished fourth island for air. Major reshaping of the islands began in 2015; the central mushroom and factory were completed by 2016.

name: Squid Games 3: Lobby
description: This was the lobby of the third Squid Game event on 2b2t. bobbers22 organized the series; its third edition brought together builders including Hovecs, minecraft_simon, YoMoBoYo, Harrissssonn and xrayessay. The Archive preserves this section separately under March 6, 2022.

name: Squid Games 3: Game 1
description: This was the first game of the third Squid Game event on 2b2t. bobbers22 organized the series; its third edition brought together builders including Hovecs, minecraft_simon, YoMoBoYo, Harrissssonn and xrayessay. The Archive preserves this section separately under March 6, 2022.

name: Akibahoods: Minigames Base
description: Akibahoods was a Bookhood minigames base. The Archive dates its establishment to December 2021 and preserves a February 22, 2022 download.

name: Capybara Castle
description: Capybara Castle was an Astral Brotherhood base established for former Rat House builders. The group’s history describes limited activity there, with Aresyl a notable exception. The Archive dates its establishment to October 10, 2021 and preserves a February 5, 2022 download.

name: Halloween Party Base 2018
description: The 2b2t Party Committee organized this 2018 Halloween venue. The Archive credits BoomerangVillage, Breitan, Mr_Pint, Mr_Morlock, Jin_Masamune, jared2013 and _Courier6_, and preserves an October 30 download.

name: The MentleFortress
description: The Mentlegen built the MentleFortress in 2011. The Archive records its abandonment on May 15 and a later return by the group, and preserves a January 22, 2018 download.

name: Kerak
description: Hickster2 built Kerak for the Knights Templar. The Archive dates its establishment to November 2016 and preserves an August 24, 2017 download. The Knights Templar were a separate group from The Last Templar.

name: IRL Sandcastle
description: Raaanch built IRL Sandcastle for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under August 21, 2021.

name: Donut Cave
description: Nordic93 built Donut Cave for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under August 28, 2021.

name: Aria
description: Aria is listed among the Facepunch Republic's bases. Its Overworld location is preserved in the Atlas catalog with the Archive warp Aria_2017-10-08. The wiki's base list supports the group association but does not give Aria a founding or destruction date.

name: Mjolnir Mansion
description: Mjolnir Mansion was Spartan512’s first base after leaving Asgard II. The Archive dates its establishment to November 1, 2014 and preserves a March 31, 2015 download.

name: Wayside Valley
description: Founded Mar, 18 2015

name: -X Digger's Base
description: This was a base of the -X Diggers near the western Overworld border. The Archive dates its establishment to June 2018 and preserves a July 30 download.

name: Acacia Tower
description: Acacia Tower was a SpawnMasons lodge recorded as l22w36. The Archive preserves it under September 3, 2022.

name: Alexios
description: The Archive dates Alexios’s establishment to 2021 and preserves an August 6 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Amenta
description: Mac_JCB and headpop built Amenta as a Collective base. The Archive dates its establishment to October 25, 2022 and preserves a November 20 download.

name: Asteria II
description: Lilyofthevalley built Asteria II as an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to February 12, 2020 and preserves a download labeled October 2021.

name: Autismium
description: rfresh_ built Autismium, also called Alpha Island. The Archive dates its establishment to February 2, 2021 and preserves a July 11 download.

name: Azuros 3
description: The Archive dates Azuros 3’s establishment to July 28, 2021 and preserves an October 25, 2022 download.

name: Base Nostalgia
description: The Archive identifies this November 20, 2021 download of Base Nostalgia as Rebuild 5. It records a later reconstruction, rather than the original base’s founding. Credits for earlier rebuilds have not been assumed to apply to this version.

name: Based Base 2
description: The Archive dates Based Base 2’s establishment to July 2021 and preserves a January 15, 2022 download.

name: BGJ: Industrial Area
description: The Archive preserves this separately cataloged BGJ industrial area under July 13, 2022. It lies near the main Block Game Jerusalem site but has its own landing point and download. The catalog does not provide an establishment date or individual builder credits for this area.

name: Blackhaven
description: The Archive dates Blackhaven’s establishment to July 4, 2022 and preserves a July 7 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Cakefuer 1: Falloutfuer
description: Cakefuer 1, also called Falloutfuer, was part of Kizzycocoa’s DonFuer scout-base series following Kizzyland. Members were encouraged to build in their own styles. The Archive dates its establishment to August 2022 and preserves an August 2 download. The Cakefuer series preceded the separate Cakemasons group.

name: Cakefuer 2: Underfuer
description: The Archive preserves Cakefuer 2: Underfuer under September 12, 2022, with establishment listed that month. Kizzycocoa’s history describes Cakefuer 2 as an earlier DonFuer scout base destroyed in August. The relationship between that account and this September download is unresolved; the preserved date has not been silently changed.

name: Camp Tallest
description: ashfor built Camp Tallest. The Archive dates its establishment to January 25, 2017 and preserves a November 19, 2018 download.

name: Chalice
description: The Archive dates Chalice’s establishment to August 2021 and preserves an April 27, 2022 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Cobtopia
description: Cobtopia was a Brownmen base and item stash concealed beneath a lavacast. FitMC’s documentary describes LordMahan, Steve3, Redstoner and Nukelord developing the site after earlier stashes were discovered, using restricted travel and pearl teleportation to avoid leaving trails for the NoCom coordinate exploit. Inside were farms, storage and an automated sorting system. The Archive dates its establishment to July 2020 and preserves a January 13, 2022 download.

name: Dienda
description: y_a_t_a built Dienda. The Archive dates its establishment to July 1, 2022 and preserves a December 7 download.

name: Don Blaahaj
description: Don Blaahaj, written Don Blåhaj in the wiki, began as DonFuer recruit base s2-ba on September 25, 2022. Metalbunny initially led the base, with leadership later passing to Centxuri. Its medieval fantasy buildings included a town center, an obsidian dragon and a shark statue inspired by the IKEA plush toy. A map of the town exposed its terrain; the wiki records its destruction on November 4, 2022, also the date of the preserved Archive download.

name: Don Darko
description: Don Darko was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 20, 2022 and preserves a September 1 download.

name: Don Myr
description: Don Myr was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to September 15, 2022 and preserves an October 26 download.

name: Don Tour
description: Don Tour was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 20, 2022 and preserves a September 3 download.

name: DonFuer 23
description: DonFuer began DonFuer 23 in December 2021. D_loaded and iAmZeiss led its early construction, with Bonk later building much of its housing. The base was compromised and griefed in late July 2022. The Archive preserves a download labeled July 28.

name: DonFuer 25
description: DonFuer founded DonFuer 25 in August 2022 after its Aureus City rebuild. The modern city combined Warske’s New York-inspired financial district, Darkomier’s New Vegas-inspired casino district, Phosph0lipid’s futuristic district and expanding suburbs. Darkomier and Alexkooj built an underground rail network connecting the districts. The Archive preserves a November 19, 2022 download. The group’s official tour documents the city and its different building styles.

name: Dorado
description: Dorado was an Astral Brotherhood Moonshriner recruit base. The Archive records its establishment and preserved download under April 6, 2022.

name: Duck Base
description: Sensible1Boy and Bonar built Duck Base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 21, 2022 and preserves an August 8 download.

name: Fem Town
description: Fem Town was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to April 28, 2022 and preserves a May 7 download.

name: Forever
description: Lightningbolt44 and friends built Forever. The Archive dates its establishment to August 9, 2022 and preserves a September 18 download.

name: Franknificant's Notre Dame
description: Franknificant built this obsidian version of Notre-Dame de Paris at the western Overworld border in April 2022. His build catalog identifies it as Notre Dame 10, distinct from his earlier spawn churches and other cathedral replicas. The Archive dates its establishment to April 10 and preserves an April 13 download.

name: FuerFuer
description: FuerFuer was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 2022 and preserves an August 24 download.

name: Halloween Base 2022
description: The Archive preserves this Halloween base under October 26, 2022 and dates its establishment to that month. Its catalog entry does not identify the organizers. It is a separate site from the other preserved 2022 Halloween venues.

name: Hamlet
description: Hamlet was Fastvincent1’s first base, built with Endermqn and Jimyy. His published history describes a return to the server and the base’s founding in 2017, while the Archive dates its establishment to early 2018. The preserved download is dated April 21, 2019. The base survived until April 2022.

name: Heaven's Gate
description: The Archive dates Heaven’s Gate’s establishment to August 2022 and preserves an October 1 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Heroes Haven
description: Heroes Haven was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to May 2022 and preserves an August 20 download.

name: Katadalanfrantaranfueristan
description: Katadalanfrantaranfueristan was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 9, 2022 and preserves a July 10 download.

name: Kiddie Land
description: The Archive dates Kiddie Land’s establishment to January 2022 and preserves an April 15 download. Its catalog entry does not identify the builders.

name: Kizzyland
description: Kizzycocoa led Kizzyland, also called Spawnfuer 28.1B, as a DonFuer scout base. A1FastYellowGTO supplied its name, and members built freely rather than following a single architectural theme. The Archive preserves a July 10, 2022 download. Its April 7 establishment date conflicts with Kizzycocoa’s documented June 2022 arrival on the server, so the founding date remains uncertain.

name: l22w24 End Island
description: DarkXL6 and Negative_Entropy built this End island SpawnMasons lodge. The current Archive warp identifies it as lodge l22w24 and is labeled June 11, 2022.

name: Larptown
description: postto founded Larptown on October 16, 2021 for Spawn Builders Association members. Builds included Harrissssonn’s Spooky Tree, postto’s French Manor and Church of 69, and MrSourkiwi’s Tower of Larp. The original base was griefed in late December 2021. The Archive preserves a December 21 download of the original and a separately labeled July 28, 2022 rebuild.

name: Negative Entropy's First Base
description: The Archive identifies this as Negative_Entropy’s first base and stash, established on June 30, 2016. Its preserved download is dated June 21, 2020.

name: Novus X
description: Novus X was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to April 8, 2022 and preserves a July 6 download.

name: NSO 2
description: SurgicalDonut built NSO 2. The Archive dates its establishment to July 30, 2022 and preserves an August 3 download.

name: NSO
description: Lazarus built NSO. The Archive dates its establishment to July 27, 2022 and preserves a July 30 download.

name: Oolacyle of the Abyss
description: Oolacyle of the Abyss was an underground Sun Knights recruit base. The group’s history calls it Oolacile of the Abyss and identifies it as recruit base 13, founded in October 2022. The Archive preserves a November 16 download.

name: Pollux
description: Dima788 built Pollux. The Archive records both its establishment and preserved download under July 21, 2022.

name: Red Fort
description: Red Fort was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to September 12, 2022 and preserves a September 16 download.

name: Savigo
description: AntonMio built Savigo. The Archive dates its establishment to September 2018 and preserves an August 9, 2022 download.

name: Serendipity
description: Serendipity was a Collector’s Club base. The Archive dates its establishment to May 2020 and preserves a February 20, 2021 download.

name: Slaves Haven
description: Slaves Haven was an Imperial Empire base. The Archive dates its establishment to May 20, 2022 and preserves a July 3 download.

name: Solaris
description: HURTLOCKERBECK founded Solaris in a shattered savanna on June 29, 2022. The Astral Brotherhood base grew around its cliffs, with stables, a glass eye, a mountain fort, a water pillar and AnimeTiddie’s large castle. Joey_Coconut connected builds with roads, bridges and retaining walls. Backstreet Boys griefed the base on October 14. The Archive preserves an October 11, 2022 download.

name: Stone Brick Sanctuary
description: Berkoes founded Stone Brick Sanctuary on November 2, 2021 as a small group base with Suyeonchan and Jazz63540. It grew to about a dozen members, combining Berkoes’ industrial buildings with KatzeFlocken’s nature-focused builds and a stone-brick palette. After its stash was stolen and security concerns grew, Berkoes publicly shared the base. Dima788 and EXM1LITARY griefed it in November 2022. The Archive preserves a September 3 download. Its successor, Stone Brick Sanctuary 2, later became Stellaris and joined Astral Brotherhood.

name: Stupidwalrus' End Base
description: stupidwalrus built this base near End spawn. The Archive preserves a download labeled March 2015; its catalog does not give a founding date.

name: Sun Knight's Paper Farm
description: The Sun Knights built this paper farm in February 2022, according to the Archive. Its catalog lists an October 15 download at these coordinates. The group’s history says the farm was discovered and griefed that day.

name: Sun Knight's Recruit Base
description: This was the Sun Knights’ tenth recruit base, established in September 2022. The group’s history dates its founding to September 28 and its grief to October 15. The Archive preserves an October 13 download.

name: The Lavacast Lodge
description: The Lavacast Lodge 2.0 was a SpawnMasons lodge near spawn. The Archive preserves a July 16, 2022 download.

name: The Rift
description: The Rift was an Astral Brotherhood base in the End. The Archive dates its establishment to July 8, 2022 and preserves a July 23 download.

name: The Spike
description: The Spike was an End build established on February 23, 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated October 12.

name: Tyranny
description: Tyranny was an Imperial Empire base established on October 12, 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated December 11. It is unrelated to the earlier griefing group of the same name.

name: Wall Town
description: Dima788 built Wall Town. The Archive dates its establishment to August 1, 2022 and preserves an August 2 download.

name: Watchmen Citadel
description: Franknificant built the Watchmen Citadel at Guardsmen’s Homeland. The Archive dates its establishment to August 2021 and preserves an August 14 download.

name: Webzone 3
description: Webzone 3 was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to August 25, 2022 and preserves a September 6 download.

name: Wingston I
description: Warske and Dima788 established the first Wingston base in November 2022. Its centerpiece referenced Berlin’s television tower, with streets radiating out to other builds. Warske also built a Brandenburg Gate-inspired entrance and a factory for storing materials. The base was griefed in December. The Archive preserves a November 23 download. Later Wingston bases occupied separate locations.

name: Fitlantis
description:
Fitlantis was built by FitMC and was his first solo base since 2014. This base was discovered using the coordinate exploit of late 2016 by ChromeCrusher. Fitlantis was griefed by multiple players after the base was compromised.

FitMC has the entire construction process of Fitlantis on his YouTube Channel and filmed the construction through multiple YouTube Livestreams. A preserved world download is linked below.

On the 6th of November, 2016, the Exploit of Late 2016 was used by ChromeCrusher to reveal the location of Fitlantis. This allowed a group of random people to travel to the base and accordingly grief it. During this time, a battle occurred between the random people who showed up to grief the base and Team Aurora. On April 21, 2017, Fitlantis was again destroyed by lavacasts and flooding.

name: Homeland
description: The Homeland was the Guardsmen’s main building area near spawn. When one part was destroyed, members moved into adjacent biomes, so the name covered successive sections rather than a single unchanged structure. Builds included the Angel of Dignity, an obsidian Nomad Hut and the Obsidian Labyrinth nearby. The Archive preserves this location under July 22, 2021.

name: Hokkaido
description: RainAura founded Hokkaido after the destruction of Waternoose. The Archive dates its establishment to December 23, 2020 and preserves a July 5, 2021 download. Her membership in other groups does not by itself establish those groups as the builders of this base.

name: -30m -30m End Corner
description: This landmark is at the northwestern End world-border corner, near X -30 million and Z -30 million. The Archive preserves a July 7, 2022 download. These are End coordinates, not Nether-to-Overworld equivalents.

name: Castle Big
description: Unfinished - 2019

name: End Portal
description: Possible End Portal Location

name: -X Border
description:
The Western World Border

This location includes Overworld and Nether captures of the same highway stop. The Nether view is also known as -X 3.75 million Nether milestone, near X -3,749,940, Z 1. The Nether capture is dated 2018-02-12.

name: Eleusis
description: The Archive dates Eleusis’s establishment to August 5, 2017 and preserves a December 15 download.

name: Neflheim
description: Neflheim, also spelled Niflheim, was built by DocSmurf and Sicknessman around a Norse-inspired ice-dragon centerpiece. The base included a large castle, custom ice trees, tunnels and automated ice and dark-oak farms. The Archive dates the project to 2018 and preserves a May 18, 2019 download.

name: HammerBeam
description: HammerBeam was a group base where BarrenDome built substantial farming infrastructure, including a villager breeder and a two-floor trading hall with 92 trading spaces. The underground works also included an iron farm and sewers. After outsiders found the base, its residents deliberately destroyed much of their own work. BarrenDome's surviving videos document both its working machinery and that final destruction.

name: Wrath of VoCo
description: The Vortex Coalition Spawn Base, continually griefed and re-built.

name: Abaddon's Descent
description: BenzinMitCola built Abaddon’s Descent in 2015, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated August 2, 2019.

name: Lonely Island
description:
The Lonely Island was a base created in 2011 by Momo_the_Bear and BennyDeece. The name comes from that it was over 100k blocks away from spawn, which was considered very far away in those days, and considerably remote.

The most unique thing about the Lonely Island is the giant statue of the Forever Alone meme. The island also has many wooden houses, thought most are just pretend businesses like shops and restaurants. The island also is unique because it has many games like chess, Rock 'em Sock 'em Robots, redstone dice, and some others.

name: End Portal
description: An End portal on the +X highway near X 1,889, Z -30, listed in the historical portal catalog. This record does not verify its current condition on the live server.

name: Valerian
description:
Valerian was a large group base on 2b2t. The base started construction on March 23rd 2018. Coords were leaked on June 1 2019; the base was eventually griefed on July 22nd 2019.

In 2018, HawkedOnFonix and OldFreeWilly used the area as a temporary building site. Willy decided to invite BigBatYT after meeting him on the highway. Bat christened the site 'Valerian'.

After the grief of Exposition and Builders Haven's final stash, Hawk invited 1Charlie3 to move items with him to the safety of Valerian. Builder's Haven disbanded; Cloverfrost, xX_Regicide_Xx, R2bEEaton, GTHESUPERMAN and The_GenderBender joined soon after, with Bluerr staying as a guest.
Valerian Congress
Each base member had their own title and office at congress:

HawkedOnFonix - Founding Father & Ministry of Construction
Cloverfrost - Speaker of the House & Ministry of Landscaping
OldFreeWilly - Founding Father & Ministry of Truth
1Charlie3 - Secretary of State
BigBat - Founding Father & Ministry of Magic
R2bEEaton - Ministry of Logic
Regicide - Ministry of the Underground
Gthesuperman - Ministry of Spawn
The_GenderBender - Ministry of the Arts

name: Farmville
description: PeterRichard's old base

name: Ramiel's Watch
description: The Archive credits KingLouisXIV and Loafykins with building Ramiel’s Watch, dating its establishment to May 13, 2013. Its preserved download is dated January 17, 2018. It is sometimes described online as popbob’s castle, but that name does not establish popbob as its original builder.

name: Space Valkyria III (second site)
description: Space Valkyria III's second 2b2t site was the survival-server copy near X 76,933 and Z -112,211. Jack_therippa built it with SilverKrownKing, AlphaComputer, HermeticLock, and other collaborators after Space Valkyria II. The site was destroyed in early-to-mid 2019 before its rings were complete. The Atlas preserves both a community-distributed WDL and The Archive's May 2019 second-site capture under this record.

renders.name: Space Valkyria III (second site) - community WDL

name: Celestia City
description: RobMaster21 founded Celestia City, which had around ten members before its destruction in April 2017. The existing history dates its founding to late 2016, while the Archive gives early 2017 and preserves an April 22 download.

name: Facepunch Food Island
description: assasin_raptor built Facepunch Food Island, tentatively dated by the Archive to 2012. Vab_ito later restored it. The preserved download is dated January 14, 2018.

name: Frontline Base
description: KillerCapybara established Frontline Base in March 2016, according to the Archive. The preserved download is labeled 2017.

name: The Savanna Hope
description: The Savanna Hope was established at the end of October 2018, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 22, 2019.

name: Yiffington I
description:
Yiffington I was a base founded by DemonElite119 directly after the end of the Third Incursion.

Taken to an undisclosed location by Sato86, he was led to a small base he had occupied with other individuals. After gathering supplies he had walked for some time, settling down just a mere 1,200 blocks away from what is known as the Dark Souls Base. Setting up in corrupted chunks, it was at first nothing but hills and some patches of flat land. Over time, he flattened the land, created artificial barriers, docks, and other artifical land features. Other structures were planned to be included, such as an underground city. During the construction of the base, he had invited numerous individuals such as IamTUNA , 24 , coconut4, and jared2013. Before these individuals were invited, or arrived most of the base was already highly developed with the aforementioned features, decorative houses, and a very rudimentary mob grinder. When IamTUNA arrived, he set up a more efficient double grinder and began work on a tower wheat farm, that was ultimately uncompleted. The base had been visited by a number of individuals, newfags and oldfags alike, and was largely ungriefed until jared2013 took it upon himself to destroy the base for reasons unknown (his reasons wildly differ every time he's asked). Initially, he blamed the user ashnwill, however Jared's treachery was soon revealed.

Willing to work past this issue with Jared, DemonElite and IamTUNA opted to start a new base called Yiffington II located at a nearby triple grinder and underground water temple, however personality clashes between DemonElite119 and Jared (usually threats by Jared) resulted in DemonElite giving the player SilverKrownKing coordinates to the new location so that he could turn the base into a crater. The reason for giving SilverKrownKing coordinates was also fueled by the revalation that despite Jared's behavior and dissolution of their group, Jared had only disabled, not destroyed the mob spawners as he claimed and it was evident Jared would return to use the mob grinder.

name: Farm Town
description: Offtopia established Farm Town after the fall of Rainbow Islands. The Archive dates its establishment to late 2011 or early 2012. Its current warp, Farm_Town_2017-11, is labeled November 2017.

name: Viper Outpost
description: StneCldKilla built Viper Outpost. The Archive dates its establishment to mid-2017 and preserves a December 3 download.

name: Flashpoint
description: Flashpoint was a Watchmen spawn-base event site. The Archive dates its establishment to April 7, 2021 and preserves a download from the following day.

name: Point Dory
description:
Point Dory was the official base of the +X Digging Group after the destruction of the border outpost,Point Nemo. The base lasted for around two months until it was leaked by one of its members. It was visited by FitMC, leading up to a new drama involving him.

Point Dory was founded mere days after the destruction of Point Nemo by Babbaj, almost all of the remaining trusted members of the Nether Highway Group joined the base over the next 2 weeks. The base was one of the largest ever on 2b2t, both in player count and size.

Point Dory fell due to drama with basemate xxq. After multiple attempts of him destroying parts of the Hall of Heroes, xxq ran off on his own. When he was eventually questioned about why he left, he blamed his various basemates for harassing him. After weeks of uncertainty, xxq caved in all that he knew and it was revealed that his account NTTWestJPN was an alt shared with jared2013.

MiningMinecraft also discovered that his copy, the only copy of Mein Kampf 121 and iTristan's 32k leggings were missing. xxq decided to share coordinates of jared2013's base. MiningMinecraft and Joeilk proceeded to raid the base in the dead of night and steal back Mein Kampf 121. Tristan's 32k leggings were recovered from one of xxq's shulkers and the group gathered to decide on xxq's fate. After days of deliberation, it was decided by Byrnsy that xxq would be kicked from the group and base.

Days later, the coords to the base were then publicly leaked by xxq and Point Dory was griefed days later by Babbaj and Nordic93. A battle during the griefing ensued where Joeilk and MiningMinecraft killed Babbaj, sending him to spawn but Nordic93 managed to escape the defenders and combat logged. The base was then destroyed later that day once the defenders logged off.

name: Spic Town
description: Spic Town was an Emperium base, according to the Archive. The preserved warp is undated.

name: Wintermelon
description: Wintermelon was founded by Toshie and Vaxent in 2016 after leaving Acacia. It developed from a tower and underground storage area into a large group base with numerous individual builds. After its destruction in March 2017, members moved on to Summermelon. The Archive preserves a July 3, 2017 version of the site; its founding-date label differs from the October date in the published history.

name: Avalonia
description: Avalonia was the Avalonian Republic’s planned island city, divided by a canal and organized into building plots. Its builders included Noah3j, TimeRapier, Rex1258, Elijah204, Marcus4761 and Xapamaa. The wiki dates its beginning to March 13, 2020, while the Archive gives May 2. The preserved download is dated August 10; the base was destroyed on August 12 after its coordinates were exposed through Nocom.

name: l19w06's End Lodge
description:
This SpawnMasons lodge in the End was built by ufocrossing, Negative_Entropy, policemike55, BoomerangVillage and Terbin. The Archive records the lodge under February 9, 2019 at X 1,750, Z 488.

This earlier Atlas entry describes the same lodge as The l19w06 in End (record 1596). Use record 1596 for the preserved Archive world download and render. This entry records Y 64; the Archive warp on record 1596 records Y 1. The different stored heights do not identify a separate build.

name: Swamp Base
description: Swamp Base was founded by Fiskie and xcc2 in late 2011 after they left NFE. In xcc2's account, they chose new swamp terrain and expanded the base into 2012; policemike built a cobblestone generator beneath the main storage building. The base had a substantial railway, documented in xcc2's tours. The Archive preserves a February 21, 2012 capture.

name: Melopia
description: ZeroCoolX and FuzedUltra built Melopia. The Archive dates its establishment to August 30, 2016 and preserves a download labeled the fourth quarter of 2018.

name: ONIV
description: ONIV was a Nihongun base established in March 2021, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated March 15.

name: Lifeisgood72's Snowbase
description: A few buildings inside a snow biome made by Lifeisgood72.

name: The New Rainbow Islands
description: The New Rainbow Islands, also called Rainbow Republic, was a Team Rainbow base. The Archive dates its establishment to December 20, 2017; its current warp is labeled April 28, 2018. Team Rainbow’s history identifies it as one of the group’s bases before the later Rainbow Forest project.

name: Elysium 2
description: Elysium II was the Elysium group’s ice-spikes base, farther from spawn than its first settlement. Carlll_ and Lil_Remains66 led the group during its lifetime. The Archive gives a December 9, 2019 founding date, while the group history gives December 21. The preserved download is dated June 26, 2020; the base was destroyed on July 9.

name: Chongfuer 2
description: Chongfuer 2 was a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to July 22, 2021 and records abandonment and its preserved download on September 11.

name: Lost Nomad Games V
description: The Lost Nomads held their fifth Nomad Games at a venue featuring Franknificant’s cathedral design. The event history dates the gathering to July 31, 2021. The Archive records the venue’s establishment on July 23 and preserves an August 1 download. This is distinct from Franknificant’s later Duomo Cathedral wedding build.

name: Leafium
description: Semi-public End base located on a hyperlinked gateway at the -X world border. Submitted by Chess James.

name: cutecurly's City (2025)
description: Base render ingested from TwinkNet/2b2tmuseum-WDL public archive.

name: Fusionia I
description: Fusion09a built Fusionia I. The Archive dates its establishment to October 20, 2024 and preserves a March 28, 2025 download.

name: The Coliseum
description: The Coliseum was a Sun Knights base, according to the Archive. Its warp is dated May 4, 2022, but its menu gives September 20, 2022 as the establishment date. Those dates conflict, so its chronology remains unconfirmed.

name: Nether Highway Inn
description: mdo_ and EntityChan built the Nether Highway Inn. The Archive dates both its establishment and preserved download to August 25, 2023.

name: Bedrock City
description: The original Bedrock City was founded by usuriousberry39 in November 2022. Its builders recreated designs made in Minecraft: Bedrock Edition on 2b2t using schematics. It was destroyed in June 2023, before the later numbered Bedrock City bases. The Archive dates its establishment to November 14 and preserves a June 15, 2023 download.

name: High Garden
description: Ski_Lmoa built High Garden. The Archive dates its establishment to March 15, 2025 and preserves a July 25 download.

name: Spawnfuer 37
description: Spawnfuer 37 was a DonFuer base established on February 3, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 5.

name: Midnight Council 2022
description: HermeticLock organized the first Midnight Council in late 2022. Participants left their equipment behind and built a camp together using locally gathered materials, with themed ceremonies and a custom resource pack. FitMC documented his participation in a January 2023 video. The Archive dates the site’s establishment to December 6 and preserves a December 30, 2022 download.

name: Sky Masons
description: Sky Masons was a SpawnMasons megabase established in 2020 near 827,065, 439,090. The Archive warps identify individual islands and builds within the shared base.

name: Melongrad
description: Melongrad was a Melon Men base established on October 1, 2024, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated November 10.

name: Throne of the Ancients
description: P529 built Throne of the Ancients for a SpawnMasons lodge, according to the Archive. Its current Archive warp is labeled June 25, 2022.

name: MoLaST
description: MoLaST, the Museum of Larpy and Shiny Things, was founded by Beardler and Osmobyte to preserve collectibles and original blocks from other bases. Steampunkjax designed the main museum structure, Durkaaqt supplied materials, and Beardler and Osmobyte carried out much of the construction. The museum remained unfinished and was self-griefed in August 2022. The Archive preserves an August 23 download; its January establishment date differs from the February date in the published history.

name: +Z 4M Milestone
description: This location includes Overworld and Nether saved worlds. The Overworld capture is archived as z4m_2018-12-07. The Nether view is also known as Nether +Z 500k Milestone, near X 0, Z 499,988. This milestone is near Nether Z 500,000, corresponding to Overworld Z 4,000,000. The Archive preserves a January 11, 2018 download.

name: Astralis II
description: Astralis II, also called Pearl Harbor, was a Civitas base established on April 15, 2025, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 18.

name: Nether +X 15.8M Milestone
description: This milestone is near Nether X 15,800,000. The Archive’s comparison to Overworld X 126,400,000 is a theoretical eightfold distance beyond the normal Overworld border. The preserved download is dated April 4, 2021.

name: -X 20M Milestone
description: This location includes Overworld and Nether saved worlds. The Nether capture is archived as Nether -X 2.5M Milestone, at X -2,499,984, Z 1. The Archive preserves captures in both dimensions dated 2019-08-25.

name: Emfinity I
description: Emfinity I was an Imperial Empire base established on April 28, 2025, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated October 4.

name: iO Ominous Bottle farm
description: 1021111 built this ominous bottle farm, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 28, 2025; the catalog does not give an establishment date.

name: Eleanor Rigby
description: The Archive dates Eleanor Rigby’s establishment to August 30, 2023 and preserves a September 4 download.

name: +X 800k / +Z 800k Milestone
description: The Archive identifies a carrot farm at this milestone near X 800,000, Z 800,000. Its preserved download is dated December 6, 2017.

name: -X 16M Milestone
description: This record covers the milestone near Overworld X -16,000,000 and its corresponding Nether milestone near X -2,000,000. The Archive preserves both dimensional views under November 27, 2017.

name: SCC Monument (Nether +X 3.57M)
description: This SCC monument is near Nether X 3,570,000, corresponding to Overworld X 28,560,000. The Archive preserves an April 9, 2017 download.

name: +X 6M Milestone
description: Miguelo4001 built the giant lavacast at this milestone near X 6,000,000, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated December 14, 2017.

name: U Retil
description: U Retil was a DonFuer base established on April 1, 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 19.

name: Miraculum
description: Miraculum was an Emperium base established on July 28, 2025, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated August 23.

name: Block Game Babylon
description: Block Game Babylon was a Block Gamers base established in October 2021 and destroyed in April 2023. Joey_Coconut helped revive it with new builders after an inactive period. Its builds included the Ishtar Arch and central Etemananke ziggurat, whose exterior patterns Cpybara helped design, and Warske’s Russian Orthodox church in the mountains. The project remained separate from Astral Brotherhood despite members participating in both. The Archive preserves an April 23, 2023 download.

name: SBA Christmas Hide and Seek 2023
description: This was a Spawn Builders Association Christmas hide-and-seek event venue. The Archive records it under December 23, 2023.

name: VEA farm base
description: This Vapepens Elite Alliance farm base was established in November 2023, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 7, 2024.

name: Rain Solo Base
description: RainMotorsports built Rain Solo Base. The Archive’s warp is dated August 21, 2021, but its menu gives July 2022 as the establishment date. Those dates conflict, so the build’s chronology remains unconfirmed.

name: -X 1M Milestone
description: This milestone is near X -1,000,000. The Archive dates the site’s establishment to 2013 and preserves August 29, 2015 and March 2, 2018 downloads. Its 2018 catalog entry credits DocSmurf.

name: Nether +X 3.275M Milestone
description: This milestone is near Nether X 3,275,000, corresponding to Overworld X 26,200,000. Its current Archive warp is labeled December 28, 2017.

name: Sun Town
description: Sun Town was an Astral Brotherhood recruit base built from mid-January to late April 2025. The group published both construction footage and a showcase of the finished base.

name: Eraclata
description: Eraclata was an Imperial Empire base established on May 13, 2024, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 18.

name: The RomaL has joined server
description: RomaL_FurnoI built this Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to August 28, 2023 and preserves an August 16, 2025 download.

The 2b2t Wiki names Jaydon as winner and describes a suit-and-banquet celebration with about 80 attendees. Its separate Osmobyte biography credits him with work on both this arena and Pit Fight 12.

The Archive dates the venue's establishment to March 2023 and preserves a March 7 download. That date identifies the saved build; an exact tournament date, winner and prize list have not been verified in the available event sources.

name: PitFight 12: One Year Event
description:
This venue hosted Obscension’s twelfth PitFight event. Its arena recreated Hunted from Call of Duty: Black Ops III, and past winners competed for the prize. The Archive preserves the venue under April 8, 2022, calling it the One Year Event.

The 2b2t Wiki names SyndicateNA as the $200 winner. In a contemporary Reddit thread posted on May 1, the organizer reported 107 players and thanked the community for a year of support. This was presented as the series' one-year celebration.

Warske and Blaksaber began its street grid, with a tower inspired by Stuttgart’s television tower as the centerpiece. Members added factories, houses, high-rises, a railway and an elevated highway. Warske’s cinematic retrospective describes roughly ten builders working over three months. The Archive preserves a May 20 download, shortly before the May 21 grief recorded by the 2b2t Wiki.

name: Killaqueen123 funeral
description: This was the venue for Outlast’s Killaqueen123 funeral event in the End. The Archive records the in-game event in October 2023 and preserves an October 22 download.

name: Sun Knights Recruits Base 25
description: This was a Sun Knights recruit base, preserved in an Archive download labeled February 16, 2024. The Archive calls it Recruit Base 25; the founding date remains uncertain because the catalog and the group’s wiki history place R25 in different periods.

name: SBA Crimus
description: SBA Crimus was a Spawn Builders Association Christmas base. The Archive preserves a December 26, 2022 download.

name: on Lava Island
description: McNeo built this SpawnMasons lodge on Lava Island. The Archive records it under March 17, 2018.

name: Pit Fight 2
description:
This was the arena for Obscension’s second Pit Fight event in June 2021. Decorative buildings surrounded a fighting pit at bedrock level. The 2b2t Wiki dates the tournament to June 20 and names SyndicateNA as its winner. The Archive preserves an earlier June 14 download of the venue.

The organizer posted a thank-you recap on June 21, providing a contemporary reference for the second event. The older listing called Pit Fight: Arena is approximately one block away horizontally and has the same June 14 warp date, suggesting another catalog record for this venue rather than an additional numbered tournament.

name: VEA 1 Year Anniversary
description: This base marked the first anniversary of Vapepens Elite Alliance. The Archive dates its establishment to February 11, 2024 and preserves a February 12 download.

name: Nintendo Switch
description: Todarac built Nintendo Switch for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under February 15, 2020.

name: Outlast Yodie Court 2
description: Outlast Yodie Court 2 was an Outlast event venue in the End. The Archive records the event and preserved download under November 23, 2024.

name: Time is Running Out (The Isle)
description: Time is Running Out is a SpawnMason lodge at The Isle in the End. The marker is its own Archive warp arrival point. The available world download and 2D/3D renders include the surrounding Isle and neighboring lodges, which is why several lodge pages show the same island. Their separate Archive warp names and catalog dates are retained.

name: SBA 28 5

name: Boyland rebuild

name: The Safe

name: Hangover Base

name: Premature annihilation
description: LordNo built Premature Annihilation for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records the lodge under August 29, 2020.

name: Gravity Falls
description: WarLordN1k built Gravity Falls for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under September 19, 2020.

name: Sky

name: Purple Lodge
description: Jumbo_Warrior built Purple Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under April 22, 2017.

name: WAHO 2
description: The Archive dates WAHO 2’s establishment to September 13, 2025 and preserves an October 13 download. Its builders are not identified in the catalog entry.

name: JAM VEA Event Base
description: This JAM–VEA event base was established on June 20, 2023, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated July 1.

name: Rusher Day
description: This Rusher Day lodge was at NewLoo. The Archive records the SpawnMasons gathering under May 27, 2023; it is separate from the 2020 Rusher Victorious monument.

name: Fort Deeck
description: Fort Deeck was a castle near a diagonal spawn highway, with an extensive underground section. In his firsthand restoration account, OverFloyd identifies Tomteglog and Hallucigenias as its original April 2012 builders. OverFloyd and TheMlgFox restored it in August 2019, with additions by visitors including timetoerist, T3mpar and xcc2. The restored fort was griefed on August 24, 2019; the Archive preserves an August 21 download.

name: CreamTown 4 tempmap
description: CreamTown 4 was a Vapepens Elite Alliance base on the September 2024 Minecraft 1.21 temporary map. The Archive dates it to September 10, separately from the permanent 2b2t world.

name: Sheep Arena Lodge
description: Sheep Arena Lodge was part of the 2023 rebuilding and expansion of Fort Concord. The Archive records the SpawnMasons lodge under June 24, 2023.

name: Forest Lodge
description: _m_o_t_h_r_a_ built Forest Lodge at Rat House. The Archive records this SpawnMasons lodge under July 17, 2021.

name: Bedrock Time Travel Lodge
description: Bedrock Time Travel Lodge was built at the SpawnMasons’ 2023 guest base. The Archive records the lodge under September 30, 2023.

name: Scout Camp 1
description: Scout Camp 1 was an Order of the Arrow base. The Archive dates its establishment to September 23, 2023 and preserves an October 1 download.

name: Loo Lodge Five
description: Loo Lodge Five was a SpawnMasons lodge at NewLoo. The Archive preserves it under February 11, 2023, separately from the earlier Loo lodges near spawn.

name: Ghastling Nest
description: Breithan built Ghastling Nest for the SpawnMasons. The Archive identifies the original lodge as a Nether build and records it under July 30, 2022.

name: Fighters Mapart Meetup
description: DarkXL6 and Rathause built the outpost for the Fighters map-art meetup in April 2020. The associated group project recreated Minecraft’s Fighters painting as map art, led by villicool112. DarkXL6’s original announcement credits the individual map artists and links photographs of the meetup. The Archive preserves the outpost in an April 27 download.

name: SBA Duck Hunt Event
description: BryceDey built this Duck Hunt event site for the Spawn Builders Association. The Archive dates its establishment to September 21, 2023 and preserves a September 24 download.

name: 19k
description: 19k is the original Trading Post community site on the Southern Canal. The wiki describes _OGKush_ setting up a trading shop near Z 19,000 in late December 2024, followed by other traders and repeated rebuilding after griefs. The Archive dates its establishment to January 20, 2025, while the wiki describes the earlier beginnings of the trading activity. The preserved download is dated February 22, 2025.

name: Loo Lodge Six
description: Loo Lodge Six was a SpawnMasons lodge at NewLoo, preserved under February 3, 2024. It is separate from the earlier Loo lodges near spawn.

description: Nekramite built Vine Carriage as part of Taichung Railway Station. The Archive records it as a SpawnMasons lodge under July 11, 2020.

description: Dawsomite and PopeViper built the Garden of Eden near Z -56,000. The Archive dates its establishment to May 2017 and preserves a January 29, 2018 download.

description: Prismarine Fortress was built by xcc2. The Archive records the original in 2015 and later rebuilds in 2017, 2018 and 2019. FitMC's Postwar Party video tours the fortress.

name: Satanic Sacrificial Island
description: Todarac built Satanic Sacrificial Island at Rat House. The Archive records it as a SpawnMasons lodge under August 14, 2021.

name: SBA 40
description: SBA 40 was a Spawn Builders Association base preserved in an August 10, 2022 download. The 2b2t Wiki records Warske building a Japanese-themed tower here after DanDucky invited him to the group that summer.

name: Spawnfuer S2 A
description: Spawnfuer S2 A was a DonFuer base established on November 28, 2022, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated December 7, 2022.

description: SBA 35 was a Spawn Builders Association base established in June 2022, according to the Archive.

name: HK and Vertz Wedding: Part 2
description: This was the second venue for HK and Vertz’s 2022 wedding event, centered on Franknificant’s Duomo Cathedral. The 2b2t Wiki also credits KitNightingale, MrAllNet, Forceken, Gravixious and Svenn_Svenn with the cathedral. FitMC’s account covers the first venue’s destruction, construction of this replacement, and the second ceremony being attacked.

name: Flashback
description: dr_frankfurt built Flashback for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under September 9, 2017.

name: BackstreetBoys Summer Spawnbase
description: This Backstreet Boys summer spawnbase was established on August 2, 2022, according to the Archive.

name: 25k Pyramid (+X 25k / +Z 25k)
description: The 25k Pyramid stood near X 25,500, Z 25,500. The Archive describes it as a well-known base from before the June 2016 influx and preserves a February 10, 2017 download.

name: HermeticLock Castle Lodge
description: HermeticLock built this castle lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under December 2, 2017.

name: Scoutbase Lodge
description: Negative_Entropy, ufocrossing and Terbin built Scoutbase Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under May 25, 2019.

name: Kang and Kodos
description: Krobar01 built Kang and Kodos for the SpawnMasons. The Archive dates it to May 2018 and preserves it under the May 24 lodge entry.

name: Pit Fight 16
description:
Pit Fight 16 is an Obscension arena preserved in an August 5, 2023 Archive download. The saved world shows a broad circular fighting platform over water, with a dark floor, an orange center and branching orange patterns inside a pale outer rim. Nearby island builds include oversized red and purple mushrooms and a golden ring.

These features describe the surviving build rather than a verified official theme title. The available sources do not establish a winner, prize list or exact tournament day; August 5 is the date of the preserved world.

name: Mirror Lodge
description: Breithan built Mirror Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under February 8, 2020.

name: SBA 54
description: SBA 54 was a Spawn Builders Association base in the End. The Archive dates its establishment to July 2023 and preserves a July 20 download.

name: Valley of Melons
description: The current Archive warp for Valley of Melons is labeled Valley_of_Melons_2014_restore, identifying a restoration rather than an untouched view of the ruins. Its catalog tentatively dates the base’s establishment to that year; the exact founding date and builders remain unconfirmed.

name: SBS Spawn Base
description: SBS Spawn Base was established on February 17, 2022, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated December 12, 2022.

name: G I S screenshot event
description: i13d1x built the Global Impact Squad screenshot-event base, established in May 2023 according to the Archive. The 2b2t Wiki also lists the GIS Screenshot Event among Vapepens Elite Alliance bases.

name: Isle of Peace
description: Etbes built Isle of Peace for the Emperium. The Archive dates its establishment to March 14, 2024 and preserves a July 17 download.

name: Christmas Tree at spawn
description: Negative_Entropy built the Christmas Tree at Spawn. The Archive preserves downloads from December 31, 2022 and December 25, 2023.

description: P5 Appreciation was a SpawnMasons lodge preserved under October 19, 2024. Nasderius includes the lodge in his portfolio of 2b2t builds.

name: Geezer Town 15
description: Geezer Town 15 was a Graybeard Geezers base established on November 2, 2024, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated November 21.

name: LLEH (-X 66k / +Z 66k)
description: LLEH was a base of the Order of Lucifer near X -66,000, Z 66,000. The Archive dates its establishment to August 2017 and preserves a download from August 25.

description: SunPolis was the Sun Knights’ 19th recruits base. The Archive dates its establishment to April 4, 2023 and preserves a May 4 download.

name: Ice chapel
description: D_Loaded built Ice Chapel for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the May 16, 2020 lodge entry.

name: Mothgolian Yurtwagon
description: Mothgolian Yurtwagon was a SpawnMasons lodge at Spawn Migration. The Archive preserves it under November 12, 2022.

name: SBA 57
description: SBA 57 was the Spawn Builders Association’s 2023 Halloween base, established on October 9 according to the Archive. It hosted the grand finale of the wider October 2023 Halloween route, whose event report gives coordinates matching this site.

name: Bridge Lodge
description: Todarac built Bridge Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive dates its establishment to May 20, 2023, which is also the date in its current warp label.

name: Yacht
