name: Underwater Baby Box at 00
description: Breithan, Lunch_Katsu and Negative_Entropy built Underwater Baby Box 0 0 for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under December 3, 2022.

name: SBA 43: Greggsmas
description: Greggsmas was the Spawn Builders Association’s 43rd base, preserved in a November 6, 2022 download. Its Ice Cathedral was designed by -[Rr]-dRock and MajorasEnd for the 2022 celebration, using snow, ice, packed ice and blue stained glass.

name: Keky Base tempmap
description: Keky Base was built on the March 2018 temporary map. The Archive preserves it under March 23, 2018, separately from the permanent 2b2t world.

name: Grass Hill
description: Ain and iTavux built Grass Hill for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the September 23, 2017 lodge entry.

name: Halloweenfuer
description: Halloweenfuer was a DonFuer base established on October 27, 2024, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated October 29.

name: Walking Library
description: FifthDegree built Walking Library at Spawn Migration. The Archive records it as the SpawnMasons lodge for November 5, 2022.

name: SBA 51
description: This was the 51st Spawn Builders Association base, established in April 2023 according to the Archive.

name: LaSpawnbase
description: La Spawnbase was established on April 23, 2022, according to the Archive. The preserved download is dated September 4, 2022.

name: Emperium Pit Fight 4
description:
Emperium Pit Fight 4 used a serpent-themed arena over the water. A huge red snake coils above a ring of pale classical columns surrounding a circular, stepped fighting platform; dark purple discs and Emperium's emblem frame the build. The organizer's August 24, 2025 recap identifies the photographed venue as the fourth event.

The Archive preserves the arena in an August 22 download. The recap confirms that the event had happened by August 24, but does not supply a precise tournament day, winner or prize list. The same distinctive serpent arena appears in the organizer's later gallery of the series.

name: Machu Kekchu
description: Lifeisgood72 built Machu Kekchu on the 1.12 temporary map. The Archive preserves it under July 10, 2017, separately from the permanent 2b2t world.

name: Bollywood 1 16 test server
description: Bollywood was built on the 1.16 test server in March 2021. This download preserves that test-server build, rather than a site on the permanent 2b2t world.

name: 2b2t Oscars 2022
description: This was the venue for the 2022 2b2t Oscars. The Archive credits Franknificant with the build, while the 2b2t Wiki identifies the venue as a recreation of Royal Albert Hall built with Bookhood. A recording of the event is preserved on Jake Lord’s channel.

name: Emperium Pit Fight 2
description:
Emperium's second Pit Fight used an Easter-themed arena, with enormous brown and white rabbits, decorated eggs and flowers beside a round fighting enclosure. Emperium's omega-and-wreath emblem rises above the scene. A participant posted an arena photograph on April 19, 2025, describing joining the fight and staying to watch after using their totems.

The Archive dates the event build and preserved download to April 19. The same rabbit-and-egg venue appears among earlier arenas in the organizer's June promotion and September 2026 retrospective. A winner and prize list have not been verified from those posts.

name: Black Forest Cake
description: Black Forest Cake, also known as The Blacksite, was a Cakemasons base established on March 6, 2023. The Archive credits nickcat1; the 2b2t Wiki also records Kizzycocoa building there with the Cakemasons.

name: SBA 28: Lean
description: Lean was the 28th Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2022.

name: Wässrige Hölle
description: Wässrige Hölle, or Watery Hell, was an Emperium base in the Nether, established in August 2019 according to the Archive. It is separate from the later Wässrige Hölle Zwei.

name: VEA Pimp My Village
description: Pimp My Village was a Vapepens Elite Alliance event base established in October 2024, according to the Archive.

name: Minecraft 10 Year Anniversary
description: SalC1's May 2019 SpawnMason lodge celebrated Minecraft's tenth anniversary. His showcase discusses grass colors, building materials and world generation, and credits Todarac for helping with the build.

name: Loo Lodge too
description: BoomerangVillage built Loo Lodge too for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under February 1, 2020, separate from the original 2019 Loo Lodge.

name: Sun Knights Recruits base 1
description: This was the first Sun Knights recruits base, established in February 2022 according to the Archive. It is separate from the second recruits base, also dated to that month.

name: Loo Lodge
description: BoomerangVillage built Loo Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under January 26, 2019; it is distinct from the later Loo Lodge too.

name: 19 06 15 Dark Oak Spleef
description: l_amp built Dark Oak Spleef for the SpawnMasons. The Archive records it under the June 15, 2019 lodge entry.

name: SBA 74
description: SBA 74 was a Spawn Builders Association base established on June 21, 2025, according to the Archive. An August 4, 2025 post by builder renovatedarrays shared an image of the base and its coordinates, describing it as a place to meet and build with other players.

name: Upside Down Logo
description: ufocrossing built Upside Down Logo for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the January 11, 2020 lodge entry.

name: Quarantine
description: ufocrossing built Quarantine for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the March 21, 2020 lodge entry.

name: Grimace lodge
description: Grimace Lodge was a SpawnMasons lodge at Spawn Migration 2, preserved under the August 5, 2023 lodge entry.

name: Lamps Lodge
description: smcz19 built Lamps Lodge at Rat Hause. The Archive records it as the SpawnMasons lodge for August 7, 2021.

name: He duck army
description: Todarac built He-duck Army for the SpawnMasons, recorded in the Archive under December 17, 2022. The surrounding Duck Army area later became a stop on the October 2023 Halloween route, whose organizers also credited Todarac.

name: Emperium Pit Fight 1
description:
The first Emperium Pit Fight arena was a dark castle over the water, with purple pointed roofs around a circular fighting pit and a large dragon above the entrance. Purple accents, hanging banners and Emperium's omega-and-wreath emblem gave the venue a consistent black-and-purple appearance. The build is visible in the preserved world and in the organizer's later gallery of the series.

The Archive preserves a January 11, 2025 download. That date identifies the saved arena; the exact event day, winner and prizes have not been independently verified. This is the first venue in Emperium's later series, not Obscension's original 2021 Pit Fight.

name: Cobblestone Timeloop
description: OverFloyd and Negative_Entropy built Cobblestone Timeloop for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the September 12, 2020 lodge entry.

name: Spawnquarium catflushed
description: This SpawnMasons lodge formed part of the SpawnQuarium project in the Spawn Water Cube. The Archive records it under March 25, 2023. The wider event brought together several building groups to fill the water cube with aquatic builds; the event report lists the SpawnMasons among the participants.

name: Sun Knights Recruits base 2
description: This was the second Sun Knights recruits base, established in February 2022 according to the Archive. It is separate from the first recruits base, also dated to that month.

name: VoCo Christmas Base
description: This Vortex Coalition Christmas base was established in December 2019. The Archive credits Rathaus and TheQracken with the build.

name: Bigbong Lodge
description: ufocrossing built Bigbong Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the April 18, 2020 lodge entry.

name: Chunk Ravine Caverns
description: DarkXL6 built Chunk Ravine Caverns at Chunk Haven. The Archive records it as the SpawnMasons lodge for April 10, 2021.

name: Poker Lodge
description: Zippietwo built Poker Lodge for the SpawnMasons. The Archive preserves it under the May 22, 2021 lodge entry.

name: Fountain of Youth
description: Negative_Entropy and DarkXL6 built the Fountain of Youth lodge at Chunk Haven, recorded in the Archive under May 8, 2021. Negative_Entropy includes the fountain in a Pirates of the Caribbean scene with the Black Pearl and the Trench of Poseidon; the builder gallery describes the project as built in survival on 2b2t.

name: 2b2t DOT Mobile Warehouse Road Construction Unit
description: The 2b2t DOT Mobile Warehouse Road Construction Unit was a SpawnMasons lodge at Spawn Migration 2, recorded under July 15, 2023.

description: Breithan built Polly Parrot at the 2020 Christmas Party Base. The Archive records it as the SpawnMasons lodge for December 19, 2020.

description: Negative_Entropy built this Victorian birdhouse at Chunk Haven. The Archive records it as a SpawnMasons lodge from December 2020.

name: Underground Obsidian Arena
description: The Underground Obsidian Arena was a SpawnMasons lodge built by dryg_, preserved under the Archive's January 27, 2018 lodge entry.

name: NTE
description: NTE, short for Negative Twohundred Eighthundred, was established by Dima788 on April 22, 2022, according to the Archive.

description: Warlordn1k and SalC1 built this recreation of Minecraft's pack.png scene at Chunk Haven. The Archive identifies it as the SpawnMasons lodge for October 3, 2020.

description: The Temple of the Molten Rock was a Nether lodge built by EnigmA_008 for the SpawnMasons. It is preserved under the Archive's January 21, 2023 lodge entry.

name: Waffle Hize
description: Waffle Hize was a Geocaching Collective base established on March 29, 2025, according to the Archive.

name: Fallout: Equestria tunnel
description: rebane2001 built this tunnel to display Fallout: Equestria on Minecraft signs. The project began as a test of a mod that wrote text files onto signs and expanded into a transcription of the complete novel. SalC1's May 2021 visit documents the tunnel near the ruins of DonFuer, its chapter divisions and rest stops, and the automated repair system used to restore damaged signs.

name: Spawnfuer s2 b
description: Spawnfuer s2-b was a DonFuer base established on July 13, 2022, according to the Archive.

name: Taichung Railway Station
description: Taichung Railway Station was a SpawnMasons lodge built by Negative_Entropy and other participants on August 22, 2020. Its station building recreates the exterior of the old railway station in Taichung, Taiwan. Negative_Entropy published a gallery and schematic of the project. The current Archive warp is labeled August 22, 2020.

name: The l22w44 catflushed cutest couple watch birth of their interracial baby from a surrogate mother
description: This SpawnMasons lodge was built at the 2022 Halloween Party Base. The Archive preserves it under the October 29, 2022 lodge entry.

name: Notre Dame
description: This Notre Dame was a SpawnMasons lodge built by EntropyAnnDroid, preserved under the May 4, 2019 lodge entry. It is separate from the Notre Dame projects at other Atlas locations.

name: SpawnQuarium
description: SpawnQuarium was a community aquarium in the Spawn Water Cube, led by The Ancients with the Spawn Builders Association, Astral Brotherhood, Bookhood, The Last Templar and SpawnMasons. In his March 2023 announcement, xrayessay credited 42 participants with over 100 sea-creature builds. The project spanned two months of planning and construction, with the survival builds placed over 16 days. YoMoBoYo proposed the event, and RulesOff organized its execution and supplied materials. The Archive preserves a March 28, 2023 download.

name: Derpy Build
description: Derpy Build is deaddreamer's build also known as Giant Robot Head. xcc2's 2018 retrospective explicitly identifies the two names as the same structure and describes restoring it in November 2016. The Archive preserves multiple versions, including a 2019 Halloween edition.

name: Passie's Dirt Mansion
description: Passie's Dirt Mansion is a repeatedly rebuilt project credited to passie05 in the Archive. FitMC's October 8, 2016 livestream documents the mansion before the Archive's listed 2017 establishment year, so that year should not be treated as its original founding date. Preserved Archive entries explicitly identify rebuilds from 2018 and 2019.

name: Giant Robot Head
description: Giant Robot Head, also known as Derpy Build, was built by deaddreamer. In a 2018 retrospective, xcc2 describes finding it in 2015 and restoring it in November 2016. HermeticLock also lived there for a time, and the build underwent several repairs before a destructive grief about a year later. The Archive preserves later snapshots as well, including a 2019 Halloween edition.

name: Tortellini City 2
description: Tortellini City 2 was established in late 2016 by NickHasCancer and BenitoTortellini, according to the Archive.

name: wouowo's base one
description: wouowo established this first base in early January 2017, according to the Archive.

name: The Colossus Cathedral
description: The Colossus Cathedral appears in Archive snapshots from 2017 and 2019. The 2019 entry credits OverFloyd with expanding the structure; it does not identify the original builder.

name: Freyr's Shadow
description: Freyr's Shadow was established in March 2019 by IamU, XentricCrafter and Kirk31, according to the Archive.

name: The Nether Fortress in overworld
description: DarkAlly123 built this Nether-fortress project in the Overworld. The Archive dates its establishment to April 7, 2016.

name: UB NOX Christmas event 2
description: This was the second United Builders and NOX Christmas event base. The Archive dates its establishment to December 9, 2024.

name: Roma
description: Roma was a United Builders base established on January 5, 2025, according to the Archive.

name: Edark's Volkano and Balloon Edark's 2013 base

name: zexesl2 base
description: This base dates to 2012 and was later restored by xcc2, according to the Archive. The restoration credit is separate from the original base attribution to zexesl2.

name: Newbase v2
description: Newbase v2 was a spawn base created by 0xymoron to give new players somewhere to settle and encourage them to stay on the server. The Archive dates it to 2013 and records that around 50 players lived there at one point. It also identifies this as the place TheCampingRusher encountered in his first 2b2t video.

name: BackstreetBoys Christmas Base
description: This was the Backstreet Boys Christmas base of December 2019. It is distinct from the group's earlier Christmas base of 2018.

name: Jack's Tower
description: Jack's Tower was a SpawnMasons lodge built by Jacktherippa, preserved under the Archive's July 29, 2017 lodge entry.

name: Pit Fight 5: High Charity
description:
High Charity was the End-dimension arena for Pitfight V, held on September 18, 2021. Franknificant designed the structure after the Halo setting of the same name, using more than 600,000 blocks of obsidian. The Archive identifies it as an Obscension event; the 2b2t Wiki records BIKMUNNI as the tournament winner.

The build also carried its Halo theme inside: Franknificant's documented building history describes furnished rooms contributed by other builders and a machine by Roy4lRondi that played the Halo theme. An1meTiddie, KitNightingale, MrAllNet and GodoftheOceans are credited among the collaborators. Contemporary posts on September 19 and 20 thanked players and builders after the event.

The Archive's preserved world is dated September 18, 2021. This is Obscension's Halo-inspired End venue, separate from Emperium's later Pit Fight series.

name: Pyramid of Resilience
description: The Pyramid of Resilience is a separate monument associated with the Valley of Wheat restoration community, about 6,818 blocks west of the valley. Terbin's Archive icon notes describe it as a commemorative build and a farewell to a departing member. The Archive landing is X 6824.8014, Y 129.7429, Z 0.1395 in the Overworld. The warp is dated 2021-06-13, while its icon notes refer to the 2022 restoration project; that date conflict remains unresolved. Related location: https://2b2tatlas.com/location/1092. name: Popbob's Mushroom Island
description: Popbob's Mushroom Island is an early base dated to 2012 in the Archive, with a separate jungle section to the east. FitMC's November 2020 visit documents the ruined island, surviving jungle structures and nearby artificial End portals. The 2b2t Wiki discusses the site among the surviving traces of the server's first backdoor.

name: Void Caverns
description: Void Caverns was BarrenDome's underground excavation and building project. In a February 2018 tour, he described hollowing out an area roughly 250 by 250 blocks and about 50 blocks deep using TNT-duplicating flying machines, with plans inspired by Skyrim's Blackreach. His September 2019 museum tour shows two floors designed to display up to 1,800 items, including ordinary Minecraft items and collections specific to 2b2t.

name: Camp Nimbus
description: Camp Nimbus was a United Builders base built by _Porridge_. The Archive dates its establishment to February 18, 2025.

name: Sternenfall

name: wouowo's base two

name: North Pole
description: North Pole was a Christmas-themed group base established in August 2017. The Archive credits iTavux. Negative_Entropy documented their wooden Christmas stable at the base in an August 2017 Planet Minecraft gallery, which also credits iTavux.

name: Doughnut Base
description: Doughnut Base was built by wakwak90, with construction beginning in May 2019 according to the Archive. Its large circular glass structure surrounded a monumental Jesus statue. In an October 2019 Reddit showcase, the builder described it as largely a solo project and said they wanted to document the build before moving on to something different.

description: The Dark Alcove was a United Builders base established on September 1, 2025, according to the Archive.

name: Pit Fight 3
description:
The third Pit Fight was an Obscension event held on July 17, 2021. Its arena was modeled on Nuketown from Call of Duty, and _xMeh won the event.

An1meTiddie posted a contemporary thank-you message on July 17, with arena images and discussion of the site's Overworld location. The Archive preserves the build under that same date. An older catalog entry titled simply Pit Fight has the same horizontal coordinates and date, but a different landing height, suggesting an alternate listing of this venue.

Sato86's 2016 account lists it among the group's bases, and the 2b2t Wiki describes the move to Ravenholm and Ravendel following Old Town's destruction in 2011. This record preserves an Archive snapshot labeled 2018; that label is not the base's founding date.

name: Mansion and farm
description: A mansion and farm built by mattbrady775, established in August 2016 according to the Archive. This record preserves a snapshot from the final quarter of 2018.

name: Adrian's Castle

description: A United Builders base established on March 2, 2025, according to the Archive. This record preserves its April 20, 2025 snapshot.

name: Equilibrium II
description: Equilibrium II was established on June 2, 2018 according to the Archive. Its builds include Drollovitch's unfinished cathedral, redesigned after his earlier version at Equilibrium I. In his April 2020 account, Drollovitch credits Krobar with helping design the roof, TheFunCubes with construction, and Giganox and Fabustra with the surrounding terraforming. This record preserves the Archive's March 10, 2020 snapshot.

name: capybep's 2b2t build battle
description: The venue for Capybara's 2b2t Build Battle, held on April 27, 2025 with The Wedding Planners. Capybara designed the event's build and terrain, with KBgaming helping construct it on the server; hardboiledmegs helped organize and manage the event. Teams competed in Fantasy, Sci-fi and Organic rounds, judged by Capybara and YoMoBoYo. Copperator and CirocDrip's Cyan team won the final. The organizers credit the SpawnMasons with donating building materials and Malik and the Journeymen with contributing to the prize pool. The Archive records this venue under capybep's name.

name: x 39k Island (-X 39k)
description: An island near the -X 39,000 milestone, established on January 1, 2016 according to the Archive. This record preserves the January 3, 2016 snapshot.

name: Imperator's Base: Offtopia's
description: Offtopia's build at the original Imperator's Base, preserved in the Archive's November 20, 2015 snapshot. Offtopia is documented among the base's builders. The Archive labels this particular landmark simply as Offtopia's.

name: Drowzy's Civilization Project
description: Drowzy's Civilization Project, also called sleepyheads in the Archive, was established on September 20, 2025 by drcwzy, Lizinatorr and OldLadyNorth. This record preserves the September 23, 2025 snapshot.

name: Desert schematic base
description: A desert base built by Thorcffs in late 2019, according to the Archive. This record preserves the May 13, 2020 snapshot.

name: IronFist
description: Iron Fist was founded on May 7, 2018. In his account of the base, Redbaron1991 names 18emcclellan, quinn9009, ShrimpShack and 4pilot as fellow members. The base included a windmill, horse track, towers and an excavated circular pit. Gsmack filmed a tour with 4pilot in May 2019; Redbaron1991 documented the damaged base the following month. Atlas preserves the Archive snapshot labeled April 26, 2020, alongside the earlier historical media.

name: Magna Terram
description: Magna Terram was established on November 11, 2018 according to the Archive. This record preserves the April 26, 2020 snapshot.

name: Beta Isles
description: Beta Isles was established in mid-2017 by ItsYoungDaddy, 0xymoron and kyle_rayner_ion, according to the Archive. This record preserves a snapshot from the final quarter of 2018.

name: City of Boostation
description: A Peacekeepers base established in 2017, according to the Archive. This record preserves its June 10, 2024 snapshot.

name: Mount Vill
description: A base built by Mirek855, established on June 14, 2019 according to the Archive. This record preserves the January 31, 2020 snapshot of Mount Vill.

name: Imperator's Base: German Town Shipyard
description: The shipyard at German Town within Imperator's Base. The Archive dates its opening to December 2013 and preserves it in the November 20, 2015 snapshot.

name: Creeper farm
description: A creeper farm built by Green_Chrome, according to the Archive's builder credit. Its current Archive warp is labeled January 9, 2018.

name: Imperator's Base: Mushroom Dome
description: The Mushroom Dome landmark at Imperator's Base, preserved in the Archive's November 20, 2015 snapshot. The Archive identifies it as part of the original base; the dome's individual builder is not recorded in the reviewed sources.

name: Imperator's Base: Cathedral
description: LegitLobster's cathedral at Imperator's Base. The 2b2t Wiki records its construction during 2014, when much of the rest of the base was inactive. This landmark is preserved in the Archive's November 20, 2015 snapshot.

name: Japanese Temple
description: A temple built by _gigo in 2019, also known as Gigo's Temple. Its green tiered roofs overlook a raised garden with red gates and ornamental trees. In his original showcase, _gigo described adapting a Hanliang Palace design, planning parts in creative mode and then building it on 2b2t. The Archive preserves a November 5, 2019 snapshot.

name: Midgard Keep
description: The Archive identifies Midgard Keep as a Valkyria base and preserves a June 12, 2017 download.

name: Imperator's Base: iTristan's monument to Xntai
description: iTristan's monument to Xntai at the original Imperator's Base. The Archive identifies the monument by name in its November 20, 2015 snapshot; iTristan is also listed among the base's builders in the 2b2t Wiki.

name: Chimmy Chonga's base
description: Chimmy Chonga's base, established in June 2018 according to the Archive. This record preserves its September 6, 2019 snapshot.

name: IronWeasel's underwater base
description: An underwater base built by IronWeasel just north of Shenandoah. The Archive dates its founding to before June 2015 and preserves an August 12, 2016 snapshot.

name: assassin raptor's home
description: A home attributed to assassin_raptor in the Archive, whose menu dates the build to 2012. This record preserves the November 30, 2017 snapshot.

name: Argonath Fortress
description: A fortress near spawn attributed by the Archive to jowelly and brainslushy, established in 2012. This record preserves the November 16, 2017 snapshot. It is distinct from the later Last Templar base named Argonath.

name: Oceania (2018)
description: Island base founded by R2bEEaton and TheColorGreen after leaving their earlier Menders base. Beardler joined in March 2018, followed by other builders, and the base took the name Oceania that May. Participant recollections describe its destruction by jared2013 in May 2018 and members moving on to the Purgatory bases. The Archive preserves a world download dated May 15, 2018. This is separate from Oceania-i, the Imperials' 2025 spawn base.

name: Rusher 10-Year Anniversary
description: Event site built by Builders Guild for the tenth anniversary of TheCampingRusher's arrival on 2b2t. Location and builder attribution contributed by acuzi. Elevation was not supplied.

name: Bridgefuer
description: DonFuer base reported griefed in May 2026. Location, builder attribution, and grief date contributed by acuzi.

name: Aethervale
description: Fantasy-themed United Builders base established on March 24, 2026. Its May showcase features Dragonworm's floating wizard city and tower, a skyport by JustLuka and Turbo, Sumo's ocean-bowl statue, and a blackstone dragon by J3ww, alongside houses, a lighthouse, and landscaped terrain. The showcase credits its renders to lukent and includes further builder credits. Atlas pin coordinates were contributed by acuzi; the public announcement places the base nearby at X -166300, Z 122900. Elevation was not supplied.

name: Anime Base 6
description: Base of the 2b2t Anime Club. Location and builder attribution contributed by acuzi. Elevation was not supplied.

name: Underground Lodge (2019)
description: DieloTai built this SpawnMasons lodge. The Archive records it under April 14, 2019. It is a separate build from the other Underground Lodge.

name: Boat Lodge (2018)
description: Negative_Entropy built this SpawnMasons Boat Lodge. The Archive records it under March 3, 2018. It is separate from DieloTai’s 2019 Boat Lodge.

name: Secret Santa (2023)
description: This SpawnMasons Secret Santa lodge is recorded by the Archive under December 23, 2023. It is a separate site from the 2021 Secret Santa lodge at Sky Masons.

name: SBA 50
description: SBA 50 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive records it under April 4, 2023. It is a different site from SBA 70.

name: NSO 6
description: SurgicalDonut built NSO 6, established in March 2023 according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated April 4. It is a separate site from NSO 8.

name: Cookie Shack 3
description: Godroster and Ko8efanboy built Cookie Shack 3, established in July 2023 according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated September 21, 2023. It is separate from Cookie Shack 7.

name: SBA 69
description: SBA 69 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive preserves a September 2, 2024 download. It is separate from SBA 69.69.

name: Emperium Christmas Base 2019
description: This was the Emperium Christmas base preserved by the Archive under December 25, 2019. It is a separate site from the group’s 2024 Christmas base.

name: Christmas Party Base 2019
description: The 2b2t Party Committee organized this Christmas party base. The Archive credits BoomerangVillage, Breithan, CasparovJR, HawkedOnFonix, Negative_Entropy and BottleCapBrony, and preserves a December 21, 2019 download. It is separate from the committee’s 2024 venue.

name: Riften (Imperial Empire)
description: Avoxy founded Riften as an Imperial Empire recruit base on April 22, 2023. The Archive preserves a May 13 download, also listed as its end date in the group’s history. It is separate from the Riften build in the Skyrim complex.

name: Mushroom Base (mrking039)
description: This was mrking039’s first base, established in September 2016 according to the Archive. Its preserved download is labeled late 2018. It is separate from Blizzen’s Mushroom Base.

name: Halloween Party Committee Base 2022
description: This was a 2b2t Party Committee Halloween venue near X -37,482, Z -19,259. The Archive dates its establishment to October 2022 and preserves an October 29 download. Several separate Halloween venues existed that year.

name: Halloween Party Base 2025
description: The 2b2t Party Committee built this Halloween venue in October 2025, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated October 25.

name: Halloween Party Base 2024
description: This 2b2t Party Committee Halloween venue was preserved by the Archive under October 26, 2024. It is separate from the committee’s 2018 and 2020 venues.

name: Geezer Town 7 (January 2024 capture)
description: The Archive labels this Graybeard Geezers site Geezer Town 7 and preserves a January 26, 2024 download near X -6,945, Z -34,329. Its listed establishment date is November 26, 2023. The separately preserved February capture is at different coordinates.

name: Polaris
description: Polaris was an Astral Brotherhood base established on October 17, 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated November 7. It is separate from the later Molaris base.

name: Spawnfuer S7-a
description: Spawnfuer S7-a was a DonFuer base established in August 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated August 17. It is separate from Spawnfuer 17, a December 2021 base at different coordinates.

name: SBA 47
description: SBA 47 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive preserves a January 17, 2023 download; its catalog entry does not give a founding date.

name: SBA 64
description: SBA 64 was a Spawn Builders Association base established on April 9, 2024, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 8.

name: SBA 65
description: SBA 65 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive preserves a June 22, 2024 download; its catalog entry does not give a founding date.

name: SBA 26
description: SBA 26 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2022 and preserves a March 10 download.

name: SBA 29
description: SBA 29 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2022 and preserves an April 1 download.

name: SBA 62
description: SBA 62 was a Spawn Builders Association base. The Archive preserves a May 5, 2024 download; its catalog entry does not give a founding date.

name: SBA Nether Spawn Build
description: This Spawn Builders Association build was near Nether spawn. The Archive preserves it under January 1, 2023. It is separate from SBA 1 in the Overworld.

name: Christmas Party Base 2018
description: The 2b2t Party Committee built this 2018 Christmas venue. The Archive credits BoomerangVillage, BottleCapBrony, Breithan, Mr_Pint and Jin_Masamune and preserves a December 22 download. This is distinct from the committee’s later annual venues.

name: Spawnfuer 22
description: Spawnfuer 22 was a DonFuer base established on May 28, 2022, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated June 5. This site is distinct from Spawnfuer 16 and the later Don Luden base also called Spawnfuer 22.

name: SpawnFuer 25
description: NamoVFX built SpawnFuer 25 as a DonFuer base. The Archive dates its establishment to June 17, 2022 and preserves a June 25 download. It is separate from Spawnfuer 15.1 and the later city DonFuer 25.

name: The Last Templar 1 Year Memorial
description: The Last Templar built this first-anniversary obsidian monument on the positive X Overworld highway near X 10,000. The Archive dates its establishment to September 2019 and preserves a September 29 download.

name: The Last Templar 4 Year Memorial
description: The Last Templar built this fourth-anniversary monument on the negative Z Overworld highway near Z -10,000. The Archive dates its establishment to March 2022 and preserves a March 23 download.

name: The Last Templar 5 Year Memorial
description: The Last Templar built this fifth-anniversary monument on the positive X Overworld highway near X 20,000. The Archive dates its establishment to February 27, 2023 and preserves an October 20 download.

name: Imperial Recruit Base (2022)
description: The Imperial Empire established this recruit base on October 3, 2022. The Archive preserves an October 20 download. It is separate from the group’s March 2021 recruit base.

name: Fight Club Reboot: Notre Dame (Nether)
description: Franknificant built this Nether recreation of Notre-Dame de Paris with soggydoggy for Fight Club in October 2021. The Archive preserves an October 19 download. It is separate from his original Overworld church and later replicas.

name: Baghdad (Fourth Incursion)
description: Baghdad was established during the Fourth Incursion in 2016, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is labeled the fourth quarter of 2018. This is separate from the SpawnMasons base Boghdad.

name: Little Italy (2024)
description: This Little Italy was established in November 2024, according to the Archive. Its preserved download is dated February 1, 2025. It is distinct from the July 2019 settlement near spawn with the same name.

name: Old City
description: Old City was a Judge’s Group base established in 2011, according to the Archive. Its current Archive warp is labeled November 2011. This is a separate location from HermeticLock’s Cloud City.

name: Oasis (SpawnMasons lodge)
description: Mr_Pint built this SpawnMasons lodge, recorded by the Archive under July 25, 2020. It is separate from Geometrik’s 2016 Oasis base and the Nether Highway Group’s Oasis Outpost.

name: Narnia

name: Rocket Town (2025)

name: Sleepy Hollow (Emperium)

name: Sixth Incursion base (main map)
description: This Sixth Incursion base was established in April 2018 on the main 2b2t map. The Archive preserves an April 8 download. It is distinct from the stronghold on the temporary AntVenom map.

name: Monastery (Astral Order)
description: The Astral Order founded this Monastery on February 19, 2018 after the destruction of Malachor. Founders included jay_monroe, LordGalvatronMC and SuperViperMan. The Archive preserves a July 8, 2019 download. This is separate from the much older Monastery also known as Gape Haven.

name: Exodus (CainesLaw and Tachrev)
description: CainesLaw and Tachrev founded Exodus in early 2015. The small peninsula base included a cobblestone wall, a house and a gold farm. It is distinct from Pheanom’s later Exodus City.

name: 4milville
description: Bobymicjohn's Nether retreat on the +Z highway, just short of the four-million-block milestone. Constructed in 2020 as MEG diggers reached the milestone.

name: Zipper
description: LucidLullabye's pyramid base at the Overworld's southern world border, about 30,000 blocks west of the +Z axis. The enormous stone pyramid shelters buildings, farms and a visitor wall whose welcome sign is dated December 2019. LucidLullabye shared early photographs in May 2021. In February 2023, the builder reported that the pyramid remained standing despite damage to the storage room and interior walls.

name: Mesashroom
description: Also known as Meshroom, an Overworld base near the southern world border. Its surroundings include a large collection of map art, documented in a JourneyMap image shared by bobymicjohn in March 2025. The +Z Border community recorded the base coordinates in a pinned message in April 2021.

name: Boby's Border Base 2
description: Bobymicjohn's new border base after the update to Minecraft 1.21, built in the snowy mountains about one million blocks north of the southern Overworld border. Discovered by Krabss in October 2025. Preserved in a September 22, 2026 world download by bobymicjohn.

name: +Z 15M End Rest Stop
description: An End rest stop near the +Z 15-million highway milestone. Bobymicjohn began building it on July 30, 2025, including its shulker and ender pearl farms. The site offers free supplies and includes an oasis later expanded by Bird. Preserved in a September 23, 2026 world download by bobymicjohn.

name: Blinkee Oasis
description: Blinkee Oasis was the Sun Knights' first members' base. The group's wiki history dates its establishment to March 16, 2022 and says it lasted until April 1, 2023. The Archive preserves a May 5, 2022 capture of the Overworld site, with a world download and map render linked here.

name: Yqe SkyBlock Void: colored block stash

renders.name: Yqe SkyBlock Void: colored block stash

name: Spawn Migration
description: Spawn Migration, also called Migration Base, was a SpawnMasons community spawnbase founded by Joey_Coconut on October 20, 2022. Its theme required buildings to appear mobile: walking structures, wheeled builds, flying creations and carried buildings. It hosted SpawnMasons meetings and expanded with builders from the Astral Brotherhood, the Ancients and the Spawn Builders Association. After its location was leaked, members self-griefed the base on November 23, 2022. The Archive preserves a capture dated that same day; the date alone does not establish which stage of the destruction it records.

name: Trading Post Krakatoa
description: Krakatoa was a Trading Post community base built around a large volcano and a replica of the Southern Canal. The wiki credits _OGKush_ and MikeyJohnson. Its founding date is uncertain: the Archive menu says September 12, 2025, while the wiki says October 21. The Archive preserves a November 3, 2025 download. The source disagreement is retained rather than treating the capture date as the founding date.

name: Dominion and Fart Clan Halloween Base
description: A shared Dominion and Fart Clan Halloween base. The Archive preserves a download labelled November 1, 2025.

renders.name: Dominion and Fart Clan Halloween Base

name: Core City
description: Core City is an Overworld base built by Core Builders, started in August 2026. Builders credited by CoreBuilder are vqsr, 001OliNaut, CrazyHasCake, Hyper01, breadrollofdoom, 220__022, polevka1234 and Qwerttze. Preserved in a September 15, 2026 world download supplied by the group and available on The Archive as /warp Core_City_2026-09-15.

name: Emperium Pit Fight 4.5
description:
Emperium Pit Fight 4.5 used a flying-saucer arena in the End. A broad, dark domed UFO hangs over a green circular platform, with pale lights around the craft and arena. The surrounding End islands and the saucer's distinctive shape can be seen both in the preserved world and in the organizer's later series gallery.

The venue is at X -6629, Z 767, and the Archive preserves an October 24, 2025 download. The decimal in 4.5 is part of its recorded name. It is a separate venue from Emperium Pit Fight 5 in the Overworld and Obscension's High Charity arena. The capture does not establish an exact event day, winner or prizes.

name: Cider Haven
description: Cider Haven is a DonFuer base on 2b2t. Dragonworm listed its 2025-11-25 capture among the group's additions to The Archive on September 29, 2026.

name: Bridgefuer 2
description: Bridgefuer 2 is a DonFuer base on 2b2t. Dragonworm listed its 2026-05-22 capture among the group's additions to The Archive on September 29, 2026.

name: GeezerTown 20
description: Geezer Town 20 is part of the Graybeard Geezers' numbered base series. Its Archive warp is labelled August 29, 2025.

name: 10 Year anniversary base
description: The Imperials' 10-year anniversary base.

name: rusher v fit lodge and event

name: Green Castle
description: Green Castle is a DonFuer base on 2b2t. Dragonworm listed its 2026-09-06 capture among the group's additions to The Archive on September 29, 2026.

name: Frostfall
description: Frostfall is an Emperium base in the Overworld. The 2b2t Wiki lists it as Frost Fall, and The Archive preserves a partial capture dated December 27, 2025.

name: Esseadris
description: Esseadris was an unfinished Valkyrian base from 2015. FitMC’s May 2018 tour describes it as an abandoned project intended as a new main base after the Third Incursion. The tour shows its snowy setting, buildings and surviving member signs. The wiki lists Esseadris among Valkyria’s bases. The Archive preserves a download dated October 5, 2019; that is a capture date, not the founding date.

name: Farmfuer
description: Farmfuer is a DonFuer base on 2b2t. Dragonworm listed its 2026-01-22 capture among the group's additions to The Archive on September 29, 2026.

name: Hollow
description: Hollow is an Emperium base in the Overworld, preserved in The Archive's November 1, 2025 partial world download. The Emperium's wiki article lists Hollow and Sleepy Hollow separately.

name: R1ckson's Dojo
description: R1ckson's Dojo is an Overworld castle-and-courtyard build. In his video about inviting players to a public spawn base, R1ckson recalls the original Dojo at 3:58; the rest of that video follows a different base. The Archive preserves a March 19, 2026 capture of the Dojo, linked here as a world download and map render.

name: Emperium Pit Fight 5
description:
Emperium Pit Fight 5 used a SpongeBob SquarePants-inspired venue in the Overworld. The preserved build recreates the Krusty Krab and the Chum Bucket across a road, with sandy landscaping and coral-like decorations. The organizer's later gallery shows the Krusty Krab facade, its clam-shaped sign and the adjacent bucket-shaped building beneath Emperium branding.

The location is at X -7816, Z 94632. The Archive preserves a March 21, 2026 download, which establishes the saved build's date rather than a verified tournament day. A winner and prize list have not been confirmed. This is distinct from Emperium's End-dimension Pit Fight 4.5 and Obscension's Halo-themed High Charity arena.

name: Spawn Pearl Ziggurat of Ash
description: The Ziggurat of Ash was a Spawn Pearl trading and transport hub operated by The Trading Post. The group’s history credits _OGKush_, MikeyJohnson and musheck with its design and describes it as a successor to earlier Spawn Pearl sites. The Archive preserves a May 23, 2026 download. The wiki’s surrounding Spawn Pearl chronology contains inconsistent years, so no precise founding date is asserted here.

name: Geezer Town 14
description: Geezer Town 14 was a Graybeard Geezers base. The Archive lists its establishment as November 1, 2024 and preserves a November 2 download.

name: Underground Lodge (August 2018)
description: Spawnmason lodge l18w32, recorded in The Archive for 2018-08-11. The Archive credits Rooster548 Scribblefoxx, Stadhouder iAreLuck.

name: Spawnmason Lodge l17w35
description: Spawnmason lodge l17w35, recorded in The Archive for 2017-09-02. The Archive credits Ain, Tanaxis.

name: Spawnmason Lodge l17w31
description: Spawnmason lodge l17w31, recorded in The Archive for 2017-08-05. The Archive credits HermeticLock. This capture shows ruins.

name: Spawnmason Lodge l17w26
description: Spawnmason lodge l17w26, recorded in The Archive for 2017-07-01. The Archive credits AlphaComputer. This capture shows ruins.

name: +X 30M / +Z 10M Milestone
description: This location includes Overworld and Nether captures of the same highway stop. The Nether view is also known as Nether +X 3.75M / +Z 1.25M Milestone, near X 3,750,000, Z 1,249,978. The current Nether warp is labeled January 5, 2018; the Overworld warp is labeled July 11, 2017.

name: +X 30M / +Z 15M Milestone
description: This location includes Overworld and Nether captures of the same highway stop. The Nether view is also known as Nether +X 3.75M / +Z 1.875M Milestone, near X 3,750,000, Z 1,874,987. The current Nether warp is labeled January 6, 2018; the Overworld warp is labeled August 29, 2017.

name: Divinity Colosseum
description: Divinity's Colosseum near spawn, presented in Cloudy Abyss's two June 2026 videos as a place for summer PvP. Cloudy supplied its Overworld X/Z position in October 2026; elevation is unrecorded.

name: Anor Londo
description: A Divinity build inspired by Anor Londo from Dark Souls. Cloudy Abyss's August 2026 video shows it while construction was still underway. Cloudy supplied its Overworld X/Z position in October 2026; elevation is unrecorded.

name: Divinity Outpost
description: A Divinity outpost on the positive Z axis. Cloudy supplied its name and Overworld X/Z position to Atlas in October 2026; elevation is unrecorded.
